blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Nevertheless, all journeys involve considerable risk and part of the skill in arriving safely is setting off at the right time. This means accurate weather forecasting and utilising favourable winds. Birds are adept at both and, in tests, some can detect the minute difference in barometric pressure between the floor and ceiling of a room. Often birds react to weather changes before there is any visible sign of them. Certain species that feed on grassland flee at the onset of a cold snap because when the ground surface freezes the birds could starve. Yet they return ahead of a thaw, their arrival linked to a pressure change presaging an improvement in the weather.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 尽管如此，所有旅程都伴随巨大风险，而安全抵达的部分技巧在于选择正确的出发时间。这需要准确预测天气并利用有利风向，鸟类对两者都十分擅长。在测试中，有些鸟甚至能察觉一个房间地面与天花板之间极其细微的气压差。鸟类往往在天气变化尚未出现任何可见迹象前就作出反应。某些以草地为食物来源的物种，会在寒潮开始时逃离，因为地表一旦冻结，它们就可能饿死。然而，它们会在解冻前返回；其到来与预示天气好转的气压变化有关。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Unfortunately, some never complete their journey. Not so long ago the assumption was that a bird in the air on a dark windy night with no visible reference points to judge position was, like a pilot without radar, hopelessly lost. We now know this is not the case. Losses do occur, but mainly because birds get swept off course by strong air masses against which battle is futile, and this results in a watery grave. Indeed, it is not unusual for ocean fish to be caught with bird remains in their stomachs. But sometimes there's a silver lining. Each autumn a small number of North American birds are blown across the Atlantic by fast-moving westerly tail winds. Not only do they arrive safely in Europe but, based on tracking evidence, some make it back to North America in the following spring – probably after spending the winter with European migrants in sunny African climes.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 遗憾的是，有些鸟永远无法完成旅程。不久以前，人们还以为，在一个黑暗多风的夜晚，空中的鸟看不到任何可用来判断位置的参照物，就会像没有雷达的飞行员一样彻底迷失方向。如今我们知道事实并非如此。迁徙途中确实会有损失，但主要原因是鸟类被强劲气团吹离航线；与之抗争毫无希望，最终只能葬身水中。事实上，海鱼被捕获时胃里带有鸟类残骸，并不罕见。不过，有时也会因祸得福。每年秋天，少量北美鸟类会被快速移动的西风顺风吹过大西洋。它们不仅能够安全抵达欧洲；追踪证据还表明，其中一些会在第二年春天返回北美——它们此前可能与欧洲候鸟一起，在阳光充足的非洲地区度过了冬天。

source.text: Born to Trade

translation.text: 天生会交易

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Long before our ancestors had any trappings of civilisation, they had a taste for material goods. Kate Douglas discovers where this ancient obsession has led us.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 早在祖先拥有任何文明的外在标志之前，他们就已对物质商品产生兴趣。Kate Douglas 探究这种古老的痴迷最终把我们带到了何处。

source.text: Long before our ancestors had any trappings of civilisation, they had a taste for material goods.

translation.text: 早在祖先拥有任何文明的外在标志之前，他们就已对物质商品产生兴趣。

source.text: Kate Douglas discovers where this ancient obsession has led us.

translation.text: Kate Douglas 探究这种古老的痴迷最终把我们带到了何处。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Humans are born to trade and we don’t need shops or money to do it—the heart of commerce is an instinctive ability for what anthropologists call “reciprocity”. This is an ability to exchange goods of equal worth, and it evolved as the brains of our ancient ancestors and societies became more complex, allowing individuals to keep a running tally of their interactions with others. Evidence from modern hunter-gatherers leaves little doubt that the exchange of food and favours is innate, as is the ability to keep track of the credits and debits that accrue as a result. Combine this skill for mental book-keeping with even the most basic material culture, and trade inevitably follows.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 人类天生会交易，而且不需要商店或货币也能做到。商业的核心，是一种人类学家称为“互惠”的本能能力，也就是交换价值相等的物品。这种能力随着远古祖先的大脑和社会变得更加复杂而进化形成，使个人能够持续记录自己与他人的往来。现代狩猎采集者提供的证据几乎毫无疑问地表明，交换食物和互相帮忙是与生俱来的，记录由此累积的收支账目也是如此。把这种心算记账的能力与哪怕最基本的物质文化结合起来，贸易就必然随之出现。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Once trade gets off the ground, the economic benefits quickly make it irresistible. But exchanging tools, food and other essentials of life in a barter economy is a far cry from the shopping mall. Modern consumerism extends beyond subsistence and utilitarianism to encompass everything from Gucci handbags and BMW convertibles to valuable paintings. Clearly, the worth of such goods is not inherent but resides in certain intangible qualities that we invest in them. When did humans start holding these goods in such high esteem?
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 贸易一旦起步，其经济利益很快就会让人难以抗拒。然而，在以物易物的经济中交换工具、食物和其他生活必需品，与购物中心相去甚远。现代消费主义超越了生存需要和实用价值，涵盖从 Gucci 手袋、BMW 敞篷车到名贵画作的一切物品。显然，这些商品的价值并非与生俱来，而是存在于我们赋予它们的某些无形特质之中。人类是从什么时候开始如此看重这些商品的？

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: All the archaeological evidence for the flowering of consumer culture has up to now pointed to a date of around 40,000 years ago. That’s when early modern humans started making increasingly intricate bone and stone tools, carving patterns into rocks and creating representational art such as carved figurines, jewellery and cave paintings. However, discoveries in Africa are pushing the origins of consumerism much further back into human prehistory. A few years ago, reports began to emerge of discoveries made at the Blombos Cave, a site of ancient human habitation in South Africa. Christopher Henshilwood and colleagues from the University of Bergen in Norway dated thousands of pieces of ochre from the cave, and many of them proved to be more than 100,000 years old — before the time that early humans moved out of Africa. Ochre, a coloured clay that comes in various shades from red to black, does not occur naturally around Blombos and must have been imported from quarries at least 30 kilometres away, either directly by Blombos residents or through trade. Although ochre can be used to dry and preserve (cure) animal hides, the researchers are convinced the Blombos ochre had a symbolic purpose. For a start, it is predominantly red—any of the other colours available would have done for curing—and the surfaces of the clay had been scraped in a way that indicates they were used to yield pigment for dyes.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 迄今为止，有关消费文化兴盛的所有考古证据都指向大约4万年前。正是在那时，早期现代人开始制作日益精巧的骨器和石器，在岩石上雕刻图案，并创作雕像、首饰和洞穴绘画等具象艺术。然而，非洲的发现正把消费主义的起源大幅推向人类史前时期更久远的年代。 几年前，关于南非古人类居住遗址布隆博斯洞穴的发现开始见诸报道。挪威卑尔根大学的 Christopher Henshilwood 及其同事测定了洞中数千块赭土的年代，结果表明其中许多已有超过10万年历史，早于早期人类走出非洲的时期。赭土是一种颜色从红到黑、深浅不一的彩色黏土，在布隆博斯附近并非天然存在，必定是从至少30公里外的采石场运来，可能由当地居民直接带回，也可能通过贸易获得。赭土可以用来使动物皮干燥并保存，但研究人员确信，布隆博斯的赭土具有象征用途。首先，这些赭土以红色为主，而用于处理兽皮时，任何一种现有颜色都可以；其次，黏土表面经过刮削，表明人们曾从中取得颜料用于染色。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: An even more intriguing discovery from Blombos was of 41 beads dating from 76,000 years ago, found in clusters and made from the shells of a tiny mollusc. These cannot be natural deposits, argue the researchers, as each cluster contains shells of a similar size and colour with consistently placed holes. What’s more, all the beads display a pattern of wear suggesting friction from rubbing against thread, clothes or other beads. The previous oldest find of beads in Africa dates back to just 45,000 years ago. And it seems the Blombos people’s taste for beautiful items was not an isolated phenomenon. Jessica Thompson of Arizona State University in Tempe has described finding shell fragments from a site in Tanzania that she believes may represent debris from bead manufacture. They are at least 45,000—and possibly 280,000—years old. Although there is no evidence of how the ancient beads were used, their modern counterparts are often traded. So it looks as though our taste for jewellery and art is much older than we thought.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 布隆博斯还有一项更耐人寻味的发现：41颗距今7.6万年的珠子。这些珠子成簇出土，由一种微小软体动物的贝壳制成。研究人员认为，它们不可能是自然沉积物，因为每一簇所含贝壳的大小和颜色相近，孔洞位置也始终一致。此外，所有珠子都呈现出一种磨损痕迹，说明它们曾与线、衣物或其他珠子相互摩擦。 此前，非洲发现的最古老珠子只能追溯到4.5万年前。而且，布隆博斯人对美丽物品的喜爱似乎并非孤立现象。位于坦佩的亚利桑那州立大学研究人员 Jessica Thompson 曾描述，在坦桑尼亚一处遗址发现了一些贝壳碎片；她认为这些碎片可能是制作珠子留下的残屑。它们至少有4.5万年历史，甚至可能已有28万年。虽然没有证据说明古代珠子如何使用，但现代对应物经常用于交易。因此看来，我们对珠宝和艺术的喜爱远比原先认为的更加古老。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: But why did we come to value these objects in the first place? In many animal species, individuals signal their genetic fitness by showing off with attention-grabbing adornment. Some researchers think that in humans, consumer products play a similar role. Archaeologist Aimee Plourde, from the University of California, also argues that even in egalitarian societies, some people are more successful than others. Among our ancestors, superior skills in areas such as hunting, crafts, environmental knowledge and contact with neighbouring groups would have brought respect—in other words, prestige. And because prestige brings social benefits, people would want to show off their talents. The best way to do this would be through demonstrating possession of material items that are hard to fake. ‘A good hunter, for instance, could advertise his skills by wearing the tooth of an animal that is elusive or dangerous,’ says Plourde. The benefits of prestige would also lead to competition to acquire it. As a result, the value and variety of prestige goods would spiral and there would be a parallel increase in the ranking of social systems. If Plourde is correct, prestige goods form a direct link between our innate drive for trade and the development of structured, hierarchical societies. They are arguably the first step on the road to modern civilisation, paving the way for agriculture and urbanisation. We may not be impressed by beads any more, but their modern equivalents have the same fascination. Nobody believes the guy who spends €670,000 on a Bugatti Veyron car does so because he needs to travel at 250 mph. We all know in today’s consumer society he’s buying an exclusive status symbol.

passages.title: Coins - the first form of money

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: Coins - the first form of money

source.text: Coins - the first form of money

translation.text: 硬币——最早的货币形式

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Few people pay much attention to coins; we take them for granted. Since the advent of paper currency and the abandonment of a monetary system based on intrinsic or actual value, they have been demoted to the status of change: what is left when you have paid for something with ‘paper’ money. There is even a belief that they will one day be obsolete, as will paper or plastic notes, and money will at last have achieved the pure status of a mathematical formulation, a system of electronic credits and debits.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 很少有人特别留意硬币，我们把它们视为理所当然。纸币出现、以货币内在或实际价值为基础的货币制度被弃用以后，硬币的地位降为零钱，也就是用“纸”币买东西后剩下的钱。甚至有人认为，有朝一日硬币将被淘汰，纸质或塑料钞票也会如此；到那时，货币终于会达到纯粹的数学表达形式，成为一套电子收支系统。

translation.text: 很少有人特别留意硬币，我们把它们视为理所当然。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In the modern media environment, the sheer number of visual images is overwhelming, but it makes one stop to think that coins are among the most durable of our artefacts, and future archaeologists will scrutinise coins in order to learn about their distant ancestors. This is exactly the way ancient coins have informed us for over four millennia. There are thousands of different coins, each designed to carry meaning as well as value, tiny but rich sources of documentary evidence about events and cultural attitudes, frequently produced with exquisite craftsmanship.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 现代媒体环境中的视觉图像数量之多，令人难以招架。然而，想到硬币是我们最耐久的人工制品之一，不免让人停下来思考：未来的考古学家会仔细研究硬币，以了解他们遥远的祖先。四千多年来，古代硬币正是以这种方式向我们提供信息。不同硬币数以千计，每一种都经过设计，既承载价值，也传达含义。它们体积虽小，却是有关历史事件和文化态度的丰富文献证据来源，而且往往工艺极为精美。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Coins in Europe date from 2,500 to 2,700 years ago, and seem to have originated in the ancient kingdom of Lydia, in what is now Turkey. Before coins, trade was based on barter: the direct trade of commodities. Barter required the physical presence of both commodities that were being traded. Metal coins were far more portable, and not subject to the same spoilage on long sea journeys as a commodity like grain might be if it became wet. However, they could also be accumulated, and these hoards could be stolen. Coins were therefore a temptation to criminals. The Greeks, however, were the first to realise the full potential of the new invention. They were a trading people of seafarers. Their civilisation, which was composed of dozens of city-states, was highly decentralised. Despite the potential for theft, the Greeks realised that they could benefit enormously from a system that used coins, because it meant that they no longer had to carry goods with them to barter.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 欧洲的硬币可追溯到2,500至2,700年前，似乎起源于古代吕底亚王国，即今天的土耳其境内。硬币出现以前，贸易以物易物，也就是直接交换商品。以物易物要求双方要交换的商品同时在场。金属硬币便于携带得多；在漫长海上旅程中，它们也不会像谷物等商品那样，因受潮而腐坏。然而，硬币也可以大量积存，而这些储藏可能被盗，因此会成为罪犯的诱惑。不过，希腊人最先认识到这项新发明的全部潜力。他们是从事贸易的航海民族，其文明由数十个城邦组成，权力高度分散。尽管存在失窃风险，希腊人仍意识到，硬币制度能带来巨大利益，因为他们不再需要随身携带商品去交换。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The value of coins was generally based on the intrinsic value of the metal they were made of. At first this was mostly silver, and this meant that the discovery of silver mines on Greek territory actually increased the quantity of money they could produce. Had the Greek mining been on a larger scale, it could have caused problems similar to those faced by the Spanish centuries later, when so much gold from the New World was brought into their economy that it resulted in serious inflation. One advantage of intrinsic value was that coins could be weighed to determine the amount of metal they contained, so that the only thing an issuing state had to guarantee was the purity of the metal to prevent accusations of fraud and cheating, which could cause fighting and unrest. This was quite difficult to do, especially with coins made of gold, until Archimedes realised that different metals have different weight-volume ratios, and that by measuring the amount of displacement when coins were immersed in water, it was possible to establish whether gold was alloyed with silver.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 硬币的价值通常取决于铸造金属本身的价值。最初使用的金属主要是银，这意味着在希腊领土上发现银矿，确实增加了他们能够制造的货币数量。假如希腊采矿规模更大，就可能引发类似几个世纪后西班牙面临的问题：大量来自新大陆的黄金进入西班牙经济，造成严重通货膨胀。内在价值制度的一项优势是，人们可以给硬币称重，以确定其中所含金属的数量。因此，发行硬币的国家只需保证金属纯度，防止欺诈和作弊指控；这类指控可能导致冲突和动荡。不过，这一点相当难以做到，金币尤其如此；直到阿基米德认识到不同金属的重量与体积之比不同，并发现通过测量硬币浸入水中时的排水量，可以判断黄金是否掺入了白银，问题才得以解决。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: All ancient coins were made by hand using engraved metal moulds. Many hundreds of coins were made, and as a result the moulds often cracked and new ones had to be engraved. This explains the endless variety encountered in coins with the same designs because the moulds had to be remade repeatedly, by many different artisans. One of the distinctive features of coins, in fact, is that they are the work of anonymous craftsmen, and yet each coin is an intimate reflection of the character of its city of origin. It was the Greeks who realised that coins could have a double function, as a unit of value and as a symbol of the identity of the city that issued them. The Greek view of life was deeply motivated by a spirit of competition, and coins, which circulated around the trading world, were a way of advertising the qualities of each particular city-state.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 所有古代硬币都用雕刻过的金属模具手工铸造。人们会用同一模具制造数百枚硬币，模具因此经常开裂，必须重新雕刻。即使设计相同的硬币也变化无穷，原因就在于模具要由许多不同工匠反复重制。事实上，硬币的一项鲜明特点是，它们出自无名工匠之手，但每一枚都细致反映了发行城市的特质。希腊人认识到，硬币可以发挥双重作用：既是价值单位，也是发行城市的身份象征。希腊人的人生观深受竞争精神驱动，而在贸易世界中流通的硬币，正是宣传各个城邦特质的一种方式。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Interestingly, Greek coins from the city of Athens, which was the home of the greatest sculptors of the classical period, seem to have been completely disconnected from the high sculptural tradition. The beautiful features of the city’s patron, Athena (with her owl on the reverse of the coin), seem to have been repeated virtually unaltered for many years. Perhaps this was because the Athenian currency had grown increasingly to be the international standard and, like the US dollar today, a uniform design implied integrity.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 有意思的是，雅典是古典时期最伟大雕塑家的故乡，但该城的希腊硬币似乎与这种高水平雕塑传统完全脱节。城邦守护神雅典娜美丽的面容，以及硬币背面的猫头鹰，多年来似乎一直被反复采用，几乎没有变化。或许这是因为雅典货币日益成为国际标准；如同今天的美元，统一的设计意味着可靠和诚信。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: One side of a coin was always occupied by the head of a divinity, so it was a relatively small step, at around 323 BC, for Greek coins to replace that head with the portrait of the reigning monarch, a tradition that has continued in monarchies to the present day. Republics may have either symbolic heads going back to the older tradition of divinities or the features of a distinguished past head of state. The Romans adopted the Greek practice of coin design and as a result, the features of many great Romans have survived and are known to modern generations, despite the fact that the art of portrait painting was completely lost for more than a millennium following the fall of the Roman Empire.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 硬币的一面原本总是铸有神祇头像，因此大约到公元前323年，希腊硬币把这一头像换成在位君主的肖像，只是相对不大的一步。这一传统在君主制国家一直延续至今。共和国的硬币上可能使用象征性头像，沿袭更早的神祇传统；也可能采用过去某位杰出国家元首的面容。罗马人沿用了希腊的硬币设计做法，因此许多伟大罗马人的面貌得以留存，并为现代人所知，尽管罗马帝国灭亡后，肖像画艺术曾彻底失传一千多年。

source.text: Corporate social responsibility

translation.text: 企业社会责任

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: Acting in a socially responsible way can give companies a competitive advantage as well as benefiting the community
headerUnits.translationNormalizedText: 以对社会负责的方式行事，既能造福社区，也能给企业带来竞争优势。

source.text: Acting in a socially responsible way can give companies a competitive advantage as well as benefiting the community

translation.text: 以对社会负责的方式行事，既能造福社区，也能给企业带来竞争优势。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In the 1980s, Norwegian Prime Minister Gro Harlem Brundtland gave the following definition of corporate social responsibility (CSR): ‘Meeting the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.’ Nowadays, governments, activists and the media are quick to hold companies to account for the social consequences of their actions. As a result, corporate social responsibility has become a priority for business leaders around the world. When a well-run business applies its vast resources and expertise to social problems that it understands and in which it has a stake, it can have a greater impact than any other organization. Although many companies have already done much to improve the social and environmental impact of their activities, these efforts are not always as productive as they could be.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 20世纪80年代，挪威首相 Gro Harlem Brundtland 对企业社会责任（CSR）作出如下定义：“在满足当代人需求的同时，不损害后代人满足自身需求的能力。”如今，政府、活动人士和媒体会迅速要求企业为其行为造成的社会后果负责。因此，企业社会责任已经成为全球企业领导者优先考虑的问题。一家管理良好的企业如果把庞大的资源和专业能力用于自己了解且利益相关的社会问题，所能产生的影响可能超过任何其他组织。尽管许多企业已经为改善自身活动对社会和环境的影响做了大量工作，这些努力并不总能发挥其本可达到的成效。

translation.text: 因此，企业社会责任已经成为全球企业领导者优先考虑的问题。

source.text: Although many companies have already done much to improve the social and environmental impact of their activities, these efforts are not always as productive as they could be.

translation.text: 尽管许多企业已经为改善自身活动对社会和环境的影响做了大量工作，这些努力并不总能发挥其本可达到的成效。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: To advance CSR we need first to acknowledge the interrelationship between a corporation and society. Successful corporations need a healthy society. Education, health care and equal opportunities are essential to a productive workforce. Safe products and working conditions not only attract customers but also lower internal costs as there are fewer accidents, while good government and strong regulatory standards protect both consumers and competing companies from exploitation. Ultimately, a healthy society creates demand for business as more human needs are met and aspirations grow. At the same time, a healthy society needs successful companies to create the jobs, wealth and innovation that improve social conditions over time.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 要推进企业社会责任，我们首先需要承认企业与社会之间相互依存。成功的企业需要健康的社会。教育、医疗保健和平等机会，是形成高效劳动力的必要条件。安全的产品和工作条件不仅能吸引顾客，还能因为事故减少而降低企业内部成本；良好的政府治理和严格的监管标准，则能保护消费者和相互竞争的企业免受剥削。归根结底，随着越来越多的人类需求得到满足、愿望不断增长，健康的社会会创造商业需求。与此同时，健康的社会也需要成功企业创造就业、财富和创新，从而逐步改善社会状况。

source.text: To advance CSR we need first to acknowledge the interrelationship between a corporation and society.

translation.text: 要推进企业社会责任，我们首先需要承认企业与社会之间相互依存。

translation.text: 与此同时，健康的社会也需要成功企业创造就业、财富和创新，从而逐步改善社会状况。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: A company’s impact on society also changes over time, as social standards evolve and science progresses. Asbestos, now understood to be a serious health risk, was thought to be safe in the early 1900s, given the scientific knowledge then available. Evidence of its risks gradually mounted for more than 50 years before any company was held liable for the harm it can cause. Many firms that failed to anticipate the consequences of this evolving body of research have been bankrupted by the results. No longer can companies be content to monitor only the obvious social impacts of today. Without a careful process to identify evolving social effects, firms may risk their very survival.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 随着社会标准演变和科学进步，企业对社会的影响也会发生变化。石棉如今被认为会严重危害健康，但以20世纪初当时已有的科学知识来看，人们曾认为它是安全的。有关石棉风险的证据逐渐积累了50多年，之后才有企业因其可能造成的伤害而被追究责任。许多公司未能预见这些不断累积的研究证据会带来何种后果，最终因此破产。企业再也不能满足于只监测当今显而易见的社会影响。如果没有一套审慎流程来识别不断变化的社会影响，企业可能会危及自身生存。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: However, no business can solve all of society’s problems or bear the cost of doing so. Instead, each company must choose issues that intersect with its particular business. Other social agendas are best left to companies in other industries or government institutions that are better positioned to address them. The essential test that should guide CSR is not whether a cause is worthy but whether it presents an opportunity to create shared value – that is, a meaningful benefit for society that is also valuable for the business. Each company should try to identify the social problems that it is best equipped to help resolve. Addressing social issues in this way will lead to self-sustaining solutions that are not dependent on government subsidies.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 然而，任何企业都无法解决社会的全部问题，也无力承担这样做的成本。每家公司应当选择与自身特定业务有交集的问题。其他社会议题最好留给其他行业的企业，或更有条件处理这些问题的政府机构。指导企业社会责任的关键检验标准，不是某项事业是否值得支持，而是它能否创造共享价值——也就是既能给社会带来切实利益，又对企业有价值。每家公司都应努力找出自己最有能力协助解决的社会问题。以这种方式处理社会问题，将产生可以自我维持、不依赖政府补贴的解决方案。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The best corporate citizenship initiatives involve far more than simply donating money; they specify clear goals and measure their effectiveness over time. A good example is the manufacturing company GE’s program to adopt public high schools in poorer areas near several of its major US facilities. The company contributes between $250,000 and $1 million over a five-year period to each school. GE’s managers and employees take an active role by working with school administrators to assess needs and tutor students. GE conducted a study of ten schools in the program between 1989 and 1999 and nearly all showed significant improvement in their academic standards. Programs such as this one create goodwill and improve relations with local governments. Their effect is inherently limited, however. No matter how beneficial the program is, it remains incidental to the company’s manufacturing business, and the direct effect on GE’s recruiting and retention is modest.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 最好的企业公民行动远不只是捐款；它们会明确具体目标，并持续衡量成效。一项良好范例，是制造企业 GE 在美国几处主要设施附近的贫困地区结对帮办公立高中的计划。公司在五年内向每所学校投入25万至100万美元。GE 的管理人员和员工会积极参与，与学校管理者一起评估需求，并辅导学生。GE 对1989至1999年间参加该计划的十所学校进行了研究，结果几乎所有学校的学业水平都有显著提高。此类计划能积累好感，并改善与地方政府的关系。然而，其作用本身有限。无论该计划带来多少益处，它对公司的制造业务而言仍只是附带活动，对 GE 招聘和留住员工的直接影响也不大。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Software company Microsoft’s partnership with the American Association of Community Colleges is a good example of a mutually beneficial opportunity. The shortage of information technology workers is a significant constraint on Microsoft’s growth; currently there are 450,000 unfilled IT positions in the US alone. Community colleges with an enrolment of 11.6 million students, representing 45% of all US undergraduates, could provide a solution. Microsoft recognizes, however, that these colleges face special challenges: IT curricula are not standardized, technology used in classrooms is often outdated, and there are no professional development programs to keep teachers up to date. Microsoft’s $50 million, five-year initiative was aimed at all three problems. In addition to contributing money and products, Microsoft sent employee volunteers to colleges to assess needs and contribute to curriculum development. Microsoft’s program benefited many communities while also having a clear impact on company profits.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: A final example is the company Whole Foods Market. Its aim is to sell organic, healthy food to customers who are passionate about food and the environment. The company sources all of its products from local farmers and screens out up to 100 common ingredients that it considers to be unhealthy or environmentally damaging. Furthermore, Whole Foods’ stores are constructed using a majority of recycled materials and the company recently bought renewable wind energy credits equal to 100% of its electricity use. Any spoiled produce is trucked to regional centers for composting and all of their vehicles are being converted to biofuels. In this initiative even the cleaning products used in their stores are environmentally friendly. In short, the entire company’s operations reinforce its ideals, helping to distinguish Whole Foods from its competitors.

source.text: Decision Fatigue

translation.text: 决策疲劳

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: ‘Decision fatigue’ helps explain why ordinarily sensible people avoid making decisions or are easily persuaded to make the wrong decisions when they are tired. Yet few people are conscious of it, and researchers are only beginning to understand why it happens.
headerUnits.translationNormalizedText: “决策疲劳”有助于解释，为什么平时理智的人疲倦时会逃避作决定，或很容易受人劝说而作出错误决定。然而，很少有人意识到这种现象，研究人员也才刚开始了解它为何发生。

source.text: ‘Decision fatigue’ helps explain why ordinarily sensible people avoid making decisions or are easily persuaded to make the wrong decisions when they are tired.

translation.text: “决策疲劳”有助于解释，为什么平时理智的人疲倦时会逃避作决定，或很容易受人劝说而作出错误决定。

source.text: Yet few people are conscious of it, and researchers are only beginning to understand why it happens.

translation.text: 然而，很少有人意识到这种现象，研究人员也才刚开始了解它为何发生。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: No matter how rational people try to be, they can’t make decision after decision without paying a biological price. This ‘decision fatigue’ is different from ordinary physical fatigue. People are not conscious of being tired, but nevertheless they are low on energy. The more choices one makes throughout the day, the harder it becomes for the brain, and eventually it looks for shortcuts: either to act impulsively instead of expending the energy to think through the possible results, or the ultimate energy saver: do nothing. Avoiding a decision often creates bigger problems in the long run, but for the moment it eases the mental strain.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 无论人们多么努力保持理性，也不可能连续作出一个又一个决定，而不付出生理代价。这种“决策疲劳”不同于普通的身体疲劳。人们意识不到自己已经疲倦，但精力确实不足。一个人一天中作出的选择越多，大脑继续选择就越困难，最终会寻找捷径：要么不再耗费精力考虑可能的结果，转而凭冲动行事；要么采用最省力的办法——什么也不做。逃避决定从长远看往往会造成更大问题，但眼下能够减轻心理压力。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Decision fatigue involves a phenomenon called ego depletion, a term coined by social psychologist Roy F. Baumeister. His research demonstrated that there is a finite store of mental stamina for exerting self-control. For example, when people fended off the temptation to eat freshly baked biscuits, they were then less able to resist other temptations. When they tried to resist the urge to cry during a sad movie, afterwards they gave up more quickly on tasks requiring self-discipline, such as working on a geometry puzzle. The experiments confirmed the 19th-century notion of willpower being like a muscle that became tired with use; something which could be conserved by avoiding temptation.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 决策疲劳涉及一种称为自我损耗（ego depletion）的现象，这一术语由社会心理学家 Roy F. Baumeister 提出。他的研究表明，人用来自我控制的心理耐力储备是有限的。例如，人们抵挡住刚出炉饼干的诱惑后，抵抗其他诱惑的能力就会减弱。人们看悲伤电影时努力忍住不哭，之后面对需要自律的任务，例如解几何题，会更快放弃。这些实验印证了19世纪的一种观念：意志力就像肌肉，使用后会疲劳；避开诱惑可以把它保存下来。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Decision fatigue leaves people vulnerable to marketers who know how to time their sales, as Jonathan Levav demonstrated. He visited a tailor to have a suit made for his wedding and began going through the choices of fabric, buttons, and so forth, and when he got through the third pile of fabric samples, Levav recalls, “I couldn’t tell the choices apart anymore. After a while my only response to the tailor became, ‘What do you recommend?’” Levav put the experience to use in an experiment conducted at German car dealerships, where real customers had to choose among four styles of gearshift knobs, 25 configurations of the engine and gearbox, and a palette of 56 colours for the interior. As they started picking features, customers would carefully weigh the choices, but as decision fatigue set in they would start settling for the default option. By manipulating the order of the car buyers’ choices, the researchers found that customers would end up paying more.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 决策疲劳会使人容易受到懂得把握销售时机的营销人员影响，Jonathan Levav 的经历证明了这一点。他去裁缝店为婚礼定做西装，开始逐一选择布料、纽扣等项目。Levav 回忆，当他看完第三叠布料样品时，“我已经分不清这些选项了。过了一会儿，我对裁缝只剩下一种回答：‘你建议选什么？’”Levav 随后把这次经历用于德国汽车经销店的一项实验；真实顾客需要从4种换挡杆旋钮样式、25种发动机和变速箱配置，以及56种内饰颜色中作出选择。刚开始挑选配置时，顾客会仔细权衡各个选项；但随着决策疲劳出现，他们开始接受默认选项。研究人员通过调整购车者作出各项选择的顺序发现，顾客最终会支付更多费用。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Similarly, sweet snacks are featured prominently at cash registers at most supermarkets. With their willpower reduced after shopping, people are especially vulnerable to sweet drinks and snacks. While supermarkets figured this out a long time ago, only recently did researchers discover why. Baumeister’s research team tested the notion that people could build up willpower by first indulging in pleasure. They found that a delicious, thick milkshake strengthened willpower by helping people perform better than expected on their next task. However, the experiment also included a control group who drank a tasteless low-fat dairy beverage. It provided them with no pleasure, yet it produced similar improvements in self-control. Baumeister concluded that even the tasteless drink had worked because the brain, like the rest of the body, derived energy from glucose, the simple sugar manufactured from all kinds of foods, including milk.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 同样，大多数超市都会把甜食摆在收银台的显眼位置。购物之后，人的意志力已经减弱，特别容易受到甜饮料和零食的诱惑。超市很久以前就发现了这一点，但研究人员直到最近才弄清原因。Baumeister 的研究团队检验了一种设想：人们能否先享受愉悦，从而增强意志力。他们发现，一杯香浓可口的奶昔能增强意志力，帮助人们在下一项任务中取得好于预期的表现。不过，实验还设置了一个对照组，让参与者饮用寡淡无味的低脂乳制饮料。它没有带来愉悦感，却同样提升了自我控制。Baumeister 得出结论，即使那杯无味饮料也会发挥作用，因为大脑和身体其他部分一样，会从葡萄糖获得能量；葡萄糖是一种由包括牛奶在内的各种食物转化而来的单糖。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: To establish cause and effect, researchers at Baumeister’s lab tried refueling the brain in experiments involving lemonade mixed either with sugar or with a diet sweetener. The sugary lemonade provided a burst of glucose, the effects of which could be observed immediately in the lab; the sugarless sweeteners tasted similar but did not contain the glucose. Again and again, the sugar restored willpower, but the artificial sweetener had no effect. The glucose would mitigate the ego depletion and sometimes completely reverse it, improving self-control and the quality of decisions: the subjects resisted irrational bias when making choices and, when making financial decisions, they were more likely to choose the better long-term strategy instead of going for a quick payoff.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 为了确定因果关系，Baumeister 实验室的研究人员在实验中尝试为大脑补充能量，让参与者饮用加入糖或低热量代糖的柠檬水。含糖柠檬水会迅速提供葡萄糖，其效果可以立即在实验室中观察到；无糖甜味剂的味道相似，却不含葡萄糖。一次又一次，糖恢复了意志力，人工甜味剂却毫无作用。葡萄糖会缓解自我损耗，有时甚至能将其完全逆转，从而改善自我控制和决策质量：受试者作选择时能抵制非理性偏见；作财务决定时，也更可能选择较好的长期策略，而不是追求眼前回报。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: However, some brain researchers had reservations about the glucose connection. “Todd Heatherton, a pioneer of social neuroscience, believed in ego depletion but didn’t see how this process could be caused simply by variations in glucose levels.” To observe the process, and to see if it could be reversed by glucose, Heatherton’s team recorded images of the brains of 45 people who were on a low-calorie diet as they reacted to pictures of food. Next, these dieters watched a comedy video while forcing themselves to suppress their laughter—thereby draining mental energy and inducing ego depletion. When they were again shown pictures of food, further brain scans revealed more activity in the brain’s reward centre and a decrease in the amygdala, which helps control impulses. The food’s appeal, in other words, registered more strongly while impulse control weakened. What surprised Heatherton was that administering glucose completely reversed the brain changes brought about by ego depletion.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 不过，一些脑科学研究人员对葡萄糖与自我损耗之间的联系持保留态度。社会神经科学先驱 Todd Heatherton 相信自我损耗确实存在，却不明白这一过程怎么可能仅由葡萄糖水平变化引起。为了观察这一过程，并了解葡萄糖能否将其逆转，Heatherton 团队记录了45名低热量饮食者看到食物图片时的脑部影像。接着，这些节食者观看一段喜剧视频，同时强迫自己忍住不笑，从而消耗心理能量并引发自我损耗。再次向他们展示食物图片时，进一步的脑扫描显示，大脑奖赏中心的活动增强，而有助于控制冲动的杏仁核活动下降。换言之，食物的吸引力在脑中反应得更强烈，冲动控制却变弱了。让 Heatherton 惊讶的是，补充葡萄糖完全逆转了自我损耗造成的脑部变化。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: “Good decision-making is not a trait of the person,” Baumeister says. “It’s a state that fluctuates.” His studies show that people with the best self-control are the ones who avoid temptations, and who establish habits that eliminate the mental effort of making choices. Instead of counting on willpower all day, they conserve it so that it’s available for important decisions. “Even the wisest people won’t make good choices when they’re not rested and their glucose is low,” Baumeister notes. If a decision must be made late in the afternoon or in the evening, they know not to do it on an empty stomach. The best decision-makers, according to Baumeister, “are the ones who know when not to trust themselves.”
blocks.translationNormalizedText: Baumeister 说：“善于决策并不是一个人的固定特质，而是一种会波动的状态。”他的研究显示，自我控制能力最好的人会避开诱惑，并建立能够免除选择时心理消耗的习惯。他们不会指望意志力支撑一整天，而是把它保存下来，留给重要决定。Baumeister 指出：“即使最明智的人在没有休息好、葡萄糖又偏低时，也作不出好选择。”如果必须在下午晚些时候或晚上作决定，他们知道不能空着肚子去做。Baumeister 认为，最优秀的决策者“是那些知道什么时候不能相信自己的人”。

source.text: A review of the classical and neoclassical theories of organisational structures

translation.text: 回顾关于组织结构的古典理论与新古典理论

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Determining the ‘best’ type of organisational structure for a particular situation has long been an important task for managers in all types of organisations. All structures have advantages and disadvantages and managers face the challenge of developing the most appropriate design for changing circumstances.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 长期以来，为特定情境确定“最佳”组织结构类型，一直是各类组织管理者的一项重要任务。所有结构都有优缺点，管理者面临的挑战，是针对不断变化的情况制定最合适的设计。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The Classical Approach
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 古典方法

source.text: The Classical Approach

translation.text: 古典方法

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Early management writers attempted to approach organisational design using a set of principles that would make an organisational structure perform efficiently in most situations, independent of external conditions and internal objectives. The sociologist Max Weber and management writers Frederick Taylor and Henri Fayol were major contributors to this so-called classical approach. They believed that the most efficient organisations had a legalised, formal and hierarchical structure called a ‘bureaucracy’. Members of the organisation were guided by a sense of duty to the organisation and by a set of rational rules and regulations. According to Weber, such organisations were characterised by the specialisation of tasks, appointment by merit, and an impersonal climate.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 早期管理学作者试图用一套原则来处理组织设计，使组织结构在大多数情境下都能高效运作，不受外部条件和内部目标影响。社会学家 Max Weber 以及管理学作者 Frederick Taylor 和 Henri Fayol，是这种所谓古典方法的主要贡献者。他们认为，最高效的组织拥有一种具有法定地位、正式且层级分明的结构，称为“官僚制”。组织成员受对组织的责任感以及一套理性规章制度引导。Weber 认为，这类组织的特点是任务专业化、按才能任用人员，以及非人格化的组织氛围。

source.text: Early management writers attempted to approach organisational design using a set of principles that would make an organisational structure perform efficiently in most situations, independent of external conditions and internal objectives.

translation.text: 早期管理学作者试图用一套原则来处理组织设计，使组织结构在大多数情境下都能高效运作，不受外部条件和内部目标影响。

source.text: The sociologist Max Weber and management writers Frederick Taylor and Henri Fayol were major contributors to this so-called classical approach.

translation.text: 社会学家 Max Weber 以及管理学作者 Frederick Taylor 和 Henri Fayol，是这种所谓古典方法的主要贡献者。

source.text: They believed that the most efficient organisations had a legalised, formal and hierarchical structure called a ‘bureaucracy’.

translation.text: 他们认为，最高效的组织拥有一种具有法定地位、正式且层级分明的结构，称为“官僚制”。

source.text: Members of the organisation were guided by a sense of duty to the organisation and by a set of rational rules and regulations.

translation.text: 组织成员受对组织的责任感以及一套理性规章制度引导。

source.text: According to Weber, such organisations were characterised by the specialisation of tasks, appointment by merit, and an impersonal climate.

translation.text: Weber 认为，这类组织的特点是任务专业化、按才能任用人员，以及非人格化的组织氛围。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Today the word ‘bureaucracy’ sometimes has negative connotations. Early management writers, however, commended bureaucracy as an organisational design for its rationality, rules for decision-making, clear chain of command, and promotion of people based on ability and experience, rather than favouritism or whim. Weber also believed that clearly specified authority and responsibility made performance easier to evaluate and reward.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 如今，“官僚制”一词有时带有负面含义。然而，早期管理学作者推崇官僚制这一组织设计，因为它具有理性基础、明确的决策规则和清晰的指挥链，并依据能力和经验而不是徇私或随意决定人员晋升。Weber 还认为，权力和责任得到明确规定后，绩效更容易评估和奖励。

translation.text: 如今，“官僚制”一词有时带有负面含义。

source.text: Early management writers, however, commended bureaucracy as an organisational design for its rationality, rules for decision-making, clear chain of command, and promotion of people based on ability and experience, rather than favouritism or whim.

translation.text: 然而，早期管理学作者推崇官僚制这一组织设计，因为它具有理性基础、明确的决策规则和清晰的指挥链，并依据能力和经验而不是徇私或随意决定人员晋升。

source.text: Weber also believed that clearly specified authority and responsibility made performance easier to evaluate and reward.

translation.text: Weber 还认为，权力和责任得到明确规定后，绩效更容易评估和奖励。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Criticism of the Classical Approach
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 对古典方法的批评

source.text: Criticism of the Classical Approach

translation.text: 对古典方法的批评

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Weber, Taylor and Fayol developed their theories when organisations that resembled this bureaucratic model were modern and efficient. It became evident, however, that some of the major advantages of the bureaucratic structure could become disadvantages if the theory were applied dogmatically. For example, the safeguards against favouritism could be rigidly imposed by adhering excessively to rules, resulting in both managers and subordinates becoming depersonalised.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: Weber、Taylor 和 Fayol 提出理论时，与这种官僚制模式相似的组织既现代又高效。然而，人们逐渐发现，如果教条地运用这一理论，官僚结构的一些主要优势可能转变为劣势。例如，为防止徇私而设置的保障措施，可能因过度遵守规则而被僵化执行，结果是管理者和下属都变得缺乏个性与人情。

source.text: Weber, Taylor and Fayol developed their theories when organisations that resembled this bureaucratic model were modern and efficient.

translation.text: Weber、Taylor 和 Fayol 提出理论时，与这种官僚制模式相似的组织既现代又高效。

source.text: It became evident, however, that some of the major advantages of the bureaucratic structure could become disadvantages if the theory were applied dogmatically.

translation.text: 然而，人们逐渐发现，如果教条地运用这一理论，官僚结构的一些主要优势可能转变为劣势。

source.text: For example, the safeguards against favouritism could be rigidly imposed by adhering excessively to rules, resulting in both managers and subordinates becoming depersonalised.

translation.text: 例如，为防止徇私而设置的保障措施，可能因过度遵守规则而被僵化执行，结果是管理者和下属都变得缺乏个性与人情。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The classical approach has been criticised from two major perspectives. First, the theory may not have a basis in reality. Have organisations like those described by Weber and the others ever existed? Second, it claims that organisations designed and managed according to bureaucratic principles will enjoy the predicted benefits. But critics argue that the world no longer fits the assumptions in Weber’s model (if it ever did), and so a bureaucracy might not yield beneficial results.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 人们主要从两个角度批评古典方法。第一，这套理论可能没有现实基础。Weber 等人所描述的那类组织，是否真的存在过？第二，它声称，依照官僚制原则设计和管理的组织，将获得理论预测的好处。但批评者指出，现实世界已经不再符合 Weber 模型的假设——如果它过去曾经符合的话——因此，官僚制未必会带来有益结果。

source.text: The classical approach has been criticised from two major perspectives.

translation.text: 人们主要从两个角度批评古典方法。

source.text: First, the theory may not have a basis in reality.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Early human relations researchers and behavioural scientists attempted to deal with the major inadequacy of the classical bureaucratic model: neglect of the human element. They argued that an industrial organisation has two objectives: economic effectiveness and employee satisfaction. They also wrote that the bureaucratic structure could be improved by permitting more subordinate participation in decision-making. Because these researchers tried to improve, and not reject, the classical model, they are sometimes called neoclassical theorists and include Douglas McGregor, Chris Argyris and Rensis Likert.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 早期人际关系研究者和行为科学家试图解决古典官僚制模式的一项主要缺陷：忽视人的因素。他们认为，工业组织有两个目标，即经济效益和员工满意度。他们还提出，允许下属更多参与决策，可以改善官僚结构。这些研究者试图改进而不是否定古典模式，因此有时被称为新古典理论家，其中包括 Douglas McGregor、Chris Argyris 和 Rensis Likert。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The Neoclassical Approach
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 新古典方法

source.text: The Neoclassical Approach

translation.text: 新古典方法

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: McGregor believed that the vertical division of labour that characterised bureaucratic organisations was derived from negative and false assumptions about workers which he called Theory X. Managers assume lower-level employees lack ambition and need orders to work effectively. The rigid formal hierarchy is designed to maintain managers’ power over subordinates. Decision-making takes place at upper levels of management while the decisions are carried out by people at lower levels. McGregor argued that organisations based instead on Theory Y assumptions use their members’ potential. Theory Y assumes that most people find work satisfying, commit themselves willingly to organisational goals and seek responsibility. Members have more independence than in bureaucratic organisations and lower-level participation in decision-making is encouraged.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: McGregor 认为，官僚制组织所特有的纵向分工，源于对劳动者消极且错误的假设，他把这些假设称为X理论。管理者假定，基层员工缺乏抱负，需要接到命令才能有效工作。僵化的正式层级结构，是为了维持管理者对下属的权力。决策在管理层上层作出，再由下层人员执行。McGregor 指出，若组织转而以Y理论的假设为基础，就能利用成员的潜力。Y理论假定，大多数人认为工作令人满意，会自愿投入组织目标，并主动承担责任。与官僚制组织相比，这类组织的成员拥有更大自主权，基层员工参与决策也受到鼓励。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Argyris was concerned that managers in bureaucratic organisations had near-total responsibility for controlling their subordinates’ work. He argued that managerial domination makes subordinates passive and dependent, and decreases their sense of responsibility and self-control. Argyris argued for an alternative organisational design that acknowledged human needs and feelings, and increased workers’ satisfaction. Like McGregor, he favoured giving subordinates more independence and decision-making power to create a more informal organisational culture.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: Argyris 关注的是，官僚制组织中的管理者几乎完全负责控制下属的工作。他认为，管理者的支配会使下属变得被动、依赖他人，并削弱其责任感和自我控制。Argyris 主张采用另一种组织设计，承认人的需求和感受，并提高劳动者满意度。他与 McGregor 一样，赞成给予下属更大自主权和决策权，从而营造较为非正式的组织文化。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Likert shared the perspectives of McGregor and Argyris. In his research, he found that managers who encouraged their subordinates could motivate them more than traditional authoritarian managers. Likert based his model of four possible systems on these findings. In System 1, power and authority are distributed strictly according to the classical management subordinate relationship: a manager gives orders to lower-level members. In System 4 organisations, by contrast, there is extensive participation in decision-making and problem-solving groups. Some individuals in each group also belong to other work groups to ensure communication between them. System 4 represents Likert’s view of an ideal organisation.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: Likert 与 McGregor 和 Argyris 持相似观点。他在研究中发现，鼓励下属的管理者，比传统的专制型管理者更能激励员工。Likert 根据这些发现建立了一个包含四种可能体系的模型。在体系1中，权力和权限严格按照古典管理中的上下级关系分配：管理者向基层成员下达命令。相比之下，在体系4的组织中，员工广泛参与决策，并参加解决问题的小组。每个小组中还有一些人同时属于其他工作组，以确保各组之间能够沟通。体系4代表了 Likert 心目中的理想组织。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Criticisms of the Neoclassical Approach
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 对新古典方法的批评

source.text: Criticisms of the Neoclassical Approach

translation.text: 对新古典方法的批评

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The neoclassical approach to organisational design compensates for limitations in the traditional classical model, but it has also been criticised. First, the neoclassicists share the classical assumption that there is one best way to design an organisation. They overlook environmental, technological, and other variables that might affect an organisation’s design, and overemphasise psychological and behavioural variables. Second, Theories X and Y oversimplify human motivation and neglect individual differences. Not everyone is motivated by the non-monetary aspects of work, nor is all work satisfying. Finally, the coordination of work groups to achieve organisational goals may be more difficult than the neoclassicists suggest, particularly when the objectives of lower-level employees are not consistent with those of upper-level managers.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 新古典组织设计方法弥补了传统古典模式的局限，但它也受到批评。第一，新古典理论家与古典理论家一样，假定组织设计存在一种最佳方式。他们忽视了可能影响组织设计的环境、技术和其他变量，却过分强调心理和行为变量。第二，X理论和Y理论把人的动机过度简单化，也忽视个体差异。并非所有人都会受到工作中非金钱因素的激励，也不是所有工作都能令人满意。最后，为实现组织目标而协调各工作组，可能比新古典理论家所说的更加困难；当基层员工的目标与高层管理者不一致时，尤其如此。

source.text: The neoclassical approach to organisational design compensates for limitations in the traditional classical model, but it has also been criticised.

source.text: Finally, the coordination of work groups to achieve organisational goals may be more difficult than the neoclassicists suggest, particularly when the objectives of lower-level employees are not consistent with those of upper-level managers.

source.text: Growing more for less

translation.text: 少投入，多收获

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: Satellite technology is helping farmers boost crop yields

source.text: Satellite technology is helping farmers boost crop yields

translation.text: 卫星技术正在帮助农民提高作物产量

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: For farmers, working out the optimal amount of seed, fertiliser, pesticide and water to scatter on a field can make, or break, the subsequent harvest. Regular laboratory analyses of soil and plant samples from various parts of the field can help – but such expertise is costly, and often unavailable. However, a new and cheaper method of doing this analysis is now on offer. Precise prescriptions for growing crops can be obtained quickly, and less expensively, by calculating the amount of electromagnetic radiation reflected from agricultural land. The data is collected by orbiting satellites.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 对农民来说，算出一块田地应播撒多少种子、肥料、农药和水才最合适，可能决定随后收成的成败。定期对田地不同区域的土壤和植物样本进行实验室分析会有所帮助，但这类专业服务费用高昂，而且往往无法获得。不过，现在已经有一种新的、更便宜的分析方法。通过计算农田反射的电磁辐射量，可以迅速以较低成本获得种植作物的精确方案，而相关数据由轨道卫星收集。

translation.text: 对农民来说，算出一块田地应播撒多少种子、肥料、农药和水才最合适，可能决定随后收成的成败。

source.text: Regular laboratory analyses of soil and plant samples from various parts of the field can help – but such expertise is costly, and often unavailable.

translation.text: 定期对田地不同区域的土壤和植物样本进行实验室分析会有所帮助，但这类专业服务费用高昂，而且往往无法获得。

source.text: However, a new and cheaper method of doing this analysis is now on offer.

translation.text: 不过，现在已经有一种新的、更便宜的分析方法。

source.text: Precise prescriptions for growing crops can be obtained quickly, and less expensively, by calculating the amount of electromagnetic radiation reflected from agricultural land. The data is collected by orbiting satellites.

translation.text: 通过计算农田反射的电磁辐射量，可以迅速以较低成本获得种植作物的精确方案，而相关数据由轨道卫星收集。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Examining the wavelength of the radiation that is reflected can reveal, with surprising precision, the properties of the soil, the quantity of crop being grown, and the levels in those crops of chlorophyll*, various minerals, moisture and other indicators of their quality. If recent and forecast weather data is added to the mix, detailed maps can be produced indicating exactly how, where and when crops should be grown. The service usually costs less than US$15 per hectare for a handful of readings a year, and can increase yields by as much as 10%.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Such precision farming using satellite-based intelligence is a relatively new technique. Even so, it is catching on quickly. Five times a year, for example, a French cereal-growers’ co-operative called Sevépi purchases satellite data and makes it available to its members in the form of maps of their fields, divided into three or four colour-coded zones per hectare. For each zone, one of about 50 fertiliser formulas is recommended. On top of this, if the wheat in the field has already grown quite high early in the season, and heavy showers are expected, an appropriate dose of growth regulator is recommended for each zone. (Long, fragile stems break more easily in downpours.) Then, farm vehicles equipped with global-positioning system locators automatically mix and apply the prescribed dose to each area.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 这种利用卫星信息的精准农业是一项较新的技术。即便如此，它仍在迅速普及。例如，一家名为 Sevépi 的法国谷物种植者合作社每年购买五次卫星数据，再以田地图的形式提供给成员；图上每公顷被划分为三到四个用颜色标示的区域。每个区域会从大约50种肥料配方中获得一种推荐方案。此外，如果田里的小麦在生长季初已经长得很高，并预计会有强降雨，每个区域还会得到适量生长调节剂的使用建议。（细长脆弱的茎秆在暴雨中更容易折断。）随后，配备全球定位系统定位器的农用车辆会自动混合规定剂量，并施用于各个区域。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: France is the pioneer in this sort of surveillance. More farmland is analysed by satellite there than in any other country, according to Infoterra (a subsidiary of EADS Astrium), the firm that is France’s largest provider of such information, supplying data to companies such as Sevépi. Moreover, Henri Douche, head of Infoterra’s agriculture sales in Toulouse, reckons the amount of monitored farmland will increase as weather patterns change and farmers can no longer rely on the past as a guide to the future. When confounded by the yield variations that these new weather patterns will bring, even farmers who are afraid of new technology will sign up, he says.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 法国是这类监测的先驱。法国最大的此类信息供应商 Infoterra 是 EADS Astrium 的一家子公司，也向 Sevépi 等公司提供数据。据该公司称，法国接受卫星分析的农田面积超过其他任何国家。此外，Infoterra 图卢兹农业销售负责人 Henri Douche 估计，随着天气模式改变，农民再也不能以过去指导未来，受监测的农田面积还会增加。他说，当新天气模式带来的产量波动使农民无所适从时，即使害怕新技术的农民也会登记使用这项服务。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Inexpensive data on the productivity of land is advantageous to governments, too. Areas where fertilisers and pesticides are being applied excessively can be pinpointed, studied and regulated by environmental and land-use agencies. Guy Lafond, an agronomist with Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada, a government agency, says the satellite data it purchases is proving useful for the study of fields with declining productivity in the province of Saskatchewan. Overkill with nitrate fertilisers (which are also a source of greenhouse gases) appears partly responsible. And according to RapidEye, a German satellite operator, insurance companies are also studying satellite data with a view to selling insurance policies to governments of famine-prone countries that might be threatened by crop failure.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 廉价的土地生产力数据对政府也有好处。环境和土地使用机构可以准确找出肥料和农药使用过量的地区，对其进行研究和监管。加拿大农业及农业食品部是一个政府机构，该机构的农学家 Guy Lafond 表示，该机构购买的卫星数据已证明有助于研究萨斯喀彻温省生产力下降的农田。过量使用硝酸盐肥料似乎要负部分责任，而这类肥料也是温室气体的来源。据德国卫星运营商 RapidEye 称，保险公司也在研究卫星数据，希望向可能受作物歉收威胁的饥荒高风险国家政府出售保险。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In March, RapidEye began selling data that helps forecast harvests. ‘Too often, farmers limit productivity by managing fields uniformly,’ says Fredrick Jung-Rothenhaüsler, head of product development at the firm’s headquarters in Brandenburg an der Havel. ‘Our satellites are the first commercial satellites to include the Red-Edge band of the light spectrum, which is sensitive to changes in chlorophyll content. More research will be necessary to realise the full potential of the Red-Edge band. However, this band can assist in monitoring vegetation health, improving species separation and also help in measuring protein and nitrogen content in biomass.’ The company’s data, which comes from both Europe and the Americas, breaks field productivity down into patches just five metres square.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 3月，RapidEye 开始销售有助于预测收成的数据。Fredrick Jung-Rothenhaüsler 是 RapidEye 位于哈弗尔河畔勃兰登堡的总部产品开发负责人，他说：“农民经常对整片田地采用完全相同的管理方式，因而限制了生产力。我们的卫星是首批把光谱红边波段（Red-Edge band）纳入其中的商业卫星；该波段能敏锐反映叶绿素含量变化。要充分发挥红边波段的潜力，还需要开展更多研究。不过，这一波段可以帮助监测植被健康、提高物种区分能力，也能协助测量生物质中的蛋白质和氮含量。”该公司的数据来自欧洲和美洲，能把田地生产力细分到仅五米见方的地块。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The advantages that satellite technology provides in terms of precision farming do not have to be restricted to rich countries. In Africa, where many soils have become badly depleted of nutrients, better fertiliser management would greatly improve the situation. As a consequence, the charitable trust World Agroforestry Centre, in the city of Nairobi, in Kenya, has begun to build up a catalogue of the radiation patterns derived from around 100,000 samples of African soils. The information is the key to understanding the potential of these soils to be more agriculturally productive. Once passed on to the International Centre for Tropical Agriculture, based in Colombia, South America, it is intended that the information be used to build a database called the ‘Digital Soil Map’. When ready, this will provide farmers with free forecasts, developed with regularly updated satellite imagery, across farmland in a number of countries in Africa. This is information which will almost certainly assist in improving crop yields. For a hunger-ravaged continent, that is good news indeed.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 卫星技术在精准农业方面提供的优势不必只限于富裕国家。在非洲，许多土壤的养分已经严重耗竭，更好地管理肥料将大幅改善情况。因此，位于肯尼亚内罗毕的慈善信托机构世界农用林业中心，已经开始建立一份辐射模式目录；这些模式来自约10万个非洲土壤样本。相关信息是了解这些土壤提高农业生产力潜力的关键。信息传给位于南美洲哥伦比亚的国际热带农业中心后，计划用来建立一个名为“数字土壤地图”的数据库。数据库完成后，将结合定期更新的卫星图像，为非洲多个国家的农民免费提供农田预测信息。这些信息几乎肯定有助于提高作物产量。对于一片饱受饥饿折磨的大陆来说，这的确是好消息。

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: The popularity of herbs and plants as medicines could be good for New Zealand

source.text: The popularity of herbs and plants as medicines could be good for New Zealand

translation.text: 草药和植物作为药物受到欢迎，这可能给新西兰带来好处

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: There is an age-old practice of harvesting plants and herbs in their natural environment for use as medicines. And today there is huge potential for New Zealand to develop a herb industry based on the excellent growing conditions and expertise there, according to Phil Rasmussen, a pharmacist and medical herbalist. Take arnica, for example, a popular pharmaceutical herb used to treat bruises and joint problems. Traditionally collected by Romany communities in Europe, it is now in high demand worldwide as interest develops in the capabilities of the small alpine plant. A 2008 report for the Plant and Food Research organisation concluded that New Zealand has a good opportunity to cultivate arnica flowers and roots for the international markets. However, the initiative was stopped in its tracks when the government abruptly halted funding for the research programme. It was an unjustified move, according to agronomist Malcolm Douglas, based on a number of inaccurate views about weed invasion.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 在自然环境中采集植物和草药用作药物，是一种由来已久的做法。药剂师兼医学草药师 Phil Rasmussen 表示，凭借优越的种植条件和当地专业知识，如今新西兰开发草药产业的潜力巨大。以常用药用植物山金车（arnica）为例，它可用于治疗瘀伤和关节问题。传统上，这种植物由欧洲的罗姆人群体采集；随着人们越来越关注这种小型高山植物的功效，如今全球需求旺盛。植物与食品研究机构2008年的一份报告认为，新西兰很有机会种植山金车的花和根，供应国际市场。然而，政府突然停止为研究计划提供资金，这项行动随即夭折。农学家 Malcolm Douglas 认为，这一决定缺乏依据，是建立在对杂草入侵的一些错误看法之上。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The history of herbal medicines in New Zealand has long featured disagreements of this sort. For the early Maori people – the original inhabitants of New Zealand – the forest was well stocked with edible plants that were an obvious source of nutrition, but that were taken for the relief of pain as well. While the earliest European doctors in New Zealand relied on imported dried herbs, many were keen to include native plants in their practices: in his book published in 1891, herbalist James Neil described manuka and koromiko as among New Zealand’s most valuable herbs. Despite its popularity among some, however, herbalism continued to have its detractors. In 1907 Neil, president of the then very young New Zealand Association of Medical Herbalists (NZAMH), petitioned parliament for legal status for herbalists, but he was unsuccessful. The Evening Post newspaper perhaps summed up the opposing position by claiming that herbalism ‘is obsolete’.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In fact, traditional Maori medicine faced a more determined challenge. In 1908 the government passed a controversial law that had the effect of restricting traditional herbal practice, or pushing it underground. Then for a brief period in the mid-20th century, herbal medicine was largely ignored, shunned by the majority of the medical profession, and absent from medical school curricula. But a centuries-old tradition was not going to disappear so easily, and in the 1980s the NZAMH was revived, and it became possible to complete a course in herbal medicine at several polytechnics around the country. However, the problem remained of how to connect the culture of plant-based medicine with conventional scientific thinking in order to promote herbal use within the general population. For many years, the limited evidence there was that herbal medicines worked was undermined by lack of interest among general practitioners and within the scientific community.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Today, the ideas of herbalists in the 1980s – eat a varied diet, include lots of fresh fruit and vegetables, recognise stress – are completely accepted by the medical establishment and widely practised in society as a whole. Natural health products are big sellers in pharmacies, and global pharmaceutical companies are buying up natural supplement brands or developing their own. What’s more, according to Rasmussen, robust clinical trials show that herbal medicine is generally safe – safer than most drugs. ‘It doesn’t do everything,’ he says, ‘but there’s a lot it does do, particularly in terms of preventative health care.’ One significant issue for today’s export-oriented herbal medicine producers is the question of how to guarantee standards for consumers in different countries. In other words, there is the need for some form of globally recognised system of documentation. Rasmussen’s range of extracts are produced under the Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) scheme, which is respected around the world. So too is the range produced by Sandra Clair, who says that such assurance is expensive but necessary if you want to export herbal remedies to the rest of the world. Moves to launch a joint Australia–New Zealand agency to regulate herbal remedies under a single, streamlined licensing process have recently been revived, after being abandoned in 2007 through lack of support in parliament.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 如今，20世纪80年代草药师提出的观念——饮食多样化、多吃新鲜水果和蔬菜、认识压力的影响——已经被医学界完全接受，也在整个社会广泛实践。天然健康产品在药店十分畅销，全球制药公司正在收购天然补充剂品牌，或开发自己的品牌。此外，Rasmussen 表示，严格的临床试验显示，草药通常是安全的，甚至比大多数药物更安全。他说：“它并非无所不能，但确实有许多作用，尤其是在预防性保健方面。”对如今面向出口的草药生产商来说，一个重要问题是如何向不同国家的消费者保证标准。换言之，需要某种获得全球认可的文件记录体系。Rasmussen 的系列提取物依照良好生产规范（Good Manufacturing Practice，GMP）体系生产，该体系在全球受到认可。Sandra Clair 的系列产品也是如此。她表示，这类质量保证费用高昂，却是向世界其他地区出口草药所必需的。此前因议会支持不足而于2007年放弃的一项计划，近来再次启动；该计划拟成立澳大利亚与新西兰联合机构，通过一套统一、精简的许可流程监管草药。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: There are those in the industry who support further regulation still. According to Rasmussen, some herbs should require a prescription from a suitably qualified medical herbalist or doctor. For example, consumers shouldn’t be able to go to their local supermarket and buy St John’s Wort, according to Rasmussen, because it can interact in harmful ways with at least ten pharmaceutical drugs. Isla Burgess, who is part of the International Research Group for the Conservation of Medicinal Plants, agrees that tighter regulation is necessary, but for a different reason. ‘More than 400,000 tonnes of medicinal and aromatic plants are traded in the world each year,’ says Burgess. ‘The great majority of these are harvested from the wild, so they each have an impact on their local ecosystem.’ She gives the example of elm trees in the USA, ringbarked and stripped for the growing market for a product called ‘slippery elm’: this endangered tree should be protected. But others argue that more regulation would be prohibitively expensive for all but the largest manufacturers – a change, cautions Clair, that would probably put some local companies out of business. So, for the time being at least, it seems that the topic of herbal medicines will continue to provoke debate.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 业内还有人支持进一步加强监管。Rasmussen 认为，一些草药应当凭具备相应资质的医学草药师或医生所开处方购买。例如，他认为消费者不应能在当地超市买到圣约翰草（St John’s Wort），因为它会与至少十种药物发生有害相互作用。国际药用植物保护研究小组成员 Isla Burgess 也认为有必要加强监管，但理由不同。Burgess 说：“全球每年交易的药用和芳香植物超过40万吨，其中绝大多数采自野外，因此每一种都会影响当地生态系统。”她以美国榆树为例：为了满足一种名为“滑榆”（slippery elm）的产品不断增长的市场需求，人们对榆树进行环状剥皮，剥取树皮；这种濒危树木应当受到保护。但另一些人指出，更严格的监管费用会高得令人无法承受，只有最大的制造商例外。Clair 警告说，这项变化很可能让一些本地企业倒闭。因此，至少在目前看来，草药这一话题仍将继续引发争论。

passages.title: How do plants talk to each other

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: How do plants talk to each other

source.text: How do plants talk to each other

translation.text: 植物如何相互交流

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: Research shows that plants communicate and interact with each other in surprisingly subtle and sophisticated ways.
headerUnits.translationNormalizedText: 研究表明，植物彼此沟通和互动的方式细微而复杂，出人意料。

source.text: Research shows that plants communicate and interact with each other in surprisingly subtle and sophisticated ways.

translation.text: 研究表明，植物彼此沟通和互动的方式细微而复杂，出人意料。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In 1983, plant scientists Jack Schultz and Ian Baldwin reported that the leaves of young maple trees increased their defense systems when exposed to maples that had been damaged by plant-eating (herbivorous) insects. The injured trees, they suggested, were alerting neighbors to the presence of a predator by releasing chemical signals into the air. But the plant research community did not accept this. The results were difficult to replicate, critics pointed out. Many also questioned how it could be evolutionarily stable if it benefited neighboring plants but not the plant releasing the signal. By the late 1980s, most ecologists felt that Schultz and Baldwin’s ideas had been discredited.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 1983年，植物科学家 Jack Schultz 和 Ian Baldwin 报告称，幼枫树接触到遭植食性昆虫破坏的枫树后，叶片会增强防御系统。他们推测，受损的树木会向空气中释放化学信号，提醒邻近树木有捕食者出现。然而，植物研究界并不接受这一观点。批评者指出，实验结果难以重复。许多人还质疑，如果这一行为只让邻近植物受益，却不给释放信号的植物带来好处，它如何能在进化中稳定存在。到20世纪80年代末，大多数生态学家都认为 Schultz 和 Baldwin 的观点已站不住脚。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: A decade later, however, a number of more carefully designed experiments began to yield convincing indications to the contrary. In 2000, evolutionary ecologist Richard Karban showed that wild tobacco plants became resistant to herbivores when grown in close proximity to sagebrush plants whose leaves had been damaged by cutting. This change appeared to be in response to chemicals – known as volatile organic compounds or VOCs – released by the sagebrush plants. Other researchers soon reported similar VOC-induced defense responses in several other plants, including lima bean, broad bean, barley, and corn. And in 2006, Karban showed that VOCs released by damaged sagebrush induce herbivore resistance in plants growing at distances of up to 60 cm, well within the range of sagebrush neighbors in nature.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 然而十年后，一批设计更严谨的实验开始得出令人信服的相反证据。2000年，进化生态学家 Richard Karban 发现，野生烟草若生长在叶片被剪伤的蒿属植物附近，就会产生抵御植食动物的能力。这一变化似乎是由蒿属植物释放的化学物质引起的，这类物质称为挥发性有机化合物（VOCs）。其他研究人员很快也在多种植物中发现了由挥发性有机化合物诱发的类似防御反应，包括利马豆、蚕豆、大麦和玉米。2006年，Karban 进一步证明，受损蒿属植物释放的挥发性有机化合物，能使最远60厘米外的植物产生抗植食动物能力；在自然环境中，这完全处于邻近蒿属植物之间通常的距离范围内。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: But the question still remains: ‘Why should a plant waste valuable resources on a function which has no obvious advantage for it?’ One hypothesis is that external communication channels are merely an extension of within-plant signaling. In sagebrush, lima bean, and poplar, VOCs released from damaged parts of a plant induce resistance in intact sections of the same plant, suggesting that each individual plant uses the signals to coordinate its own physiological responses to protect itself. Karban agrees, saying: ‘The interplant signaling we see may be a result of plants co-opting that process.’ Alternatively, VOC-based signaling between plants may have been favored because it enhances the ‘extended fitness’ of the sender by aiding related plants of the same species: a strategy known as kin selection.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 但问题依然存在：“植物为什么要把宝贵资源浪费在一种对自身没有明显好处的功能上？”一种假说认为，对外交流渠道不过是植物内部信号传递的延伸。在蒿属植物、利马豆和杨树中，植物受损部位释放的挥发性有机化合物，会使同一株植物未受损的部位产生抗性。这说明每株植物都在利用这些信号协调自身的生理反应，从而保护自己。Karban 也认同这一点。他说：“我们所看到的植物间信号传递，可能正是植物借用了这套机制的结果。”另一种可能是，基于挥发性有机化合物的植物间信号之所以在进化中受到青睐，是因为它能帮助同种的亲缘植物，从而提高信号释放者的“扩展适合度”；这种策略称为亲缘选择。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Over the past few years, a team led by Ariel Novoplansky of Ben-Gurion University of the Negev in Israel seems to have found proof that distress signals can be passed through the plants’ roots. They planted garden pea plants in rows and subjected the first in each row to conditions similar to those experienced in a drought. They then evaluated the response by measuring the microscopic holes on leaves, known as pores, which react when there is a shortage of water. After fifteen minutes, the stressed plant was seen to be closing its pores, followed by all of its neighbors, one by one. Importantly, in a control setup where root contact between neighboring plants was blocked, pores stayed open. Meanwhile, David Johnson’s team at the University of Aberdeen in Scotland have been studying the labyrinths of hair-like fungi that occur around the roots of most plants. These fungi are involved in an important two-way relationship: in exchange for sugars, they provide plants with much-needed phosphorus and nitrogen. Research in which broad bean plants were infested with aphids – small herbivorous insects – revealed that these networks also served as a channel for warning neighboring plants of the infestation.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 过去几年，以色列内盖夫本-古里安大学 Ariel Novoplansky 领导的团队，似乎找到了植物根部能够传递胁迫信号的证据。他们把豌豆植株种成一排排，并让每排第一株承受类似干旱的环境。随后，研究人员测量叶片上在缺水时会作出反应的微小孔洞，也就是气孔，以评估植株的反应。十五分钟后，受胁迫植株开始关闭气孔，接着邻近植株也一株接一株地关闭气孔。重要的是，在阻断相邻植株根部接触的对照条件下，气孔仍然张开。与此同时，苏格兰阿伯丁大学 David Johnson 的团队一直在研究大多数植物根部周围由毛发状真菌形成的迷宫。这些真菌参与一种重要的双向关系：它们以获得糖分为交换，为植物提供急需的磷和氮。研究人员让蚕豆遭到蚜虫这种小型植食性昆虫侵袭，结果发现，这些真菌网络也会成为向邻近植物发出虫害警报的渠道。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Monica Gagliano of the University of Western Australia believes that plants may even use sounds to alert their neighbors. In one study, she demonstrated that chili plants growing next to fennel plants developed more quickly than seedlings grown with other chili plants. Gagliano and her colleagues suspect the chili plants were compensating for the presence of the fennel, which is known to release chemicals that inhibit the growth of other plants. Remarkably, however, when plant communication pathways – airborne volatiles, root contact, and common fungal networks – were blocked, the results begged for an alternative explanation. ‘We think this other channel of communication might be acoustic,’ says Gagliano. But behavioral ecologist Carel ten Cate of the University of Leiden in the Netherlands points out that taking advantage of such benefits would require sensory mechanisms yet to be described in plants. Despite widespread skepticism, Gagliano has received some encouragement. Richard Karban, for example, is cautiously enthusiastic. ‘Whether or not the explanation she favors is the right one,’ he says, ‘I think that she’s gotten results that, as a field, we need to come to grips with.’
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 西澳大利亚大学的 Monica Gagliano 认为，植物甚至可能用声音向邻近植物示警。在一项研究中，她证明，生长在茴香旁的辣椒植株，比与其他辣椒一起生长的幼苗发育得更快。Gagliano 和同事推测，辣椒是在补偿茴香存在所带来的影响，因为已知茴香会释放抑制其他植物生长的化学物质。但值得注意的是，当植物的各种交流路径——空气传播的挥发物、根部接触和共享真菌网络——都被阻断后，实验结果显然需要另一种解释。Gagliano 说：“我们认为，这另一条交流渠道可能是声音。”不过，荷兰莱顿大学的行为生态学家 Carel ten Cate 指出，要利用这种声音带来的好处，植物必须具备某种尚未得到描述的感知机制。尽管外界普遍怀疑，Gagliano 也得到了一些鼓励。例如，Richard Karban 对此持谨慎乐观态度。他说：“无论她所倾向的解释是否正确，我认为她得到的结果，是我们整个领域都必须认真面对的。”

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Researchers believe that knowledge of this phenomenon could eventually be applied to agriculture, and lead to the cultivation of hardier crops. But all agree that there is still much work to be done. ‘Applying our limited knowledge [of plant-communication mechanisms] to agriculture is a big jump,’ says Johnson, ‘but it is definitely on the horizon.’ Nevertheless, one message has emerged loud and clear from those studying this new realm of botanical interaction: despite not possessing eyes, ears, or a nervous system, plants are anything but uncommunicative. ‘When I started my PhD (in the late 1980s), all this stuff was considered very weird,’ recalls Ariel Novoplansky. ‘Today, there is no doubt. We now recognise that plants are capable of some very sophisticated exchanges of information with other plants. This idea is not strange anymore.’

source.text: How to be Happy

translation.text: 如何获得幸福

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: Some recent developments in the science of happiness
headerUnits.translationNormalizedText: 幸福科学近期的一些进展

source.text: Some recent developments in the science of happiness

translation.text: 幸福科学近期的一些进展

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: A psychiatrist Tony Fernando was walking down the street when he saw a group of young homeless men sitting on the footpath. As Fernando handed out gifts of food, he tried to video the men’s reactions in his mind, recording how their gratitude lifted him in return. ‘I felt warm, content, meaningful,’ he says. Fernando believes the brain can be trained to make us happy and that his ‘video method’ is one way to achieve this. In fact, a growing body of scientific research internationally is showing how we can learn happiness in the same way we can learn to play the piano. In the soft tissue that forms the brain, there are approximately ten trillion synapses connecting roughly a hundred billion neurons. Active synapses become more sensitive; less active synapses die, but new ones grow quickly. This is relatively new thinking – just 30 years ago, neuroscientists believed that adult brain cells couldn’t regenerate. One of the pioneers in this field is University of Wisconsin professor Richard Davidson. He studied Buddhist monks using brain scans in his research facility, and found that those trained in meditation had higher levels of activity in the left prefrontal cortex – the area associated with happiness. Davidson believes that the trained brain is physically different from the untrained one.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 精神科医生 Tony Fernando 有一次走在街上，看见一群无家可归的年轻男子坐在人行道上。他把食物送给这些人时，试着在脑海中把他们的反应录成“视频”，记下他们的感激如何反过来振奋自己。他说：“我感到温暖、满足，也觉得自己所做的事有意义。”Fernando 相信，大脑可以通过训练让我们感到幸福，而他的“视频法”就是一种实现方式。事实上，越来越多的国际科学研究表明，我们可以像学习弹钢琴一样学习如何获得幸福。构成大脑的柔软组织中，约有10万亿个突触，连接着大约1,000亿个神经元。活跃的突触会变得更敏感；不太活跃的突触会消失，但新的突触也会迅速生长。这是一种相对较新的认识——仅仅30年前，神经科学家还认为成年人的脑细胞无法再生。威斯康星大学教授 Richard Davidson 是这一领域的先驱之一。他在研究机构中利用脑部扫描研究佛教僧侣，发现受过冥想训练的人左前额叶皮层活动水平更高，而这一区域与幸福感相关。Davidson 认为，经过训练的大脑在生理上不同于未经训练的大脑。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The idea that we can train our brains to find more happiness has been called ‘mindfulness’ by neuropsychologist Rick Hanson, author of Hardwiring Happiness. It was in college that Hanson, quite unintentionally, first recognised the importance of something that would become his life’s work. As an unconfident teenager, he discovered he could turn a small event, ‘a young woman smiling at me’, into a good feeling he could hold on to. To do this, Hanson employs exactly the same imaginary ‘video method’ as psychiatrist Tony Fernando. ‘The brain takes its shape from what the mind rests upon,’ says Hanson. If you keep resting your mind on self-criticism and worries, he argues, your brain will be shaped by that. Hanson explains that resting it on pleasant feelings and the things you have accomplished means that over time your brain will take on a different shape, with strength and optimism hard-wired into it.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 神经心理学家、著有《Hardwiring Happiness》的 Rick Hanson，把通过训练大脑来获得更多幸福的理念称为“正念”。Hanson 在大学期间无意中首次认识到某件事的重要性，而它后来成了他毕生的研究主题。少年时期的 Hanson 缺乏自信，他发现自己可以把一件小事——“一位年轻女子对我微笑”——转化为一种能够留住的美好感受。为此，Hanson 采用了与精神科医生 Tony Fernando 完全相同的想象“视频法”。Hanson 说：“心念经常停留在哪里，大脑就会依此塑形。”他认为，如果心里总想着自我批评和忧虑，大脑就会受其塑造。Hanson 解释说，如果让心念停留在愉快感受和自己取得的成就上，久而久之，大脑便会形成不同的样貌，把力量和乐观牢牢固化其中。

source.text: The idea that we can train our brains to find more happiness has been called ‘mindfulness’ by neuropsychologist Rick Hanson, author of Hardwiring Happiness.

translation.text: 神经心理学家、著有《Hardwiring Happiness》的 Rick Hanson，把通过训练大脑来获得更多幸福的理念称为“正念”。

source.text: It was in college that Hanson, quite unintentionally, first recognised the importance of something that would become his life’s work.

translation.text: Hanson 在大学期间无意中首次认识到某件事的重要性，而它后来成了他毕生的研究主题。

source.text: As an unconfident teenager, he discovered he could turn a small event, ‘a young woman smiling at me’, into a good feeling he could hold on to.

translation.text: 少年时期的 Hanson 缺乏自信，他发现自己可以把一件小事——“一位年轻女子对我微笑”——转化为一种能够留住的美好感受。

source.text: To do this, Hanson employs exactly the same imaginary ‘video method’ as psychiatrist Tony Fernando.

translation.text: 为此，Hanson 采用了与精神科医生 Tony Fernando 完全相同的想象“视频法”。

source.text: ‘The brain takes its shape from what the mind rests upon,’ says Hanson.

translation.text: Hanson 说：“心念经常停留在哪里，大脑就会依此塑形。”

source.text: If you keep resting your mind on self-criticism and worries, he argues, your brain will be shaped by that.

translation.text: 他认为，如果心里总想着自我批评和忧虑，大脑就会受其塑造。

source.text: Hanson explains that resting it on pleasant feelings and the things you have accomplished means that over time your brain will take on a different shape, with strength and optimism hard-wired into it.

translation.text: Hanson 解释说，如果让心念停留在愉快感受和自己取得的成就上，久而久之，大脑便会形成不同的样貌，把力量和乐观牢牢固化其中。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In New Zealand, the Mental Health Foundation runs mindfulness programmes in 14 schools. Foundation CEO Judi Clements says, ‘It’s a valuable approach because children are told to pay attention, but aren’t told how to pay attention.’ Preliminary results on the outcomes found that children had sustained increases in well-being. The Foundation recognises five pathways to happiness – being active, connecting with others, taking notice, learning and giving. And, says Clements, ‘We’re detecting a hunger for it from different organisations and professions as well, so the Foundation is soon going to pilot an online “well-being game” in several workplaces.’ The project leader is psychologist Carsten Grimm, who is interested in whether some pathways to happiness are more effective than others. In a study, Grimm recorded the activities and corresponding happiness scores of 173 people. What he found was that people who used several pathways to happiness achieved the best results, suggesting it’s better to have a balance than concentrate on the single pathway you most identify with.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 在新西兰，心理健康基金会在14所学校开展正念课程。基金会首席执行官 Judi Clements 说：“这种方法很有价值，因为孩子们会被要求集中注意力，却没人告诉他们该怎样集中。”初步结果显示，孩子们的幸福感得到了持续提升。基金会提出了通往幸福的五条路径：保持活跃、与人联结、用心观察、学习和给予。Clements 还说：“我们发现，不同组织和行业也都对此有强烈需求，因此基金会很快会在几个工作场所试行一款网络‘幸福游戏’。”项目负责人是心理学家 Carsten Grimm，他希望了解某些通往幸福的路径是否比其他路径更有效。在一项研究中，Grimm 记录了173人的活动及相应的幸福感评分。他发现，采用多条幸福路径的人效果最好。这说明，与其只专注于自己最认同的单一路径，不如保持多种路径之间的平衡。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: However, Associate Professor of Psychological Medicine Nathan Consedine greets our relentless search for the secrets to happiness with a tired sigh. ‘The more you chase it, the less you get it,’ he says, quoting studies showing those who value contentment and well-being are, in fact, less happy. The big question, he says, is whether there’s any benefit in actively seeking happiness. He cites a study, for example, which showed that people who were happier were less inclined to show sympathy. Consedine says that’s probably because happy people are strongly motivated to stay happy, but engaging sympathetically with others typically involves engaging with their distress, and that’s going to reduce their own happiness. Consedine’s not disagreeing with the theory of mindfulness, but believes there’s more work to be done.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 然而，心理医学副教授 Nathan Consedine 面对人们孜孜不倦地寻找幸福秘诀，疲惫地叹了口气。他援引相关研究说：“越是追求幸福，得到的反而越少。”这些研究显示，重视满足感和幸福感的人，事实上没有那么幸福。他说，最大的问题在于，主动追求幸福是否有任何益处。例如，他提到一项研究，其中显示较幸福的人不太愿意表达同情。Consedine 认为，这可能是因为幸福的人非常希望维持自己的幸福状态，但同情他人通常意味着要接触对方的痛苦，而这会降低他们自己的幸福感。Consedine 并不反对正念理论，但认为仍需开展更多研究。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Some of that work is being conducted at Auckland University’s Centre for Brain Research. Associate Professor Johanna Montgomery has been studying Hanson’s theory – that altering our brain activity at a synaptic level affects our behaviour. She accepts that it’s a logical explanation based on studies from animals, but we haven’t yet got the technology to prove it scientifically in humans. It’s true that MRI scans certainly do indicate an increased flow of blood to different areas of the brain which are experiencing positive stimuli. However, she warns that this is a long way from confirming that the brain itself is developing or strengthening.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Nonetheless, Montgomery believes she is making progress. In the laboratory, when scientists want to experiment with synaptic connections, they stimulate the brain with electricity, as this copies the high-frequency firings that happen normally in the brain every second. Using this technique, Montgomery has made a number of findings. For example, the hormones that are released routinely in response to good or bad situations – such as adrenaline – act to regulate the brain, in the same way that weather has a regulating effect on human activity more generally. But scientists understand some of these stimuli better than others. More is known about the impact on brain activity of prolonged periods of fear than the effects of ‘happiness’ hormones that are released by positive events in life. This is one potentially important area that she hopes to investigate further in future.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 尽管如此，Montgomery 认为自己的研究正在取得进展。在实验室里，科学家若想研究突触连接，就会用电刺激大脑，因为这种做法可以模拟大脑中每秒都会自然发生的高频放电。Montgomery 利用这项技术取得了多项发现。例如，人体通常会针对好坏不同的情境释放激素，如肾上腺素；这些激素会调节大脑，就像天气通常会影响人的活动一样。不过，科学家对其中一些刺激的了解要多于另一些。对于长时间恐惧如何影响大脑活动，人们的认识要多于生活中的积极事件所释放的“幸福”激素会产生何种作用。她希望今后进一步研究这一可能十分重要的领域。
