blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Although initially the regeneration of Gleisdreieck Park was the subject of disagreement between those who were in favour of safeguarding the railway heritage and those who wanted to regenerate the adjacent neighbourhoods, it was opened to the public in September 2011. The heart of Berlin now has a new green lung, in which the atmosphere of various small, very different corners fits neatly into a large-scale, wide-ranging and robust general order. This has been possible precisely because the intervention was not limited to conserving industrial remains in order to promote railway history. And as a reminder of the six decades of human absence, during which nature took over, the park has been able to conserve to some extent the spirit of the non-place that preceded it.

passages.title: Walking and shoes in eighteenth-century London

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: Walking and shoes in eighteenth-century London
headerUnits.translationNormalizedText: 十八世纪伦敦的步行与鞋履

source.text: Walking and shoes in eighteenth-century London

translation.text: 十八世纪伦敦的步行与鞋履

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: A look at changing fashions in footwear and leisure
headerUnits.translationNormalizedText: 鞋履与休闲时尚变迁一瞥

source.text: A look at changing fashions in footwear and leisure

translation.text: 鞋履与休闲时尚变迁一瞥

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: It was difficult to get about in eighteenth-century London. During the first half of that century, the physical mobility of the upper classes in the city had been considerably restricted: the poor condition of the streets did not allow ‘walking for pleasure’ outside private parks or pleasure gardens. Streets were dirty, rubbish was everywhere and the British climate did not help. Walking could be a risky business. The terrible state of roads, always flooded and muddy, created a metropolitan world of shoe cleaners and street sweepers.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 十八世纪的伦敦出行很困难。在该世纪上半叶，城中上层阶级的行动能力受到了相当大的限制：街道状况恶劣，除私人公园或游乐花园外，人们无法“以散步为乐”。街道肮脏，垃圾遍地，英国的气候也没有带来任何帮助。步行可能是一件危险的事。道路状况糟糕，总是积水又泥泞，由此造就了一个充斥着擦鞋工和清道夫的都市世界。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: References to walking are not abundant in early eighteenth-century texts. This is truer for urban spaces than for places in the countryside, where country life had always been dominated by a lifestyle of outdoor activities. For instance, in eighteenth-century London, a sightseer’s experience was restricted to touristic places and involved journeys by a series of boats and coaches. Walking was considered to be an activity for the poorer members of society — or simply those who could not afford a coach.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 十八世纪早期的文本很少提及步行。这一点在城市空间比在乡村更为明显，因为乡村生活一向以户外活动的生活方式为主。例如，在十八世纪的伦敦，观光客的体验仅限于旅游景点，往来则要接连乘船和马车。步行被视为社会较贫困成员从事的活动，或者干脆就是那些坐不起马车的人的活动。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: This situation underwent a sudden improvement in the mid-eighteenth century, with measures implementing the provision of public spaces in which to walk. The first legislation concerning paving in London was passed in 1762, and during the following decades similar laws were enacted in many cities. By the end of the century, areas for walking were commonplace, and far more people were enjoying the pastime than before. Sophie von La Roche writes about metropolitan street life in the diary of her visit to London of 1786. She comments on how many more pedestrians there were on the broad, clean pavements, alongside the houses where, she says ‘many thousands of neatly clad people, eminent men and dressy women, pursue their way safe from the carriages, horses and dirt’. Although the pastime of walking was pursued only in specific spaces designed for the purpose, the number of these spaces increased as the nineteenth century approached. Travelling on foot became smoother and less dangerous.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 十八世纪中叶，随着多项措施落实、供人步行的公共空间得以提供，这种情况突然改善。伦敦第一部有关铺设路面的法律于1762年通过，此后几十年里，许多城市也颁布了类似法律。到该世纪末，步行区域已十分常见，享受这项消遣的人远比以前多。Sophie von La Roche在她1786年到访伦敦的日记中写到了大都市的街头生活。她提到，宽阔、洁净的人行道上行人比以往多了许多；这些人行道沿房屋而设，用她的话说，“成千上万衣着整洁的人、显要男士和穿着时髦的女士，在这里赶路，不受车辆、马匹和污泥之扰”。尽管步行这种消遣仅限于专为此目的设计的特定空间，但随着十九世纪临近，这类空间的数量不断增加。徒步出行变得更顺畅，也更安全。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Attitudes toward walking through public spaces and their changes over time were visible in the practical designs of fashionable footwear. Protective overshoes and other devices designed to keep feet above the dirty and wet ground soon disappeared, and ease of mobility increased. In the early eighteenth century, the look of men’s and women’s shoes started to diverge in appearance as a distinction between male and female footwear filtered into production. Contemporary descriptions of the boot and shoe trade underlined the differences between ladies’ shoemakers and men’s shoemakers too.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 人们对穿行公共空间的态度及其随时间发生的变化，都体现在时尚鞋履的实用设计上。用于让双脚远离湿脏地面的防护套鞋和其他装置很快消失，行动也更加方便。十八世纪早期，随着男女鞋有别的观念逐渐进入生产环节，男鞋和女鞋的外观开始分化。当时对靴鞋行业的描述也强调了女鞋匠与男鞋匠之间的差异。

source.text: Attitudes toward walking through public spaces and their changes over time were visible in the practical designs of fashionable footwear.

translation.text: 人们对穿行公共空间的态度及其随时间发生的变化，都体现在时尚鞋履的实用设计上。

source.text: Protective overshoes and other devices designed to keep feet above the dirty and wet ground soon disappeared, and ease of mobility increased.

translation.text: 用于让双脚远离湿脏地面的防护套鞋和其他装置很快消失，行动也更加方便。

source.text: In the early eighteenth century, the look of men’s and women’s shoes started to diverge in appearance as a distinction between male and female footwear filtered into production.

translation.text: 十八世纪早期，随着男女鞋有别的观念逐渐进入生产环节，男鞋和女鞋的外观开始分化。

source.text: Contemporary descriptions of the boot and shoe trade underlined the differences between ladies’ shoemakers and men’s shoemakers too.

translation.text: 当时对靴鞋行业的描述也强调了女鞋匠与男鞋匠之间的差异。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The production of men’s and women’s footwear required different skills, as the products were essentially different. Men wore more sober footwear, not unlike modern shoes. Their shoes were entirely made of leather, which provided resistance to rain, mud and bad weather. Women’s shoes had uppers made of textiles — silk, satin or cloth — and their resistance to bad weather and dirty streets was limited. Only the lower ranks of women wore leather shoes of a form similar to men’s. The high-quality shoes for women were often embroidered and were normally worn with protective overshoes, as they were prone to being damaged or disfigured by the conditions of the time.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The shoes of men and women related to their more general clothing in different ways. Wealthy women’s footwear harmonised with their other garments, a harmony that could be effected through matching textiles, general colour, embroidered detail or buckles. In the eighteenth century, men’s shoes matched their clothing in different ways, for example with glossy black, red or pink heels. The shoe of an upper-class man also acted as a type of sign which emphasised the difference between the wearer and young boys and women. The shoe also distinguished him from working men who wore leather or cloth protective leggings, ragged shoes and clogs. The symbolic marking of the entry of a wealthy young man into manhood through his shoes, as well as his other dress, may have been of more importance than has previously been acknowledged in costume history.

source.text: War of the Plants

translation.text: 植物之战

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: Professor John Lovett from New England University, Australia, describes some of the ways in which plants ensure their own survival.
headerUnits.translationNormalizedText: 澳大利亚新英格兰大学的John Lovett教授介绍了植物确保自身生存的若干方式。

source.text: Professor John Lovett from New England University, Australia, describes some of the ways in which plants ensure their own survival.

translation.text: 澳大利亚新英格兰大学的John Lovett教授介绍了植物确保自身生存的若干方式。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The general perception of plants is that they are defenceless when faced with threat from animals (including man), insects and other plants. This, however, is not the case. Plants are able to defend themselves against attack from their environment in many ways. There are two major features of plants that ensure their continuation as species. One of these relates to their physical attributes. Spinifex grass, a plant native to Australia, provides a notable example. Adapted to life in the hot, desert inland, spinifex has developed tightly rolled leaves which reduce the effects of drought stress. The hairs, or trichomes, which are found on the inner surface of the rolled-up spinifex leaf are believed to assist in minimising water loss. Trichomes also have defensive roles against predators. Many plants, such as the sunflower, have hairy leaves which are rough to the touch. When the plant is bitten by a grazing animal, the sensation is unpleasant on the tongue and the animal normally moves on to find more palatable food.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 人们通常认为，面对包括人类在内的动物、昆虫和其他植物的威胁，植物毫无防御能力。然而，事实并非如此。植物能够以多种方式抵御周围环境的侵袭。植物有两项主要特征可确保其物种延续，其中一项与其物理属性有关。原生于澳大利亚的spinifex草就是一个显著例子。为了适应炎热的内陆荒漠生活，spinifex草长出了紧紧卷曲的叶片，从而减轻干旱胁迫的影响。人们认为，卷起的spinifex叶片内表面上的茸毛，即毛状体（trichomes），有助于最大限度地减少水分流失。毛状体还能防御捕食者。许多植物，如向日葵，都长有摸起来粗糙的带毛叶片。当食草动物啃咬植物时，舌头会产生不适感，这种动物通常便会离开，去寻找更可口的食物。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Some families of plants such as the Solanaceae, which includes the tomato, the potato and other food plants, feature glandular trichomes. In these structures a tiny sac is carried on the hair, which rises from the epidermis, or skin, of the plant. The sac contains chemicals which may perform a range of functions. For example, an insect landing on a tomato leaf and rupturing the sac is exposed to a toxic chemical which will deter it from feeding on that plant in future. In other plants of the same family, the sacs contain a natural adhesive and the unsuspecting insect landing on such a leaf and rupturing a trichome sac is held onto the plant, unable to depart. In the leaves of the nettle plant these trichomes resemble miniature hypodermic syringes. An irritant chemical is stored at the base of the ‘syringe’. If an animal touches it, a shot of the chemical is discharged through the ‘needle’ and into the skin of the animal. The irritation the chemical causes is a deterrent against future threat.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 包括番茄、马铃薯及其他食用植物在内的某些植物科，如茄科（Solanaceae），具有腺状毛状体。在这种结构中，一根从植物表皮，也就是外皮上伸出的茸毛顶端托着一个微小囊体。囊体中含有能发挥多种作用的化学物质。例如，昆虫落到番茄叶上并使囊体破裂后，便会接触到一种有毒化学物质；这种物质会阻止它日后再取食该植物。在同科其他植物中，囊体内含有天然黏合剂；毫无戒备的昆虫落到这样的叶片上并弄破毛状体囊体后，就会被粘在植物上，无法离开。荨麻叶片上的这些毛状体形似微型皮下注射器。“注射器”底部储存着一种刺激性化学物质。如果动物触碰到它，一股化学物质就会经由“针头”射入动物皮肤。这种化学物质引起的刺激会使动物不敢再次来犯。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The poisons and glues of the Solanaceae and the irritant of the nettle indicate the other major method of plant survival: that some plants use chemicals to protect themselves, sometimes from each other. Chemical interactions that occur between plants are known as ‘allelopathy’, and in natural plant communities it is one of many factors which determine how plants grow in relation to one another. An example in Australia is the suppression of vegetation growth beneath eucalypt trees, an effect which decreases with increasing distance from the trunk of the tree.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 茄科植物的毒素和黏合物，以及荨麻的刺激性物质，表明了植物另一种主要的生存方式：一些植物利用化学物质保护自己，有时防范的甚至是其他植物。植物之间发生的化学相互作用称为“他感作用”（allelopathy）；在天然植物群落中，它是决定植物彼此之间如何生长的众多因素之一。澳大利亚的一个例子是，桉树下方的植被生长会受到抑制，而且距树干越远，这种影响就越弱。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The most detailed studies of allelopathy have generally been carried out on agricultural plant communities. In agriculture, allelopathy has been identified particularly with weeds, which compete with desired crop or pasture species, such as wheat, oats and grass, for environmental resources. Competition can be physical, where the growth of one plant maximises the use of water, nutrients and light to the disadvantage of another. Allelopathy, on the other hand, involves plant-produced chemicals which may poison a neighbouring plant. On the whole, weeds are far more physically and chemically aggressive than crop and pasture species. As an example, recent research on the common thorn apple, Datura stramonium, a weed found throughout Australia, has found that two powerful chemicals are released from the seed during the early stages of germination. In fact, it is necessary for the chemicals to be released from the seed coat so that the seed can germinate. Once released, the chemicals then provide a barrier that inhibits the growth of any potential plant competitor near the thorn apple seedling.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 对他感作用最细致的研究通常是在农业植物群落中开展的。在农业中，他感作用尤其被认为与杂草有关；杂草会同小麦、燕麦和牧草等人们所需的作物或牧草物种争夺环境资源。竞争可以是物理层面的，即一种植物通过生长最大限度地占用水、养分和光照，从而损害另一种植物。相比之下，他感作用涉及植物产生的化学物质，这些物质可能毒害邻近植物。总体而言，杂草在物理和化学层面的侵袭性远强于作物和牧草物种。例如，近期对澳大利亚各地都有分布的杂草普通曼陀罗（Datura stramonium）的研究发现，其种子在萌发初期会释放两种强效化学物质。事实上，这些化学物质必须从种皮中释放出来，种子才能萌发。一经释放，它们就会形成一道屏障，抑制曼陀罗幼苗附近任何潜在植物竞争者的生长。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Allelopathic chemicals function in quite subtle ways. Generally they are active in small quantities, they are effective only with certain other plants, they act by disrupting the plant’s natural processes and they have no known residual effects. It has also been found that the activity of these chemicals may be synergistic, that is, two or more such substances may combine to produce an effect that is greater than the effects of the substances acting in isolation. These are the very attributes which are being targeted in the current development of synthetic herbicides*. Allelopathy is not restricted to weeds in agriculture, but allelopathic activity in crop and pasture plants appears to have diminished, possibly because plant breeders may have concentrated on improving aspects of crop quality and quantity rather than aspects of defence against natural enemies.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Even today, almost 400 years after his death, the works of the famous English dramatist William Shakespeare have lost none of their appeal, nor have questions about the source of his genius. For is it really credible that an ordinary actor from the small town of Stratford-upon-Avon should metamorphose into so extraordinary a dramatist? For some, the answer is obvious: Shakespeare was a genius whose gift is no more suspicious than that of the physicist Albert Einstein, the German salesman's son who devised the theory of relativity. But others have insisted that a mere school leaver simply could not have penned such sophisticated works. They believe that Shakespeare was a pseudonym for someone with far more impressive qualifications who wrote the plays that still play to packed theatres today. But after long and largely fruitless debate, researchers are now turning to scientific methods to resolve the controversies surrounding Shakespeare. Ways of identifying the literary ‘fingerprint’ of writers are currently being developed using computers. This analysis of features of literary style is known as 'stylometry' and with it researchers can recognise the work of Shakespeare and his contemporaries with impressive reliability.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 即使在今天，在英国著名剧作家莎士比亚（William Shakespeare）去世近400年后，他的作品仍丝毫不减魅力，人们对其天才来源的疑问也同样引人关注。可是，来自Stratford-upon-Avon小镇的一名普通演员，真的可能蜕变成如此杰出的剧作家吗？对一些人来说，答案显而易见：莎士比亚就是一位天才，他的天赋并不比物理学家爱因斯坦（Albert Einstein）的才华更值得怀疑；爱因斯坦是一名德国推销员的儿子，却创立了相对论。但另一些人坚称，一个仅从学校毕业的人根本不可能写出如此精深的作品。他们认为，莎士比亚是某位资历耀眼得多的人的化名，正是后者写下了那些至今仍令剧院座无虚席的戏剧。然而，经过长期而且大多徒劳的争论，研究人员如今正转向科学方法，以解决围绕莎士比亚的争议。目前，人们正在利用计算机开发识别作家文学“指纹”的方法。这种对文学风格特征的分析称为“文体计量学”（stylometry）；研究人员借此能够以相当高的可靠性识别莎士比亚及其同时代人的作品。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: As long ago as 1785, the Elizabethan writer and philosopher Sir Francis Bacon was identified as a possible contender for having written Shakespeare's works. Bacon's possible motivation for not wanting to be known as the author of such masterpieces is far from clear, but Mendenhall believed his methods might at least reveal telltale signs of Bacon's hand in the plays. However, his results, published in 1901, revealed Bacon's writing style to be quite unlike that of Shakespeare. But Mendenhall's methods also revealed some key concerns. Recognising the need to include large samples of writing from both authors, Mendenhall lumped all their works together, despite the fact that literary style can vary enormously between plays, poetry and philosophy, for example. His focus on word length as the sole ‘fingerprint’ of writing style was also questionable - for how could he be sure that some other characteristics would not give different results? But Mendenhall’s biggest fault was perhaps simply that he was too far ahead of his time - he was attempting a task that cried out for the kind of computers not even conceivable over 100 years ago. More recently with their development scholars have been able to look for subtle peculiarities among the complete works of authors, which, in Shakespeare's case, amount to over 800,000 words.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: One of the key controversies now being probed is Shakespeare's relationship with other dramatists. Was he a lone genius or was his work the result of collaboration? Traditional methods of investigating such questions have relied on traits like the use of metaphor, but these may be shared by different authors simply on cultural grounds. In contrast, modern stylometry focuses on far more fundamental characteristics which are less likely to be shared by others. The text-crunching power of computers allows researchers to pinpoint phrases, words or even individual letters by their frequency in the work of different authors. Pattern recognition techniques are then used to develop a ‘fingerprint’ for each author.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 目前正在探究的一项关键争议是莎士比亚与其他剧作家的关系。他是独自创作的天才，还是他的作品为合作的成果？调查这类问题的传统方法依靠隐喻的使用等特征，但不同作者可能只是出于共同的文化背景而具有这些特征。相比之下，现代文体计量学关注更为根本、也更不可能为他人共有的特征。计算机处理海量文本的能力，使研究人员能够根据短语、单词乃至单个字母在不同作者作品中的出现频率来精确定位它们。随后，再利用模式识别技术为每位作者建立一枚“指纹”。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Stylometry has come up with little to encourage the continual number of experts who insist Shakespeare was simply too uneducated to create works of enduring brilliance. In 1996, literary scholar Ward Elliott and mathematician Robert Valenza of Claremont McKenna College, California, published the results of a stylometric comparison of the works of Shakespeare with those of over 30 of the proposed 'real' authors. Elliott and Valenza applied a battery of 51 tests to computerised texts and found that none of the claimants had a stylometric ‘fingerprint’ similar to that of Shakespeare. “I think these claims were driven initially by a sense that Shakespeare is too ‘important’ to be an ordinary person,” says Professor Kate McCluskey, director of the Shakespeare Institute at the University of Birmingham.

Some of the earliest plays, notably Henry VI and the notoriously violent Titus Andronicus, seem to be a combination of Shakespeare and his brilliant contemporary the playwright Christopher Marlowe, who was born in the same year as Shakespeare. 'Traditional scholars accept that Marlowe influenced Shakespeare's early work,' says Dr Thomas Merriam, one of Britain's leading stylometry experts. passages.title: Will Eating Less Make You Live Longer?

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: Will Eating Less Make You Live Longer?

source.text: Will Eating Less Make You Live Longer?

translation.text: 少吃会让你更长寿吗？

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: The latest in a conflicting series of studies suggests calorie restriction could potentially slow ageing in humans
headerUnits.translationNormalizedText: 一系列结论相互冲突的研究又有了最新结果：限制热量摄入或许能延缓人类衰老。

source.text: The latest in a conflicting series of studies suggests calorie restriction could potentially slow ageing in humans

translation.text: 一系列结论相互冲突的研究又有了最新结果：限制热量摄入或许能延缓人类衰老。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Calorie restriction, or ‘semi-starvation’ as some refer to it, has been proven to extend lifespan in many living organisms from yeast to mice, but the picture for primates, including humans, is not so clear. Research published by a team at the University of Wisconsin in the United States shows that rhesus monkeys also live longer on a calorie-restricted diet. But those findings disagree with research by the National Institute on Aging (NIA) in Maryland, also in the United States. Rozalyn Anderson, of the Wisconsin team, says the research is not intended as a recommendation of calorie restriction. ‘I find the idea monumentally unattractive!’ she says. ‘We study it because it is so effective at delaying ageing and the onset of age-related disease. It’s a way to tease out what it is that creates increased disease vulnerability as a function of age.’
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 已有研究证明，限制热量摄入，即有些人所说的“半饥饿”，能够延长从酵母到小鼠等许多生物的寿命，但对于包括人类在内的灵长类动物，情况并没有这么清楚。美国威斯康星大学的一支团队发表的研究显示，采用限制热量饮食的猕猴也会活得更久。但这些发现与同在美国、位于马里兰州的美国国家老龄研究所（National Institute on Aging，NIA）的研究结果不一致。威斯康星团队的Rozalyn Anderson说，这项研究并非意在建议人们限制热量摄入。她说：“我觉得这种想法极不诱人！我们研究它，是因为它在延缓衰老和年龄相关疾病发作方面非常有效。借助这种方法，我们可以弄清楚究竟是什么原因使人随着年龄增长而更容易患病。”

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Both groups started long-term trials on rhesus monkeys in the late 1980s to determine whether calorie restriction would extend the lifespan of primates. In mice, many experiments had come to the same finding: feed them a diet with 30% fewer calories and see a lifespan extension of 40%. The monkey trials were set up in a similar way: researchers took the calorie content of a standard monkey diet, cut it by 30% (while continuing to supply all essential nutrients) and monitored whether those monkeys lived longer, healthier lives than those on the standard diet.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 20世纪80年代末，两个研究组都开始对猕猴进行长期试验，以确定限制热量摄入能否延长灵长类动物的寿命。在小鼠实验中，许多试验都得出了相同发现：喂食热量减少30%的饮食，寿命便会延长40%。猕猴试验的设计方式与此类似：研究人员以标准猕猴饮食的热量为基准，将其削减30%，同时继续供应所有必需营养物质，并观察这些猕猴是否比采用标准饮食的猕猴活得更久、更健康。

source.text: Both groups started long-term trials on rhesus monkeys in the late 1980s to determine whether calorie restriction would extend the lifespan of primates.

source.text: In mice, many experiments had come to the same finding: feed them a diet with 30% fewer calories and see a lifespan extension of 40%.

source.text: The monkey trials were set up in a similar way: researchers took the calorie content of a standard monkey diet, cut it by 30% (while continuing to supply all essential nutrients) and monitored whether those monkeys lived longer, healthier lives than those on the standard diet.

translation.text: 猕猴试验的设计方式与此类似：研究人员以标准猕猴饮食的热量为基准，将其削减30%，同时继续供应所有必需营养物质，并观察这些猕猴是否比采用标准饮食的猕猴活得更久、更健康。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In 2009, with the monkeys approaching old age, preliminary findings of the two trials started coming in. For the Wisconsin monkeys, calorie restriction seemed to be working. Compared to well-fed control animals, the lean monkeys were living longer and suffering less from the diseases of ageing: diabetes, heart disease and brain diseases. However, in 2012 the NIA results emerged with a dramatically different conclusion: their monkeys were not living any longer than the controls, although they were healthier.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 到2009年，随着猕猴日渐衰老，两项试验开始产生初步结果。对威斯康星的猕猴来说，限制热量摄入似乎奏效了。与食物充足的对照组动物相比，这些精瘦的猕猴寿命更长，也较少罹患与衰老有关的疾病，如糖尿病、心脏病和脑部疾病。然而，2012年公布的NIA结果却得出了截然不同的结论：他们的猕猴虽然更健康，但寿命并不比对照组长。

source.text: In 2009, with the monkeys approaching old age, preliminary findings of the two trials started coming in.

translation.text: 到2009年，随着猕猴日渐衰老，两项试验开始产生初步结果。

source.text: For the Wisconsin monkeys, calorie restriction seemed to be working.

translation.text: 对威斯康星的猕猴来说，限制热量摄入似乎奏效了。

source.text: Compared to well-fed control animals, the lean monkeys were living longer and suffering less from the diseases of ageing: diabetes, heart disease and brain diseases.

translation.text: 与食物充足的对照组动物相比，这些精瘦的猕猴寿命更长，也较少罹患与衰老有关的疾病，如糖尿病、心脏病和脑部疾病。

source.text: However, in 2012 the NIA results emerged with a dramatically different conclusion: their monkeys were not living any longer than the controls, although they were healthier.

translation.text: 然而，2012年公布的NIA结果却得出了截然不同的结论：他们的猕猴虽然更健康，但寿命并不比对照组长。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The Wisconsin group’s latest results confirm that their calorie-restricted monkeys are living longer than the controls. They also offer a possible explanation of why the two groups’ findings don’t agree, and that lies in the treatment of the control group. The Wisconsin study began with monkeys in early adulthood. Initially, all the monkeys were allowed to eat as much as they liked. A few months into the trial, the monkeys were placed into one of two groups: the controls (who continued to be fed as much as they wished) and the calorie-restricted monkeys (who were given an individualised diet of 30% less than they were previously eating).
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 威斯康星研究组的最新结果证实，他们限制热量摄入的猕猴比对照组活得更久。他们还为两组研究结果为何不一致提供了一个可能解释，原因就在于对照组所接受的处理。威斯康星的研究从刚进入成年期的猕猴开始。最初，所有猕猴都可以随意进食。试验开始几个月后，猕猴被分入两组中的一组：对照组继续想吃多少就喂多少，而限制热量组得到的是个性化饮食，热量比它们此前的摄入量少30%。

source.text: The Wisconsin group’s latest results confirm that their calorie-restricted monkeys are living longer than the controls.

translation.text: 威斯康星研究组的最新结果证实，他们限制热量摄入的猕猴比对照组活得更久。

source.text: They also offer a possible explanation of why the two groups’ findings don’t agree, and that lies in the treatment of the control group.

translation.text: 他们还为两组研究结果为何不一致提供了一个可能解释，原因就在于对照组所接受的处理。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The NIA study differed in two ways. First, the control group of monkeys were not allowed to eat as much as they wished. They were given a diet considered to represent a normal calorie count, while the calorie-restricted monkeys were fed 30% less than that. Second, whereas the Wisconsin monkeys were given highly processed food high in sucrose, making it easy to standardise, the NIA diet was based on whole grains, fish oils, and was very low in sugar. These different settings for the normal control diet may provide an explanation of why the two groups showed different results.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The Wisconsin group may in effect have studied the effects of ‘overeating’. Their control animals weighed up to 10% more than average for their age and gender. Compared to them, the calorie-restricted animals not only suffered fewer diseases, they lived longer. Julie Mattison, head of the NIA study, observes that an overweight person who goes to a fast food restaurant every day will obviously benefit if their calories are cut back by 30%.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The NIA study fed their control monkeys what they considered a ‘standard’ caloric intake and saw that longevity for monkeys that were fed 30% less was the same. But in Anderson’s view, the NIA control monkeys were not fed enough; the NIA was calorie restricting both groups of animals. Their older female control monkeys, for example, weighed nearly 20% less than the national average. Indeed, Anderson points out that several of the NIA control monkeys have lived past the age of 40, far exceeding the 27-year average lifespan for captive rhesus monkeys. ‘That’s the maximum lifespan ever detected for the species, so the idea that their intervention is doing nothing is really at odds with the data,’ says Anderson.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: However, neither group had the right notion of a standard diet according to Leonie Heilbronn, who researches calorie restriction and healthy ageing at the University of Adelaide in Australia. Heilbronn points out that the NIA controls were a very healthy set of monkeys and leaner than a control monkey should be. passages.title: 200 Years of Australian Landscapes at the Royal Academy in London

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: 200 Years of Australian Landscapes at the Royal Academy in London
headerUnits.translationNormalizedText: 伦敦皇家艺术学院：澳大利亚风景画二百年

source.text: 200 Years of Australian Landscapes at the Royal Academy in London

translation.text: 伦敦皇家艺术学院：澳大利亚风景画二百年

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: This exhibition promises to chart the evolution of a nation through its art, but not everyone agrees with the reasons behind the choice of artwork.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 这场展览有望通过一个国家的艺术勾勒其演变历程，但并非所有人都认同作品选择背后的理由。

source.text: This exhibition promises to chart the evolution of a nation through its art, but not everyone agrees with the reasons behind the choice of artwork.

translation.text: 这场展览有望通过一个国家的艺术勾勒其演变历程，但并非所有人都认同作品选择背后的理由。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: For the casual viewer, the exhibition of landscapes, Australia, selected by the Royal Academy of Art, will be a spectacular guide through Australian art history. Included in the exhibition are a range of artists and styles, dating from the earliest days of colonial art and progressing through expressionism and modernism to the greats of the 20th century, culminating with the current generation of Australian artists. It is hardly surprising, then, that this results in a flexible, wide-ranging notion of landscape.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 对普通观众而言，由皇家艺术学院遴选的风景作品展《澳大利亚》，将成为一部壮观的澳大利亚艺术史指南。展览囊括多位艺术家和多种风格，从殖民艺术最早期开始，历经表现主义、现代主义和20世纪的大师，最后来到当代澳大利亚艺术家。这自然形成了一种灵活而广泛的风景概念。

source.text: For the casual viewer, the exhibition of landscapes, Australia, selected by the Royal Academy of Art, will be a spectacular guide through Australian art history.

translation.text: 对普通观众而言，由皇家艺术学院遴选的风景作品展《澳大利亚》，将成为一部壮观的澳大利亚艺术史指南。

source.text: Included in the exhibition are a range of artists and styles, dating from the earliest days of colonial art and progressing through expressionism and modernism to the greats of the 20th century, culminating with the current generation of Australian artists.

translation.text: 展览囊括多位艺术家和多种风格，从殖民艺术最早期开始，历经表现主义、现代主义和20世纪的大师，最后来到当代澳大利亚艺术家。

source.text: It is hardly surprising, then, that this results in a flexible, wide-ranging notion of landscape.

translation.text: 这自然形成了一种灵活而广泛的风景概念。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: But this landmark exhibition gives rise to some questions, and perhaps problems, regarding Britain’s relationship with its former colony. By choosing a style of painting at which British artists excel, the Academy could be seen as inviting criticism that hints at a telling attitude towards Australian art by comparison. But it is the very theme of landscape that provides the strongest connection to Australian art from Britain. To consider it condescending is perhaps too strong, but for Joanna Mendelssohn, an Australian critic and Associate Professor at the University of NSW’s College of Fine Arts (COFA), there is a suggestion that British artistic values have directed this exhibition, rather than allowing Australia the freedom to demonstrate its maturity.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 但这场具有里程碑意义的展览，也引发了一些关于英国与其前殖民地关系的问题，甚至可能带来麻烦。皇家艺术学院选择了英国艺术家所擅长的一种绘画类型，因而可能招致批评，让人觉得这种比较透露了学院对澳大利亚艺术的某种意味深长的态度。然而，恰恰是风景这一主题，构成了英国与澳大利亚艺术之间最有力的联系。把这种做法称为居高临下或许言之过重，但澳大利亚评论家、新南威尔士大学美术学院（University of NSW’s College of Fine Arts，COFA）副教授Joanna Mendelssohn认为，这场展览似乎受到了英国艺术价值观的支配，并没有让澳大利亚自由展现自身的成熟。

source.text: But this landmark exhibition gives rise to some questions, and perhaps problems, regarding Britain’s relationship with its former colony.

source.text: By choosing a style of painting at which British artists excel, the Academy could be seen as inviting criticism that hints at a telling attitude towards Australian art by comparison.

source.text: But it is the very theme of landscape that provides the strongest connection to Australian art from Britain.

translation.text: 然而，恰恰是风景这一主题，构成了英国与澳大利亚艺术之间最有力的联系。

source.text: To consider it condescending is perhaps too strong, but for Joanna Mendelssohn, an Australian critic and Associate Professor at the University of NSW’s College of Fine Arts (COFA), there is a suggestion that British artistic values have directed this exhibition, rather than allowing Australia the freedom to demonstrate its maturity.

translation.text: 把这种做法称为居高临下或许言之过重，但澳大利亚评论家、新南威尔士大学美术学院（University of NSW’s College of Fine Arts，COFA）副教授Joanna Mendelssohn认为，这场展览似乎受到了英国艺术价值观的支配，并没有让澳大利亚自由展现自身的成熟。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: What Mendelssohn found surprising about this exhibition was that the underlying rules for the selection of works seemed to have been so conservative. Since the landscape is a very strong British artistic theme, it appeared to her that when the British looked to the art of a former colony, there was a tendency for them to think that those colonies would continue to be like the British themselves. In reviewing Australia, the British insisted on looking at the genre of landscape painting.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 令Mendelssohn对这场展览感到意外的是，作品遴选背后的规则似乎如此保守。风景是英国艺术中一个非常鲜明的主题，因此在她看来，英国人审视一个前殖民地的艺术时，往往会认为这些殖民地会继续像英国自身一样。在评述澳大利亚艺术时，英国人执意从风景画这一类型着眼。

source.text: What Mendelssohn found surprising about this exhibition was that the underlying rules for the selection of works seemed to have been so conservative.

translation.text: 令Mendelssohn对这场展览感到意外的是，作品遴选背后的规则似乎如此保守。

source.text: Since the landscape is a very strong British artistic theme, it appeared to her that when the British looked to the art of a former colony, there was a tendency for them to think that those colonies would continue to be like the British themselves.

translation.text: 风景是英国艺术中一个非常鲜明的主题，因此在她看来，英国人审视一个前殖民地的艺术时，往往会认为这些殖民地会继续像英国自身一样。

source.text: In reviewing Australia, the British insisted on looking at the genre of landscape painting.

translation.text: 在评述澳大利亚艺术时，英国人执意从风景画这一类型着眼。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Because of colonial ties, it was inevitable during Australian art’s formative years that it would reflect Britain’s devotion to the beloved landscape before its own character and idiosyncrasies took shape. And while Mendelssohn’s concern over the exhibition’s conventional selection is valid, the Academy is nevertheless embracing the peculiarities of Australian art from the mid-19th century onward, albeit within the boundaries of landscape.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 由于存在殖民纽带，在澳大利亚艺术的形成时期，它不可避免地会先体现英国对备受喜爱的风景画的热衷，然后才逐渐形成自己的特征与独到之处。尽管Mendelssohn对展览选材传统的担忧不无道理，皇家艺术学院仍然接纳了19世纪中叶以来澳大利亚艺术的独特之处，虽说这种接纳仍局限在风景这一范围内。

source.text: Because of colonial ties, it was inevitable during Australian art’s formative years that it would reflect Britain’s devotion to the beloved landscape before its own character and idiosyncrasies took shape.

translation.text: 由于存在殖民纽带，在澳大利亚艺术的形成时期，它不可避免地会先体现英国对备受喜爱的风景画的热衷，然后才逐渐形成自己的特征与独到之处。

source.text: And while Mendelssohn’s concern over the exhibition’s conventional selection is valid, the Academy is nevertheless embracing the peculiarities of Australian art from the mid-19th century onward, albeit within the boundaries of landscape.

translation.text: 尽管Mendelssohn对展览选材传统的担忧不无道理，皇家艺术学院仍然接纳了19世纪中叶以来澳大利亚艺术的独特之处，虽说这种接纳仍局限在风景这一范围内。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Australia is curated by Kathleen Soriano, director of exhibitions at the Royal Academy. “Certainly the influence of English, French, or German art is much more evident in the early periods, in the early 1800s to mid-1800s,” she says. “What I wanted to show was how Australian art develops a real distinctiveness, associated with the landscape and the light.”
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 《澳大利亚》由皇家艺术学院展览总监Kathleen Soriano策展。她说：“毫无疑问，英国、法国或德国艺术的影响在早期，也就是19世纪初到19世纪中叶，要明显得多。我想展示的是，澳大利亚艺术如何形成一种真正的独特性，而这种独特性与当地的风景和光线相联系。”

source.text: Australia is curated by Kathleen Soriano, director of exhibitions at the Royal Academy.

translation.text: 《澳大利亚》由皇家艺术学院展览总监Kathleen Soriano策展。

source.text: “Certainly the influence of English, French, or German art is much more evident in the early periods, in the early 1800s to mid-1800s,” she says.

translation.text: 她说：“毫无疑问，英国、法国或德国艺术的影响在早期，也就是19世纪初到19世纪中叶，要明显得多。

source.text: “What I wanted to show was how Australian art develops a real distinctiveness, associated with the landscape and the light.”

translation.text: 我想展示的是，澳大利亚艺术如何形成一种真正的独特性，而这种独特性与当地的风景和光线相联系。”

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The fusion of tradition of the European kind with something more specifically Australian, and often personal, is crucial to the exhibition, and extends particularly to some of the more contemporary artists involved. Sydney-born video artist Shaun Gladwell is a good example of this. Gladwell’s most famous piece, which is featured in the exhibition, is Storm Sequence (2000), a video of Gladwell skateboarding on the Bondi seafront as one of Sydney’s signature brutal storms lingers offshore. It is his acknowledgment of landscape (or seascape) tradition, colored by Gladwell’s own individualism. “To exhibit my work in this show might make some sense because I was interested in Turner and the idea of atmosphere affecting vision, something I was really interested in around the time of Storm Sequence. I was thinking about this tradition of Romantic landscape, but I wanted to make it personal,” says Gladwell. But he didn’t want to just embark on borrowing imagery from elsewhere. He wanted to bring it to his experience and his world through skateboarding and beach culture.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 欧洲式传统与更具澳大利亚特色、而且往往更个人化的事物相融合，是这场展览的关键；这尤其延伸至参展的一些较为当代的艺术家。出生于悉尼的影像艺术家Shaun Gladwell就是一个很好的例子。Gladwell最著名、也在展览中展出的作品，是2000年的《风暴序列》：视频里，悉尼标志性的猛烈风暴之一在海面徘徊不去，而Gladwell正在Bondi海滨玩滑板。这是他对风景——或者说海景——传统的呼应，同时又带有Gladwell自己的个人主义色彩。Gladwell说：“在这场展览中展出我的作品或许说得通，因为我曾对Turner以及氛围影响视觉的观念感兴趣；创作《风暴序列》前后，我对此确实非常着迷。我当时在思考这种浪漫主义风景画传统，但又想让作品带上个人色彩。”不过，他不想只是借用别处的意象，而是想通过滑板运动和海滩文化，把这一传统带入自己的经历和自己的世界。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: So while it may seem narrow for Britain to reduce Australian art to the genre of landscape, there can be little denying that British landscape painting is still relevant to a current generation of Australian practitioners, however indirectly.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 因此，尽管英国把澳大利亚艺术归结为风景这一类型可能显得狭隘，但几乎无法否认，英国风景画对当代澳大利亚从业艺术家仍然有着影响，无论这种影响多么间接。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Visitors to the exhibition encounter Australian Aboriginal art first, the idea being that these works warrant a prominent position because they were ‘first’. Over the last couple of decades, London has hosted many successful exhibitions of Aboriginal art in smaller spaces, but for Soriano, Australia represents an opportunity to place such art in a broader context, with new relationships to the art of the settlers and white Australia. ‘One of the reasons landscape makes sense as being the right theme was because Aboriginal art started in and on the landscape,’ she says. ‘[The exhibition] is a beautiful meshing of the two different kinds of art, that allowed me to bring them together comfortably and honestly within this theme. It was important for me to present Indigenous art to audiences, and I felt it was most authentic that it was seen as part of Australian art history, rather than a separate area with a world of its own.’
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 参观者最先看到的是澳大利亚原住民艺术，背后的想法是，这些作品因为出现得“最早”，理应占据显要位置。过去二十来年，伦敦曾在较小的展览空间举办多场成功的原住民艺术展；但对Soriano而言，《澳大利亚》提供了一个机会，可以把这类艺术置于更广阔的背景中，让它与定居者以及澳大利亚白人的艺术建立新的关系。她说：“以风景作为恰当主题之所以说得通，一个原因是原住民艺术始于风景之中，也始于风景之上。这场展览把两种不同艺术漂亮地融合在一起，让我得以在这个主题下坦然、如实地把二者并置。向观众呈现原住民艺术对我来说很重要；我觉得，把它作为澳大利亚艺术史的一部分来观看，而非一个自成世界的独立领域，才最为真实。”

source.text: ‘[The exhibition] is a beautiful meshing of the two different kinds of art, that allowed me to bring them together comfortably and honestly within this theme.

translation.text: 这场展览把两种不同艺术漂亮地融合在一起，让我得以在这个主题下坦然、如实地把二者并置。

source.text: It was important for me to present Indigenous art to audiences, and I felt it was most authentic that it was seen as part of Australian art history, rather than a separate area with a world of its own.’

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Meanwhile, Australian critic Mendelssohn also points out that London is increasingly less important to today’s generation of artists, and this somewhat weakens the ceremony surrounding the exhibition in London. ‘China is the most important art market in the world,’ she says. ‘If you’ve made it in Shanghai, you’ve made it. The world has changed. My students in Australia, who come from all over the world, really want to see Venice Biennale and Art Basel, but they’re less interested in going to London. blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Description of the Study

source.text: Description of the Study

translation.text: 研究说明

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The findings of a study on verbal and non-verbal messages in communication by Albert Mehrabian and his colleagues at UCLA in 1967 have been quoted so frequently that they are now often regarded as a self-evident truth.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 1967年，Albert Mehrabian 及其在 UCLA 的同事开展了一项有关沟通中语言与非语言信息的研究。其研究结果被引用得如此频繁，如今常被视为不证自明的真理。

source.text: The findings of a study on verbal and non-verbal messages in communication by Albert Mehrabian and his colleagues at UCLA in 1967 have been quoted so frequently that they are now often regarded as a self-evident truth.

translation.text: 1967年，Albert Mehrabian 及其在 UCLA 的同事开展了一项有关沟通中语言与非语言信息的研究。其研究结果被引用得如此频繁，如今常被视为不证自明的真理。

independentReview.reason: 人工逐句复核确认：当前显式分组与语义边界一致，覆盖完整连续，不依赖模糊猜配，原文与译文均未改动。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In the first experiment, subjects were asked to listen to a recording of a female saying the word ‘maybe’ in three tones of voice to convey liking, neutrality and disliking. The subjects were then shown photos of female faces expressing the same three emotions and were asked to guess the emotions in the recorded voice and the photos. It was found that the photos got more accurate responses than the voices. In the second experiment, subjects listened to nine recorded words spoken in different tones of voice. Three words had positive meanings (e.g. honey), three were neutral (e.g. oh) and three were negative (e.g. terrible). Again, the subjects had to guess the speaker’s emotions. It was found that tone of voice carried more meaning than the individual words. From these experiments, the researchers concluded that 7% of our feeling towards a speaker is based on the actual words they use, 38% on their tone of voice, and 55% on their body language (e.g. facial expression).
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 在第一项实验中，受试者要听一段女性说“也许”一词的录音。录音采用三种语调，分别传达喜欢、中立和不喜欢。随后，研究人员向受试者展示表达相同三种情绪的女性面部照片，并要求他们猜测录音语音和照片中的情绪。结果发现，人们对照片作出的判断比对声音作出的判断更准确。在第二项实验中，受试者听了用不同语调说出的九个录音单词。其中三个词含义积极，例如“蜂蜜”；三个含义中立，例如“哦”；另三个含义消极，例如“糟糕”。受试者仍需猜测说话者的情绪。结果发现，语调传达的含义多于单个词语本身。研究人员根据这些实验得出结论：我们对说话者产生的感受，有7%取决于对方实际使用的词语，38%取决于语调，55%取决于身体语言，例如面部表情。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Methodological Issues
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 方法问题

source.text: Methodological Issues

translation.text: 方法问题

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: However, a closer look at the study reveals several limitations. The first is that the entire study involved only 62 subjects. Of these, 25 were used to select the word for the first experiment, while the key issue – comparing verbal and non-verbal communication – was determined by only the 37 remaining subjects. All were female undergraduates who participated as part of their introductory psychology course, and their ages and academic qualifications seem remarkably uniform. Thus, the findings may simply be a product of the nature of the sample.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 然而，仔细审视这项研究便会发现若干局限。第一，整项研究只有62名受试者。其中25人用于选定第一项实验所用的单词，而比较语言与非语言沟通这一核心问题，仅由其余37名受试者决定。所有人都是参加心理学导论课程的女本科生，而且她们的年龄和学业资历似乎都出奇地一致。因此，这些发现可能只是样本性质造成的结果。

source.text: However, a closer look at the study reveals several limitations.

translation.text: 然而，仔细审视这项研究便会发现若干局限。

source.text: The first is that the entire study involved only 62 subjects.

translation.text: 第一，整项研究只有62名受试者。

source.text: Of these, 25 were used to select the word for the first experiment, while the key issue – comparing verbal and non-verbal communication – was determined by only the 37 remaining subjects.

translation.text: 其中25人用于选定第一项实验所用的单词，而比较语言与非语言沟通这一核心问题，仅由其余37名受试者决定。

source.text: All were female undergraduates who participated as part of their introductory psychology course, and their ages and academic qualifications seem remarkably uniform.

translation.text: 所有人都是参加心理学导论课程的女本科生，而且她们的年龄和学业资历似乎都出奇地一致。

source.text: Thus, the findings may simply be a product of the nature of the sample.

translation.text: 因此，这些发现可能只是样本性质造成的结果。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Critics have also pointed out that the 7-38-55 formula is flawed since it was pieced together from two different experiments, neither of which involved all three channels (verbal, vocal, and facial). In addition, in the first experiment the single word ‘maybe’ was used throughout so it was impossible for the effects of changes in verbal input to be assessed. The researchers intentionally used a ‘neutral’ word so naturally the subjects found little meaning there. Clearly, such a methodology lacks validity. In the real world, people communicate in a particular context and speak in phrases and full-blown sentences, making extensive use of the multi-faceted vehicle of language.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 批评者还指出，7—38—55公式存在缺陷，因为它是由两项不同实验拼合而成，而两项实验都没有同时涉及语言、声音和面部这三个渠道。此外，第一项实验从头到尾只使用“也许”这一个词，因此根本无法评估语言输入变化所产生的影响。研究人员有意使用一个“中性”词，受试者自然很难从中读出多少含义。显然，这样的方法缺乏效度。在现实世界中，人们在特定语境中沟通，说的是短语和完整的句子，并广泛运用语言这种多层面的载体。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: My concern is that interpretations of this study have gained such prominence in our pedagogical literature. This 7-38-55 formula appears in many basic texts, used for training in public speaking, interpersonal communication and organizational communication.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 我担忧的是，对这项研究的解读在我们的教学文献中获得了如此显著的地位。7—38—55公式出现在许多基础教材中，用于公开演讲、人际沟通和组织沟通方面的培训。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Lessons to consider
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 值得思考的教训

source.text: Lessons to consider

translation.text: 值得思考的教训

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Clearly, one appealing aspect of the Mehrabian study is its numerical precision. Communication is a complex phenomenon, but it seems less so when we can rely on these three magical numbers. In contrast to the ambiguities of language, numbers seem to possess exactness. And the popular appeal of the study has given the 7-38-55 formula enormous credibility. There is a certain mystique about non-verbal communication, and the continued references to this research sustain it, encouraging people to believe in the overwhelming importance of the non-verbal message compared with the verbal one. Yet we know that even one ill-chosen word to a colleague or friend can make or break a communicative effort. Words do matter. Bradley (1991), one of the few textbook writers to criticize the Mehrabian study, makes the same point when he observes, ‘If we could communicate 93% of information and attitudes with vocal and facial cues, it would be wasteful to spend time learning a language’.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 显然，Mehrabian研究的一个诱人之处，在于其数字上的精确。沟通是一种复杂现象，但有这三个神奇数字可以依靠后，它看起来便没有那么复杂。与语言的模糊性相比，数字似乎具有精确性。再加上这项研究广受欢迎，7—38—55公式因而获得了极高的可信度。非语言沟通带有某种神秘感，而人们不断引用这项研究，使这种神秘感延续下来，促使人们相信，非语言信息比语言信息重要得多。然而，我们知道，对同事或朋友说出哪怕一个不恰当的词，也足以决定一次沟通努力的成败。言语确实重要。少数批评Mehrabian研究的教材作者之一Bradley在1991年表达了同样的观点：“如果我们能够凭借声音和面部线索传达93%的信息和态度，那么花时间学习一门语言就是浪费。”

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: To be fair, many textbook writers attempt to be faithful to the context of Mehrabian’s research. For example, Stewart and D’Angelo (1988) write: ‘Mehrabian argues that when we’re uncertain about what someone’s feeling, or about how much we like him or her, we rely… only 7% on the words that are spoken’. Others try to play down the specific percentages, saying that an understanding of the general importance of non-verbal cues is more important. Nonetheless, other textbook authors simply use the numbers without placing any limits on their meaning.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 公平地说，许多教材作者试图忠于Mehrabian研究的语境。例如，Stewart和D’Angelo在1988年写道：“当我们无法确定某人的感受，或无法确定自己有多喜欢对方时，Mehrabian认为，我们对所说词语的依赖程度……只有7%。”另一些作者试图淡化这些具体百分比，声称理解非语言线索在总体上的重要性更为关键。尽管如此，仍有其他教材作者直接使用这些数字，完全不对其含义施加任何限制。

source.text: For example, Stewart and D’Angelo (1988) write: ‘Mehrabian argues that when we’re uncertain about what someone’s feeling, or about how much we like him or her, we rely… only 7% on the words that are spoken’.

translation.text: 例如，Stewart和D’Angelo在1988年写道：“当我们无法确定某人的感受，或无法确定自己有多喜欢对方时，Mehrabian认为，我们对所说词语的依赖程度……只有7%。”

source.text: Others try to play down the specific percentages, saying that an understanding of the general importance of non-verbal cues is more important.

translation.text: 另一些作者试图淡化这些具体百分比，声称理解非语言线索在总体上的重要性更为关键。

source.text: Nonetheless, other textbook authors simply use the numbers without placing any limits on their meaning.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: We can choose our friends, the saying goes, but we cannot choose our family of origin. Our parents provide the genetic material and make powerful early role models, but even more influential in determining what kind of adult we will become are our brothers and sisters — our siblings. They occupy a position of unique intimacy in our lives and cast a longer shadow than many recognise or are prepared to acknowledge. By turns, enraging and lovable, familiar and mysterious, our brothers and sisters are the human beings who people our first social relationships. And a sibling relationship is the most enduring relationship many of us will ever have — no less emotionally intense than the bonds we form with our spouses and our own children — if only because they started when we were so young.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 俗话说，我们可以选择朋友，却无法选择自己的原生家庭。父母为我们提供遗传物质，并在早年成为具有强大影响力的榜样；但在决定我们长大后会成为怎样的人这件事上，影响更大的甚至是我们的兄弟姐妹。他们在我们的生命中占据着一种独有的亲密位置，其影响之深远，超出许多人的认识，甚至超出他们愿意承认的程度。我们的兄弟姐妹时而令人恼怒，时而惹人怜爱；既熟悉，又神秘。正是这些人构成了我们最初的社会关系。对许多人来说，兄弟姐妹关系还是一生中持续最久的关系；它在情感上的强烈程度丝毫不亚于我们与配偶及自己子女建立的纽带，哪怕只是因为这种关系在我们很小的时候就已开始。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Surprising new research by Dr Gene Brody found that having older children who do well in school and are well liked by other children leads to parental ‘basking’ — increasing mothers’ self-esteem. It is clear that in turn this is associated with more positive parenting of younger children, who display fewer behavioural problems as a result. Conversely, parents who get a difficult first child may in turn experience a negative spiral of household tension.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: Gene Brody博士的一项出人意料的新研究发现，家中年长的孩子如果在学校表现优秀，又受到其他孩子喜爱，就会让父母产生“与有荣焉”的感觉，从而提高母亲的自尊。很明显，这又与父母更积极地养育年幼子女有关，使后者因而表现出更少的行为问题。反过来，如果第一个孩子难以管教，父母则可能陷入家庭关系日益紧张的恶性循环。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: International sports star Piri Weepu is a rugby hard man, but at least some of his tough temperament was forged long ago in the family home. His older brother Billy started rugby — tackling little Piri when he was just four — to ‘harden him up’. It seemed to work. Piri followed his brother in playing for the under-sevens league before he even started school. There are as many such stories as there are families: in the formative hothouse of the family, siblings interact in complex ways with the powerful forcefields of parents, genetics and personality already at work. It starts with birth order, which determines play roles: the firstborn leader, the middle-child mediator and the rebellious youngest. These are roles that can stick for life.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 国际体育明星Piri Weepu是橄榄球场上的硬汉，但他强悍性格中至少有一部分，早在家中就已锻造出来。为了让他“变得强硬”，哥哥Billy从小Piri仅四岁时就开始用橄榄球擒抱动作对付他。这似乎奏效了。Piri甚至还没上学，就跟随哥哥参加了七岁以下组联赛。每个家庭几乎都有这样的故事：家庭就像一座塑造人成长的温室，兄弟姐妹在其中以复杂的方式相互影响，而父母、遗传和性格等强大因素也早已在发挥作用。一切始于出生顺序，它决定了各自扮演的角色：长子女是领导者，中间的孩子是调解者，最小的孩子则是反叛者。这些角色可能伴随一生。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Clinical psychologist Claire Cartwright says she has clients who believe, and it might not have been true, that they were treated differently from their siblings, that one child in the family was preferred over others. They are quite convinced that the parental judgements on them all those years ago were harsher, and that they were the ones who always got into trouble. Later, in the workplace, such a person might be particularly defensive, and so behave in a way more prone to attracting harsh judgements.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 临床心理学家Claire Cartwright说，她的一些来访者认为自己曾受到与兄弟姐妹不同的对待，家中某个孩子比其他孩子更受偏爱，而事实可能并非如此。他们深信，多年前父母对自己的评判更苛刻，自己总是那个惹麻烦的人。日后进入职场，这样的人可能格外具有防备心，结果其行为反而更容易招致严厉评判。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: However, the research shows that being Mummy or Daddy’s favourite has its own traps. If you were the easy-going, co-operative child at home, you probably excelled at pleasing parents and, later, bosses. But you might, as an adult, find it hard to be assertive with authority figures and lack direction. On the other hand, the sibling who is disruptive and annoying as a child may be able to reinterpret that role later, turning those attention-seeking characteristics into strengths like determination and leadership.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 不过，研究显示，成为妈妈或爸爸最宠爱的孩子也有自身的陷阱。如果你在家中是那个随和、配合的孩子，你或许很擅长让父母满意，后来也很会让上司满意。但成年后，你面对权威人物时可能难以坚定表达自己的主张，也可能缺乏方向。另一方面，小时候爱捣乱、惹人烦的兄弟姐妹，日后或许能重新诠释这一角色，把那些寻求关注的特点转化为决心和领导力等优势。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: How is it that full siblings, despite sharing DNA, can turn out so differently? One answer is that, in fact, each sibling grows up in a different family, a unique micro-culture. For example, the firstborn is, for a while, an only child, and therefore has a completely different experience of the parents than those born later. The parents themselves are growing up too, weathering hardship or good fortune, so one sibling might experience stability and closeness while another might be raised in the midst of crisis.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 同父同母的兄弟姐妹明明共享DNA，最终怎么会如此不同？一个答案是，事实上每个孩子都是在不同的家庭，也就是独特的微观文化中长大的。例如，头生子女会有一段时间是独生子女，因此他们对父母的体验与后来出生的孩子完全不同。父母自己也在成长，经历着艰难或好运；所以一个孩子可能体验到稳定与亲密，另一个却可能在危机之中被抚养长大。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Of course, there are many positive aspects of sibling relationships. Annette Henderson, a lecturer in psychology, says firstborn children learn vocabulary more quickly than their siblings because they are not competing to spend one-on-one time with parents. But younger children in turn benefit from unintentional instruction from their bigger brothers and sisters, acquiring entire phrases and an understanding of social concepts such as politeness. Similarly, a Cambridge University study of 140 children found that even when there is a great deal of conflict, siblings will still create a rich world of play and make-believe that extends them developmentally. Love-hate relationships were common among the children, but even those who fought the most had as many positive interactions as the other sibling pairs. It is also true that children compete for parental attention by making themselves different from their brothers and sisters, particularly if they are close in age. A 2003 research paper studied adolescents from 185 families over two years, finding that those who changed to differentiate themselves from their siblings increased the amount of warmth they gained from parents, and also developed stronger personalities and a better sense of their own identity.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 当然，兄弟姐妹关系也有许多积极方面。心理学讲师Annette Henderson说，头生子女学习词汇的速度比弟妹更快，因为他们不必与其他孩子争夺和父母单独相处的时间。不过，年幼的孩子随后也会从哥哥姐姐无意间的教导中受益，学会完整的短语，并理解礼貌等社会概念。类似地，剑桥大学一项针对140名儿童的研究发现，即使兄弟姐妹间冲突很多，他们仍会共同创造一个丰富的游戏与想象世界，推动各自的发展。爱恨交织的关系在这些儿童中很常见，但即使打架最频繁的孩子，积极互动也和其他兄弟姐妹组合一样多。孩子确实还会通过让自己有别于兄弟姐妹来争取父母的关注，年龄相近时尤其如此。2003年的一篇研究论文对185个家庭的青少年进行了为期两年的研究，结果发现，那些作出改变、让自己有别于兄弟姐妹的青少年，从父母那里获得的温情增多，同时也形成了更强的个性和更清晰的自我认同。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Another consideration is that many families today are smaller and more intimate than their historical counterparts. This may be advantageous because siblings tend to know each other better and remain lifelong friends compared to children from bigger or more widely spaced families, who perhaps lose touch with one another after leaving home. Then there was a 2010 American study which found that having a sister, whether younger or older, meant that 10- to 14-year-olds were less likely to feel lonely, unloved, self-conscious or fearful. The same study found that having a loving sibling of either gender promoted good deeds, such as helping a neighbour around the house or helping other children at school.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 另一个需要考虑的因素是，如今许多家庭比过去的家庭规模更小，关系也更亲密。这可能是一项优势，因为与家庭规模较大或兄弟姐妹年龄间隔较大的孩子相比，这些家庭中的兄弟姐妹往往更了解彼此，并终身保持朋友关系；后两类家庭的孩子离家后或许会彼此失去联系。此外，美国2010年的一项研究发现，无论姐姐还是妹妹，有姐妹会让10至14岁的儿童较少感到孤独、不被爱、不自在或害怕。同一项研究还发现，无论性别，拥有一个充满关爱的兄弟姐妹都会促进善行，比如在家务方面帮助邻居，或在学校帮助其他孩子。

translation.text: 另一个需要考虑的因素是，如今许多家庭比过去的家庭规模更小，关系也更亲密。

translation.text: 这可能是一项优势，因为与家庭规模较大或兄弟姐妹年龄间隔较大的孩子相比，这些家庭中的兄弟姐妹往往更了解彼此，并终身保持朋友关系；后两类家庭的孩子离家后或许会彼此失去联系。

source.text: Then there was a 2010 American study which found that having a sister, whether younger or older, meant that 10- to 14-year-olds were less likely to feel lonely, unloved, self-conscious or fearful.

translation.text: 此外，美国2010年的一项研究发现，无论姐姐还是妹妹，有姐妹会让10至14岁的儿童较少感到孤独、不被爱、不自在或害怕。

source.text: The same study found that having a loving sibling of either gender promoted good deeds, such as helping a neighbour around the house or helping other children at school.

translation.text: 同一项研究还发现，无论性别，拥有一个充满关爱的兄弟姐妹都会促进善行，比如在家务方面帮助邻居，或在学校帮助其他孩子。

headerUnits.translationNormalizedText: 澳大利亚巨型动物之争

source.text: Australia’s Megafauna Controversy

translation.text: 澳大利亚巨型动物之争

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Just how long did humans live side by side with megafauna in Australia? Barry Brook, Richard Gillespie and Paul Martin dispute previous claims of a lengthy coexistence.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 人类究竟在澳大利亚与巨型动物共同生活了多久？Barry Brook、Richard Gillespie 和 Paul Martin 对先前有关长期共存的说法提出质疑。

source.text: Just how long did humans live side by side with megafauna in Australia?

translation.text: 人类究竟在澳大利亚与巨型动物共同生活了多久？

source.text: Barry Brook, Richard Gillespie and Paul Martin dispute previous claims of a lengthy coexistence.

translation.text: Barry Brook、Richard Gillespie 和 Paul Martin 对先前有关长期共存的说法提出质疑。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Over the past 50 millennia, Australia has witnessed the extinction of many species of large animals, including a rhinoceros-sized wombat and goannas the size of crocodiles. Debate about the possible cause of these extinctions has continued for more than 150 years, and one of the crucial questions raised is how long humans and megafauna coexisted in Australia. We need to know the overlap of time to make an informed choice between the two main theories regarding the causes of these extinctions. If humans and megafauna coexisted for a protracted period, then climate change is the more likely cause. However, if the megafauna became extinct shortly after the arrival of humans, then humans are the likely culprits.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 过去5万年间，澳大利亚有许多大型动物物种灭绝，其中包括犀牛般大的袋熊和鳄鱼般大的巨蜥。关于这些物种可能因何灭绝的争论已经持续了150多年，其中一个关键问题是：人类与巨型动物在澳大利亚共存了多久。要在两种主要灭绝原因理论之间作出有依据的判断，我们必须知道二者在时间上重叠了多久。如果人类与巨型动物长期共存，那么气候变化更可能是灭绝原因；但如果巨型动物在人类到来后不久便灭绝，那么人类就很可能是罪魁祸首。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The archaeological site at Cuddie Springs in eastern Australia appears to be well preserved. This dusty claypan holds within its sediments a rich cache of flaked stone and seed-grinding tools, and side by side with these clear signals of human culture are the bones of a dozen or more species of megafauna. Drs Judith Field and Stephen Wroe of the University of Sydney, who excavated the site, claim that it provides unequivocal evidence of a long overlap of humans and megafauna, and conclude that aridity leading up to the last Ice Age brought about their eventual demise. In the long-standing explanation of this site, artefacts such as stone tools and extinct animal remains were deposited over many thousands of years in an ephemeral lake – a body of water existing for a relatively short time – and remained in place and undisturbed until the present day.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 澳大利亚东部的卡迪泉（Cuddie Springs）考古遗址似乎保存完好。这片尘土飞扬的黏土洼地，其沉积物中埋藏着大量打制石器和研磨种子的工具；与这些清晰的人类文化迹象并存的，是十几种巨型动物的骨骼。发掘该遗址的悉尼大学 Judith Field 博士和 Stephen Wroe 博士声称，这里为人类与巨型动物长期共存提供了确凿证据，并据此认为，末次冰期来临前日益加剧的干旱最终导致了这些动物灭绝。长期以来，人们对该遗址的解释是：石器等人工制品和已灭绝动物的遗骸，在数千年间沉积于一个短暂存在的湖泊中，并一直留在原位，未受扰动，直至今天。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: There is no disputing the close association of bones and stones at Cuddie Springs, as both are found 1 to 1.7 metres below the modern surface. The dating of these layers is accurate: ages for the sediments were obtained through radiocarbon dating of charcoal fragments and luminescence dating of sand grains from the same levels (revealing when a sample was last exposed to sunlight). Intriguingly, some of the stone tools show surface features indicating their use for processing plants, and a few even have well-preserved blood and hair residues suggesting they were used in butchering animals.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 卡迪泉的骨骼与石块关系密切，这一点毋庸置疑，因为二者都出现在距现代地表1至1.7米深处。这些地层的年代测定准确可靠：研究人员对同一层位的木炭碎片进行放射性碳测年，并对沙粒进行发光测年，从而得出沉积物的年代；发光测年可以显示样本上一次暴露在阳光下的时间。耐人寻味的是，一些石器的表面特征表明它们曾用于加工植物；少数石器甚至留有保存良好的血液和毛发残留物，说明它们可能曾用于宰割动物。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: But is the case proposed by Field and Wroe clear-cut? We carried out a reanalysis of the scientific data from Cuddie Springs that brings into question their conclusions. The amount of anthropological evidence found at the site is remarkable: we estimate there are more than 3 tonnes of charcoal and more than 300 tonnes of stone buried there. Field and Wroe estimate that there are approximately 20 million artefacts. This plethora of tools is hard to reconcile with a site that was only available for occupation when the lake was dry. Furthermore, no cultural features such as oven pits have been discovered. If the sediment layers have remained undisturbed since being laid down, as Field and Wroe contend, then the ages of those sediments should increase with depth. However, our analysis revealed a number of inconsistencies.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 但是，菲尔德和罗提出的论据真的无懈可击吗？我们重新分析了卡迪泉的科学数据，结果使他们的结论受到质疑。遗址中发现的人类活动证据数量惊人：我们估计那里埋有3吨以上的木炭和300吨以上的石料。菲尔德和罗估计，人工制品约有2,000万件。如此多的工具，很难与“只有湖泊干涸时这里才可供人居住”的说法相吻合。此外，遗址中没有发现炉坑等文化遗迹。如果正如菲尔德和罗所说，沉积层自形成以来一直未受扰动，那么沉积物的年代应当随深度增加而变得更古老。然而，我们的分析发现了多处不一致。

translation.text: 但是，菲尔德和罗提出的论据真的无懈可击吗？

source.text: However, our analysis revealed a number of inconsistencies.

translation.text: 然而，我们的分析发现了多处不一致。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: First, the charcoal samples are all roughly 36,000 years old. Second, sand in the two upper levels is considerably younger than charcoal from the same levels. Third, Field and Wroe say that the tools and seed-grinding stones used for plant and animal processing are ancient, yet they are very similar to implements found elsewhere that were in use only a few thousand years ago. Also of interest is the fact that a deep drill core made a mere 60 metres from the site recovered no stone artefacts or fossil bones whatsoever. These points suggest strongly that the sediments have been moved about and some of the old charcoal has been re-deposited in younger layers. Indeed, one sample of cow bone found 1 metre below the surface came from sediments where charcoal dated at 6,000 and 23,000 years old is mixed with 17,000-year-old sand. The megafauna bones themselves have not yet been dated, although new technological developments make this a possibility in the near future.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 首先，所有木炭样本的年代都约为3.6万年。其次，上面两个层位的沙粒明显比同层的木炭年轻。第三，菲尔德和罗说，用于加工动植物的工具和研磨种子的石器十分古老，但它们与其他地方发现的器具非常相似，而那些器具仅在几千年前使用。另一个值得注意的事实是，在距遗址仅60米处钻取的一根深层岩芯中，完全没有发现石制人工制品或动物骨骼化石。这些情况有力表明，沉积物曾被移动，其中一些古老木炭又沉积到了较年轻的地层中。事实上，在地表下1米处发现的一件牛骨样本，来自这样一层沉积物：其中年代为6,000年和23,000年的木炭，与17,000年前的沙粒混杂在一起。巨型动物骨骼本身尚未测年，不过新的技术进展使近期进行测年成为可能。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: We propose that the archaeologists have actually been sampling the debris carried by ancient flood channels beneath the site, including charcoal transported from bushfires that intermittently occurred within the catchment. Flood events more likely explain the accumulation of megafauna remains, and could have mixed old bones with fresh deposits. European graziers also disturbed the site in 1876 by constructing a well to provide water for their cattle. Given the expense of well-digging, we speculate that the graziers made sure it was protected from the damage caused by cattle hooves by lining the surface with small stones collected from further afield, including prehistoric quarries. This idea is consistent with the thin layer of stones spread over a large area, with cattle occasionally breaking through the gravel surface and forcing the stone and even cattle bones deeper into the waterlogged soil.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 我们认为，考古学家实际采集的是古代洪水通道从遗址下方带来的碎屑，其中包括流域内间歇发生的丛林火灾所产生并被搬运而来的木炭。洪水事件更有可能解释巨型动物遗骸为何会在此堆积，也可能把古老骨骼与较新的沉积物混在一起。1876年，欧洲牧民为给牛供水而挖井，也扰动了遗址。考虑到挖井成本高昂，我们推测，牧民为了防止井受到牛蹄破坏，用从更远处收集的小石块铺设井口周围，其中一些石块来自史前采石场。这一解释与大面积铺开的薄石层相吻合；牛偶尔会踩破砾石表面，把石块甚至牛骨压入更深的积水土壤中。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The lack of conclusive evidence that humans and megafauna coexisted for a lengthy period casts doubt on Field and Wroe’s assertion that climate change was responsible for the extinction of Australia’s megafauna. However, we do not suggest that newly arrived, well-armed hunters systematically slaughtered all the large beasts they encountered. Recent studies based on the biology of modern-day large mammals, combined with observations of people who still practise a traditional hunter-gatherer lifestyle, reveal an unexpected paradox and suggest a further possible explanation as to what happened. Using a mathematical model, it was found that a group of 10 people killing only one juvenile Diprotodon each year would be sufficient to bring about the extinction of that species within 1,000 years. This suggests that here, as in other parts of the world, the arrival of humans in lands previously inhabited only by animals created a volatile combination in which large animals fared badly.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 没有确凿证据证明人类与巨型动物曾长期共存，这使菲尔德和罗关于气候变化导致澳大利亚巨型动物灭绝的说法受到质疑。不过，我们并不是说，新近到达、武器精良的猎人曾有计划地屠杀所遇到的所有大型动物。近期研究依据现代大型哺乳动物的生物学特征，并结合对至今仍保持传统狩猎采集生活方式人群的观察，揭示了一个出人意料的悖论，也为事情的经过提出了另一种可能解释。数学模型显示，只要一个10人群体每年仅杀死一头双门齿兽（Diprotodon）幼兽，就足以使这个物种在1,000年内灭绝。这说明，无论是在这里还是世界其他地区，当人类来到此前只有动物栖息的土地时，便会形成一种极不稳定的组合，大型动物往往会因此处境不利。

translation.text: 数学模型显示，只要一个10人群体每年仅杀死一头双门齿兽（Diprotodon）幼兽，就足以使这个物种在1,000年内灭绝。

source.text: This suggests that here, as in other parts of the world, the arrival of humans in lands previously inhabited only by animals created a volatile combination in which large animals fared badly.

translation.text: 这说明，无论是在这里还是世界其他地区，当人类来到此前只有动物栖息的土地时，便会形成一种极不稳定的组合，大型动物往往会因此处境不利。

passages.title: Book Review: The Discovery of Slowness

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: Book Review: The Discovery of Slowness

source.text: Book Review: The Discovery of Slowness

translation.text: 书评：《缓慢的发现》

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The English explorer and writer John Franklin (1786–1847) joined the Navy at the age of 14, and fought at the battle of Trafalgar. When peace came, he turned his attention to Arctic exploration, and in particular to solving the conundrum of the Northwest Passage, a mythical clear-water route through the ice which would, if it existed, link the Pacific Ocean on America’s West Coast with the Atlantic on its East. The first expedition Franklin led to the Arctic was an arduous overland journey lasting from 1819 to 1822, in which he and his twenty-strong team covered 8,880 kilometres on foot. Their expedition was a triumph of surveying – they managed to chart hundreds of kilometres of previously unknown coastline – but food ran out on their journey back to civilisation, and the men were forced to eat their belts and their boots (which they boiled up to make leather soup).
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 英国探险家兼作家 John Franklin（1786—1847）14岁加入海军，并参加了特拉法加海战。和平到来后，他把注意力转向北极探险，尤其希望解开西北航道之谜。这条传说中的无冰水道如果确实存在，就能穿过冰区，把美国西海岸的太平洋与东海岸的大西洋连接起来。Franklin 第一次率队前往北极，是一次从1819年持续到1822年的艰苦陆路远征；他和20人的团队徒步行进了8,880千米。这次远征在测绘方面大获成功——他们绘出了数百千米此前无人知晓的海岸线——但返程途中食物耗尽，队员被迫吃掉自己的皮带和靴子；他们把这些东西煮成了皮革汤。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: There followed a career as a travel writer and public speaker (‘the man who ate his boots’ was Franklin’s tag-line). Then in 1845, Franklin set off back to the Arctic with two ships – the Erebus and the Terror – and 129 men. Nothing was heard of them for 14 years, although more than 30 expeditions were dispatched in search of them. Eventually it was discovered that Franklin and all his team had perished after their ships were trapped in the ice.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 此后，富兰克林开始以旅行作家和公众演说家的身份活动，“吃过自己靴子的人”成了他的标志性称呼。1845年，他带着两艘船——“幽冥”号（Erebus）和“恐怖”号（Terror）——以及129人再次启程前往北极。此后14年间，他们音信全无，尽管人们派出了30多支搜救队寻找他们。最终，人们发现，富兰克林及其全体队员在船只被困冰层后全部遇难。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In his personal correspondence and published memoirs, Franklin comes across as a man dedicated to the external duties of war and exploration, who kept introspection and self-analysis to a minimum. His blandness makes him an amenably malleable subject for a novelist, and Sten Nadolny has taken full advantage of this in his book. Most important, Nadolny has endowed John Franklin with a defining trait for which there is no historical evidence: Langsamkeit (‘slowness’, or ‘calmness’).
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 从富兰克林的私人书信和已出版回忆录来看，他全心投入战争和探险等对外职责，极少进行内省和自我分析。他这种平淡无奇的性格，使他成为小说家笔下容易塑造的对象；Sten Nadolny 在书中充分利用了这一点。最重要的是，Nadolny 赋予约翰·富兰克林一种决定性特质，而历史上没有证据证明他具有这种特质：Langsamkeit，即“缓慢”或“沉静”。

source.text: Most important, Nadolny has endowed John Franklin with a defining trait for which there is no historical evidence: Langsamkeit (‘slowness’, or ‘calmness’).

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Slowness influences not only Franklin’s behaviour, but also his vision, his thought and his speech. The opening scene of The Discovery of Slowness depicts Franklin as a young boy, failing to catch a ball because his reaction time is too slow. Despite the bullying of his peers, Franklin resolves not to fall into step with ‘their way of doing things’. For Nadolny, Franklin’s fascination with the Arctic stems from his desire to find an environment suited to his peculiar slowness. He describes Franklin as a boy dreaming of the ‘time without hours and days’ which exists in the far north, a place ‘where nobody would find him too slow’.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 缓慢不仅影响富兰克林的行为，也影响他的视觉、思维和言语。《缓慢的发现》的开篇场景把富兰克林描写成一个小男孩：由于反应太慢，他没能接住球。尽管受到同伴欺凌，富兰克林仍决心不去迎合“他们做事的方式”。在纳多尔尼笔下，富兰克林之所以迷恋北极，是因为他渴望找到一个适合自己这种特殊缓慢特质的环境。他描写少年富兰克林梦想着遥远北方那种“不分小时与日子的时间”，梦想着一个“没有人会嫌他太慢”的地方。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Ice is a slow mover. The compressed blue ice inside an Alpine crevasse will have fallen as snow several decades earlier. Polar pack ice takes at least two years to form. The film of crystals which first appears on the surface of the sea thickens into a silkily pliant layer called nilas; this in turn consolidates into young ice, which then deepens during several seasons to become pack. Ice demands a corresponding patience from those who venture onto it. The explorers who have thrived at high latitudes and at high altitudes haven’t usually been men of great speed. They have tended instead to demonstrate unusual self-possession, a considerable capacity for boredom, and a talent for the uncomplaining endurance of suffering.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 冰移动得很慢。阿尔卑斯山裂隙中压实的蓝冰，最初可能是几十年前降下的雪。极地浮冰至少需要两年才能形成。最先出现在海面的晶体薄膜，会逐渐增厚成一种如丝般柔韧的冰层，称为尼拉斯冰（nilas）；它继而固结成初生冰，再历经数个季节不断加厚，最终成为浮冰。冰要求踏上它的人也具有相应的耐心。那些能在高纬度和高海拔地区顺利探险的人，通常并不是行动极快的人。相反，他们往往表现出非同寻常的沉着，极能忍受无聊，也善于毫无怨言地承受苦难。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: These were all qualities which the historical Franklin possessed in abundance, and so Nadolny’s exaggeration of them isn’t unreasonable. Even as an adult, Franklin’s slowness of thought means that he is unable to speak fluently, so he learns by heart ‘entire fleets of words and batteries of responses’, and speaks a languid, bric-à-brac language. In the Navy, his method of thinking first and acting later initially provokes mockery from his fellow sailors. But Franklin persists in doing things his way, and gradually earns the respect of those around him. To a commodore who tells him to speed up his report of an engagement, he replies: ‘When I tell something, sir, I use my own rhythm.’ A lieutenant says approvingly of him: ‘Because Franklin is so slow, he never loses time.’
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 历史上的富兰克林充分具备所有这些品质，因此纳多尔尼对它们的夸大并非毫无道理。即使成年后，富兰克林仍因思考缓慢而无法流利说话，于是他把“大量词语和成套应答”熟记于心，说出的语言缓慢而东拼西凑。在海军中，他先思考、后行动的做法起初招来同伴嘲笑。但富兰克林坚持按自己的方式做事，逐渐赢得了身边人的尊重。一名准将催他加快汇报战斗经过时，他回答：“长官，我讲述事情时有自己的节奏。”一名中尉赞许地评价他：“正因为富兰克林如此缓慢，他从不浪费时间。”

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Nadolny also brings his central metaphor of slowness to bear on the novel’s language. The chapters describing Franklin’s early years are a medley of separate fragments, rhetorical questions, associative jumps and exclamation marks. In the later sections recounting Franklin’s first Arctic expedition, Nadolny brilliantly sets the narrative pace to the rhythms of the frozen landscape, and to the ‘slowness which is bred by hunger’.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Since it was first published in Germany in 1983, The Discovery of Slowness has sold more than a million copies and been translated into 15 languages. It has been adopted as a manual and manifesto by European pressure groups and institutions representing causes as diverse as sustainable development, management science and motoring policy, even becoming involved in the debate about speed limits on German roads. The various groups that have taken the novel up have one thing in common: a dislike of the high-speed culture of Post-modernity. Nadolny’s Franklin appeals to them because he is immune to ‘the compulsion to be constantly occupied’, and to the idea that ‘someone was better if he could do the same thing fast’. It’s easy to see where the attraction lies for those in management. The novel is crammed with quotations about time-efficiency, punctiliousness and profitability: ‘What did “too late” mean? They hadn’t waited for it long enough, that’s what it meant.’
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 《缓慢的发现》自1983年首次在德国出版以来，销量已超过100万册，并被译成15种语言。欧洲一些压力团体和机构把它当作手册和宣言；这些组织代表的事业多种多样，从可持续发展、管理科学到交通政策，甚至还参与了德国道路限速的讨论。采用这部小说的不同团体有一个共同点：都不喜欢后现代社会的高速文化。纳多尔尼笔下的富兰克林不受“必须始终忙个不停”的强迫观念影响，也不认同“同一件事做得快的人就更优秀”这一看法，因此受到这些团体欢迎。不难看出，管理领域人士为何会被它吸引。小说中充满了关于时间效率、严谨守时和盈利能力的引语：“‘太迟’是什么意思？是他们等得还不够久——就是这个意思。”

source.text: Charles Darwin and Evolutionary Psychology

translation.text: 查尔斯·达尔文与进化心理学

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Charles Darwin, the brilliant anthropologist and creator of the theory of evolution, is not normally associated with the modern business world. Nevertheless, Darwinian evolutionary theory is the foundation of a new wave of ideas about human behaviour in general and particularly the way people behave in the workplace; these ideas have given the title of ‘evolutionary psychology’. Evolutionary psychology revolves around the notion that our brains, like our bodies, have an inherited evolutionary design that has scarcely changed for 10,000 years. As respected evolutionary psychology experts Leda Cosmides and John Tooby comment, ‘our modern skulls house a Stone Age mind’. The US biologist Edward O. Wilson sees evolutionary psychology as being a discipline which is based on both sociobiology, which is the study of the biological basis of social behaviour, and psychology, which is the systematic study of human behaviour.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Nigel Nicholson, an organisational psychologist from the London Business School, is a strong supporter of evolutionary psychology and on this subject has published Managing the Human Animal. His book takes the reader on a journey from the Stone Age plains of the savannah to the modern office, and includes a discussion of Darwinism and behavioural psychology, together with a dissection of dysfunctional organisational behaviour. It is an effective approach explaining why people behave as they do, particularly at work. Evolutionary psychology is increasingly being cited in management circles, where managers are trying to understand puzzling aspects of human behaviour and, by doing so, improve the workplace. Nicholson believes that evolutionary psychology can help managers understand what goes wrong in organisational life and what they can do about it.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Nicholson maintains that evolutionary psychology dismisses the long-held assumption that our minds are like blank pages just waiting for culture and experience to write on them and shape our nature. He points out that sophisticated research shows the brain actually houses a store of knowledge when we are born, and now genetic research is establishing there are certain genes that account for abilities, tastes and tendencies. The stored knowledge in the human brain has not changed much since the Stone Age. As Tooby and Cosmides stress, there have not been enough generations for a brain that is well-adapted to our post-industrial life to evolve through natural selection.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The evolutionary psychology version of human nature revolves around some key elements which we have inherited from our hunter-gatherer minds. One key element is emotion. Emotion was originally essential to keep early man alive and safe from predators. Emotion was, and continues to be, our radar, guiding us throughout today’s techno-defined business world. Despite this, the business world emphasises rational, not emotional, behaviour, and does not admit the importance of emotion. We still use the emotional part of our minds to make sense of other people’s behaviour and to create an impression, so we can often be taken in by appearances. This mental predisposition actually works best in small communities (the tribe), not in much larger environments filled with people we barely know (the modern workplace). Our minds naturally try to re-create our ancestral communities with networks of no more than 150 people, where there are clear hierarchies and leaders. As a consequence, it takes very little to trigger people’s innate distrust of others because our safety in antiquity depended on supporting our near family and friends, whom we valued more than other people.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: So what advice does Nicholson have for the corporate world? He thinks that by knowing the reasons for people’s behaviour it is possible to mould corporate environments into places that have more chance of working efficiently and being pleasant places to work in. Nicholson admits that not everybody in the business world agrees with his belief in the effectiveness of evolutionary psychology in the workplace. One group that resists the theory of evolutionary psychology is young MBA graduates who are just beginning their careers and feel that evolutionary psychology will make their lives at work more difficult. Older and wiser executives point out that they still tend to cling to the idea of a magic formula to bring people into line with corporate strategy. But that is back-to-front thinking, according to Nicholson, who contends that we should be reinventing our business structures, not our fundamental human nature.
