blocks.sourceNormalizedText: It is not enough to focus our study of Roman life only on a fixed time. It would lack foundation and consistency if we did not also focus it in space—in the country or in the town. Even today when the facilities for communication bring something of the city into the smallest and most isolated country cottage, there remains a significant difference between rural existence and the excitement of city life: a much greater gulf separated the peasant from the townsman of antiquity. So large was the inequality between them that, according to the historian Rostovtzeff, it pitted one against the other in a fierce and silent struggle which pierced the wall protecting the Roman privileged classes from the barbarian flood from the north. When the barbarian forces began to invade Roman territory, the peasants decided to fight alongside them.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 研究罗马生活，只把范围限定在一个固定时期还不够。如果不同时把空间范围限定在乡村或城镇，研究就会缺乏基础和一致性。即使在今天，通信设施已经把一些城市事物带进最偏远、最与世隔绝的乡间小屋，乡村生活与令人兴奋的城市生活之间仍有显著差异；而在古代，农民与城市居民之间的鸿沟要大得多。历史学家 Rostovtzeff 认为，两者之间的不平等如此严重，以至于他们展开了一场激烈而无声的对抗，最终冲破了保护罗马上层特权阶级、抵挡北方蛮族洪流的屏障。当蛮族军队开始入侵罗马领土时，农民决定与他们并肩作战。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The townsman, in fact, enjoyed all the goods and resources of the earth. The peasant knew nothing but unending labour without profit, and was unable to enjoy the activities available in even the poorest of cities: the liveliness of the sports field, the warmth of the public baths and the magnificence of public spectacles. In a work on the history of everyday life, we must give up any attempt to blend two such dissimilar pictures into one, and must choose between them. The time which we have chosen to describe day by day is that of those Roman subjects who spent their time exclusively in the town, or rather in The City, Rome, which they regarded as the hub and centre of the universe, proud and wealthy ruler of a world which seemed at that time to have been pacified for ever.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 事实上，城市居民享用着大地提供的一切物产和资源。农民只知道无休无止却毫无收益的劳作，连最贫穷城市中可享有的活动也无缘参与：运动场的活力、公共浴场的温暖，以及公共演出的壮观。在一部日常生活史中，我们不能试图把这两幅差异如此巨大的图景合为一体，而必须在二者之间作出选择。我们所选择逐日描写的时代，属于那些只在城镇中生活的罗马臣民；更确切地说，是生活在“罗马城”的人。他们把罗马视为宇宙的枢纽和中心，视为一个当时似乎已永远归于太平的世界中骄傲而富有的统治者。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: To perform our task well, we must first try to form an adequate picture of the surroundings in which our subjects lived, and by which their lives were coloured, freeing ourselves from any misconceptions concerning it. We must seek to reconstruct the physical nature of the great city and the social milieu of the various classes of the hierarchy by which it was governed. We must also investigate the moral background of thought and sentiment which can help explain both its strength and its weaknesses. The way in which the Romans of Rome employed their time can only be studied satisfactorily after we have plotted out the main lines of the framework within which they lived and outside of which the routine of their daily life would be more or less unintelligible.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 为了完成好这项任务，我们首先必须对研究对象生活的环境形成充分认识；正是这种环境塑造了他们的生活，而我们也要摆脱对它的种种误解。我们必须设法还原这座大城市的物质面貌，以及统治它的各个等级阶层所处的社会环境。我们还必须考察思想和情感方面的道德背景，因为这有助于解释罗马的强大与弱点。只有先勾勒出罗马人生活框架的主要轮廓，我们才能充分研究罗马城居民如何安排时间；离开这一框架，他们的日常生活规律或多或少会变得难以理解。

source.text: To perform our task well, we must first try to form an adequate picture of the surroundings in which our subjects lived, and by which their lives were coloured, freeing ourselves from any misconceptions concerning it.

translation.text: 为了完成好这项任务，我们首先必须对研究对象生活的环境形成充分认识；正是这种环境塑造了他们的生活，而我们也要摆脱对它的种种误解。

source.text: We must seek to reconstruct the physical nature of the great city and the social milieu of the various classes of the hierarchy by which it was governed.

translation.text: 我们必须设法还原这座大城市的物质面貌，以及统治它的各个等级阶层所处的社会环境。

source.text: We must also investigate the moral background of thought and sentiment which can help explain both its strength and its weaknesses.

translation.text: 我们还必须考察思想和情感方面的道德背景，因为这有助于解释罗马的强大与弱点。

source.text: The way in which the Romans of Rome employed their time can only be studied satisfactorily after we have plotted out the main lines of the framework within which they lived and outside of which the routine of their daily life would be more or less unintelligible.

translation.text: 只有先勾勒出罗马人生活框架的主要轮廓，我们才能充分研究罗马城居民如何安排时间；离开这一框架，他们的日常生活规律或多或少会变得难以理解。

source.text: Marketing and the information age

translation.text: 营销与信息时代

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: For the early practitioners of marketing in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, the business of selling was simply a matter of continually finding new customers. By contrast, marketing managers in the current era recognise the importance of gathering information about the market and about potential customers. They recognise that if companies are to be profitable, customers must gain and retain their perceptions of value from the brands they buy over a long time frame, rather than from a single transaction. This also means that customers must see value in returning continually to the stores where they shop, as well as to the service providers they deal with.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 对19世纪末和20世纪初最早从事营销的人来说，销售无非就是不断寻找新顾客。相比之下，当今的营销经理认识到，收集市场和潜在顾客信息十分重要。他们明白，企业要想盈利，顾客就必须在很长一段时间内从所购买的品牌中获得并保持价值感，而不能只从一次交易中感受到价值。这也意味着，顾客必须认为不断回到常去的商店和服务提供商那里是有价值的。

translation.text: 这也意味着，顾客必须认为不断回到常去的商店和服务提供商那里是有价值的。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Marketing practitioners and marketing scientists have never worked more closely than they currently do. There are many reasons for this, including the fact that this is the information age where convergence in telecommunications, media and technology is causing old ways to be challenged, and new methods and tools to be tested. Customer expectations have risen as new technologies allow new approaches. For instance, the subscriber-TV music channel Channel [V] encourages its viewers to sign up for text messages and email alerts that tell them when their favourite artists and songs are about to be broadcast. Competitive advantage lies in being able to recognise which customers can be given greater attention, not just because they demand it but because it makes commercial sense to provide high levels of product quality and service.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 营销从业者与营销科学家的合作从未像现在这样紧密。原因很多，其中包括我们正处于信息时代：电信、媒体与技术的融合正在挑战旧方法，也促使人们检验新的方法和工具。新技术带来了新做法，顾客的期望也随之提高。例如，订阅电视音乐频道 Channel [V] 鼓励观众注册短信和电子邮件提醒，以便在他们喜爱的艺人和歌曲即将播出时收到通知。竞争优势在于能够识别哪些顾客值得投入更多关注；这不仅是因为他们有这样的要求，也是因为向他们提供高水平的产品质量和服务符合商业利益。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Modern marketing information systems rely on information technology to enable marketing intelligence to be gathered and to store and analyse marketing research information. While some of the information used is gathered by government bodies such as the Australian Bureau of Statistics and Statistics New Zealand, most of it is purposefully gathered by marketing organisations for client companies. In the process, computer technology is used to manipulate the data and then to present the information in such a way that executives can readily identify any problems or issues, and quickly arrive at solutions.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 现代营销信息系统依靠信息技术来收集营销情报，并储存和分析营销研究资料。所用信息有一部分由澳大利亚统计局和新西兰统计局等政府机构收集，但大部分信息是营销机构为客户企业有目的地收集的。在这一过程中，人们利用计算机技术处理数据，再以便于高管迅速发现问题或需要处理的事项、快速找到解决办法的方式呈现信息。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In order to produce superior value and satisfaction for customers, marketing managers need information at almost every turn. They need information about customers – end-users and resellers – as well as competitors and governmental and other forces in the marketplace. One marketing executive put it this way: ‘To manage a business well is to manage its future; and to manage the future is to manage information.’ Increasingly, marketers are viewing information not just as an input for making better decisions but also as an important strategic asset and marketing tool. As household incomes increase, choice widens and buyers become better at discriminating, so sellers need information about how buyers respond to different products and advertising campaigns.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 为了给顾客创造更高价值、带来更大满意度，营销经理几乎处处都需要信息。他们既需要有关顾客——最终用户和转售商——的信息，也需要了解竞争对手、政府以及市场中的其他影响因素。一位营销主管这样说：“管好一家企业，就是管理它的未来；而管理未来，就是管理信息。”营销人员越来越不只把信息视为作出更好决策的投入，也把它看作重要的战略资产和营销工具。随着家庭收入增加、选择范围扩大、买方的辨别能力增强，卖方需要了解买方会如何回应不同的产品和广告活动。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The supply of information has also increased greatly. It has been suggested by the futurist and best-selling author John Naisbitt that the United States and, by observation, developed countries such as Australia, New Zealand and Singapore are moving from industrial to information-based economies. These post-industrial economies earn 70–80% of their Gross Domestic Product from services, and have entered what some commentators have termed the ‘Information Age’ or the ‘Information Technology Era’.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 信息的供应量也大幅增加。未来学家兼畅销书作者 John Naisbitt 提出，美国以及据观察包括澳大利亚、新西兰和新加坡在内的发达国家，正在从工业经济转向信息型经济。这些后工业经济体有70%至80%的国内生产总值来自服务业，并已进入一些评论者所谓的“信息时代”或“信息技术时代”。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: One study found that with all the information now available through supermarket scanners, a packaged-goods product controller is bombarded with one million to one billion new numbers each week. As Naisbitt points out: ‘Running out of information is not a problem, but drowning in it is.’ Yet marketers frequently complain that they lack information of the right kind but have plenty of the wrong kind, or they claim that marketing information is so widely spread throughout the organisation that it takes great effort to locate even simple facts. In addition, subordinates may withhold information they believe will reflect badly on their performance and important information often arrives too late to be useful, or on-time information is not accurate. So marketing managers need better information. Although marketing organisations have greater capacity to provide managers with information, they often do not use it well. As a result, many marketing organisations are now studying their managers’ information needs and designing information systems specifically to meet those needs.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 一项研究发现，面对如今通过超市扫描设备获得的全部信息，一名包装商品产品负责人每周会被100万至10亿个新数字狂轰滥炸。正如 Naisbitt 指出的：“问题不是信息枯竭，而是淹没在信息之中。”然而，营销人员经常抱怨，他们缺少正确类型的信息，却拥有大量错误类型的信息；或者声称营销信息散布在整个组织中，即使查找简单事实也要费很大力气。此外，下属可能会隐瞒他们认为会对自身表现产生不利影响的信息；重要信息又常常来得太迟，已经失去用途，而按时到达的信息则并不准确。因此，营销经理需要更好的信息。虽然营销机构向管理者提供信息的能力更强了，却往往没有妥善使用这些信息。于是，许多营销机构如今正在研究管理者的信息需求，并专门设计信息系统来满足这些需求。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: One solution is to use a Marketing Information System (MIS). This consists of people, equipment and procedures which, when put together, are able to gather, analyse, evaluate and distribute needed, timely and accurate information to marketing decision-makers. The MIS begins and ends with marketing managers. First, it interacts with these managers to assess the information needs they have. Next, it develops the needed information from internal records, marketing intelligence activities and the research process. The analysis unit processes the data to make it more useful and, finally, the MIS distributes it to managers in the right form and at the right time to help them make better marketing decisions.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 一种解决办法是使用营销信息系统（MIS）。它由人员、设备和程序组成，三者结合后，能够收集、分析、评估并向营销决策者分发所需、及时且准确的信息。营销信息系统始于营销经理，也终于营销经理。首先，系统与这些经理互动，评估他们的信息需求。接下来，系统从内部记录、营销情报活动和研究过程中形成所需信息。分析部门对数据进行处理，使其更有用；最后，系统在适当的时间以适当的形式把信息分发给经理，帮助他们作出更好的营销决策。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: However, the costs of obtaining, processing, storing and delivering information can mount quickly. In some cases additional information will do little to change or improve a manager’s decision, or the costs of the information will exceed the returns from the improved decision. For example, if an organisation estimates that launching a new product without any further information will yield a profit of $500,000, then it would be foolish to spend $30,000 for additional information that would increase the profit to only $525,000. By itself, information is valueless – its value comes from its use.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 然而，获取、处理、储存和传递信息的成本可能迅速累积。在某些情况下，补充信息几乎无法改变或改善经理的决策；或者，信息成本会超过决策改善所带来的回报。例如，如果一家机构估计，在不获取任何进一步信息的情况下推出新产品可获利50万美元，那么花3万美元购买补充信息、却只能把利润提高到52.5万美元，就是不明智的。信息本身没有价值，它的价值来自实际运用。

source.text: Mercator - The Map Maker

translation.text: 墨卡托——制图师

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Maps codify the miracle of existence. And the man who wrote the codes for the maps we use today was Gerard Mercator, a cobbler’s son born 500 years ago on a muddy floodplain in northern Europe.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 地图把存在这一奇迹编码下来。而为我们今天所使用的地图写下这套编码规则的人，正是 Gerard Mercator：一名鞋匠的儿子，500年前出生在北欧一片泥泞的洪泛平原上。

source.text: Maps codify the miracle of existence.

translation.text: 地图把存在这一奇迹编码下来。

source.text: And the man who wrote the codes for the maps we use today was Gerard Mercator, a cobbler’s son born 500 years ago on a muddy floodplain in northern Europe.

translation.text: 而为我们今天所使用的地图写下这套编码规则的人，正是 Gerard Mercator：一名鞋匠的儿子，500年前出生在北欧一片泥泞的洪泛平原上。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Mercator was a humble man with a universal vision. In his own time he was ‘the prince of modern geographers’, his depictions of the planet and its regions unsurpassed in accuracy, clarity and consistency. More recently, he was crowned by the American scholar Robert W. Karrow as ‘the first modern, scientific cartographer’. Where his predecessors had adopted a piecemeal approach to cartography, Mercator sought to wrap the world in systematic overlapping maps. Along the way he erected a number of historic milestones. He participated in the naming and mapping of ‘America’, he constructed the two most important globes of the 16th century, and the title of his pioneering ‘modern geography’, the Atlas, became the standard term for a volume of maps. Mercator also devised a new method - ‘a projection’ - of converting the spherical world into a two-dimensional map.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 墨卡托为人谦逊，却有着面向整个世界的视野。在他的时代，他被誉为“现代地理学家中的翘楚”；他对地球及其各地区的描绘，在准确性、清晰度和一致性上无人能及。在更近的年代，美国学者 Robert W. Karrow 又将他誉为“第一位现代科学制图师”。他的前辈们采用的是零散、分块的制图方式，而墨卡托力图用一套系统化、彼此重叠衔接的地图覆盖全世界。在这一过程中，他树立了多个历史性里程碑。他参与了“美洲”的命名和制图，制作了16世纪最重要的两个地球仪；而他那部开创性的“现代地理学”著作《Atlas》的名称，后来成为成册地图汇编的标准称谓。墨卡托还创制了一种把球形世界转换为二维地图的新方法——“投影法”。

source.text: In his own time he was ‘the prince of modern geographers’, his depictions of the planet and its regions unsurpassed in accuracy, clarity and consistency.

source.text: Where his predecessors had adopted a piecemeal approach to cartography, Mercator sought to wrap the world in systematic overlapping maps.

source.text: Along the way he erected a number of historic milestones.

source.text: He participated in the naming and mapping of ‘America’, he constructed the two most important globes of the 16th century, and the title of his pioneering ‘modern geography’, the Atlas, became the standard term for a volume of maps.

translation.text: 他参与了“美洲”的命名和制图，制作了16世纪最重要的两个地球仪；而他那部开创性的“现代地理学”著作《Atlas》的名称，后来成为成册地图汇编的标准称谓。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Mercator was born in 1512 and died in 1594. His world was one of military conflict, social upheaval, religious revolution - and geographical discovery. He was ten years old when the survivors of the world’s first circumnavigation returned to Spain in their leaking caravel. No better example is required of genius arising from turmoil. He knew poverty, plague, war and persecution. He was imprisoned for his ideas yet patronised by an emperor. His life was one of brilliant breakthroughs and abrupt reversals. In its telling, his is the story of the poor boy made good: the pauper who embraced the world, found fame, faced death, yet triumphed through fortitude. Variously described by his peers as honest, calm, candid, sincere and peaceable, Mercator wore an aura of calm in troubled times. His attitude to his geographical calling was described by his friend and neighbour, William Ghim, as ‘indefatigable’. Some 40 or so of Mercator’s letters have survived, together with examples of virtually all of his printed maps and globes.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 墨卡托生于1512年，卒于1594年。他所处的是一个充满军事冲突、社会动荡、宗教革命——以及地理发现的世界。世界首次环球航行的幸存者乘着漏水的卡拉维尔帆船返回西班牙时，他只有10岁。要说明天才从动荡中崛起，再没有比这更好的例子。他经历过贫困、瘟疫、战争和迫害。他曾因自己的思想而入狱，却又得到一位皇帝的扶持。他的一生既有才华横溢的突破，也有突如其来的逆转。讲述起来，他的人生就是贫寒少年取得成功的故事：一个穷困之人拥抱世界、赢得声名、直面死亡，最终凭借坚毅取得胜利。同辈曾用诚实、沉着、坦率、真诚、平和等不同词语形容他；在动荡的年代，墨卡托始终带着一种从容气度。他的朋友兼邻居 William Ghim 用“孜孜不倦”来形容他对地理事业这一使命的态度。墨卡托约有40封书信留存至今；此外，他印制的几乎所有地图和地球仪也都有样本留存。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Mercator’s most significant work was a project of cosmic proportions. A multi-part cosmography, the work would include a section on astronomy, a chronology of world events and a modern geography, which would eventually contain over 100 maps.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 墨卡托最重要的著作是一项规模如宇宙般宏大的工程。这部由多个部分构成的宇宙志将包括天文学部分、世界大事年表和一部现代地理学著作；这部现代地理学著作最终将收录100多幅地图。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Before he commenced the great work, Mercator produced in 1569 an enormous world map on a new projection. His method for converting the spherical globe into a two-dimensional map helped to solve the greatest cartographic riddle of the day: how could the course of a ship following a constant compass bearing be represented as a straight line on a map which had been constructed on a grid of latitude and longitude?
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 在开始这项宏大工程之前，墨卡托于1569年采用一种新的投影法绘制了一幅巨大的世界地图。他把球形地球转换为二维地图的方法，有助于解决当时制图学中最大的难题：一艘保持恒定罗盘方位航行的船，其航线如何能在一幅以经纬网格构建的地图上表示为直线？

source.text: Before he commenced the great work, Mercator produced in 1569 an enormous world map on a new projection.

translation.text: 在开始这项宏大工程之前，墨卡托于1569年采用一种新的投影法绘制了一幅巨大的世界地图。

source.text: His method for converting the spherical globe into a two-dimensional map helped to solve the greatest cartographic riddle of the day: how could the course of a ship following a constant compass bearing be represented as a straight line on a map which had been constructed on a grid of latitude and longitude?

translation.text: 他把球形地球转换为二维地图的方法，有助于解决当时制图学中最大的难题：一艘保持恒定罗盘方位航行的船，其航线如何能在一幅以经纬网格构建的地图上表示为直线？

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Mercator’s solution was to progressively increase the space between his lines of latitude, away from the equator. The effect was to straighten the lines of constant compass bearing (also known as rhumbs or loxodromes). Unfortunately, straightening the rhumbs caused areal* distortion: at the map’s northern and southern extremities, the polar regions occupied the full width of the map, while North America appeared to fill half the circumference of the world.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 墨卡托的解决办法是：随着远离赤道，逐步加大纬线之间的间距。这样便把恒定罗盘方位的航线拉直了（这类航线也称为 rhumbs 或 loxodromes）。遗憾的是，把这些航线拉直造成了面积*失真：在地图的南北两端，极地区域占据了地图的全部宽度，而北美洲看起来占据了地球周长的一半。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Few of Mercator’s contemporaries understood what he was up to, despite the map’s title explaining that it was intended ‘for use in navigation’. Mercator knew that his projection was unsuitable as an areal description of the world, but it would be several decades before the map’s true navigational value would be recognised.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 尽管地图标题说明它旨在“用于航海”，墨卡托的同时代人中仍很少有人明白他究竟在做什么。墨卡托知道，他的投影法不适合用来表示世界各地区的面积关系，但要再过几十年，人们才会认识到这幅地图真正的航海价值。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Meanwhile, Mercator was marshalling and editing all the geographical data he needed for his modern regional maps of the world. His sources were wide-ranging and multitudinous, including an imperial physician in Vienna and his competitor, the Viceroy of Holstein. He was still working on these maps when he died. The great cosmography that Mercator had already titled ‘Atlas’ would never be finished.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In the Atlas, Mercator had embodied the principles of future mapmaking: his italic lettering, his identical map overlaps, his complete coverage of regions at more than one scale, his consistent use of grids of latitude and longitude, his singular editorial control, were all adopted as cartographic standards. ‘Atlas’, the cosmography, became ‘atlas’, the (Oxford English Dictionary) term for ‘a collection of maps in a volume.’
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 在《Atlas》中，墨卡托已经体现出后来制图的各项原则：斜体字标注、各幅地图之间一致的重叠范围、以一种以上的比例尺完整覆盖各个地区、始终一致地使用经纬网格，以及由一人实行统一的编辑控制——这些后来全都被采纳为制图标准。作为宇宙志名称的“Atlas”，后来变成了普通名词“atlas”，即《牛津英语词典》所定义的“装订成册的一组地图”。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The projection assumed a life of its own. So powerful a cartographic tool did it become that Mercator the man became subsumed by his own device. By the 20th century, Mercator’s Projection had been adopted by state cartographers to map the land that he had named ‘North America’. In 1938, Mercator’s Projection was selected by the Ordnance Survey to map Britain anew. And in 1974, the American cartographer Alden P. Colvocoresses used the Space Oblique Mercator Projection for the first satellite map of the USA. When the Jet Propulsion Laboratory sent Mariner 8 and Mariner 9 to map Mars, they undertook their Martian cartography on a standard Mercator Projection. One by one, the mappable orbs of our solar system are appearing on the worldwide web, flattened for our screens according to Mercator’s cartographic principles.

source.text: Neanderthal Technology

translation.text: 尼安德特人的技术

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: We think of our prehistoric ancestors as people of the ice and snow, living in caves, and for many of the West European Neanderthalers that is just a picture of their life. But where there were no caves, further to the east on the Russian steppe, for example, open-air sites with some sort of constructed shelter were the only option.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 我们常把史前祖先想象成生活在冰天雪地、居住在洞穴里的人；对许多西欧尼安德特人来说，这确实就是他们生活的写照。但在更靠东的地区，例如俄罗斯草原上，没有洞穴可用，露天居址加上某种人工搭建的遮蔽物便成了唯一选择。

source.text: We think of our prehistoric ancestors as people of the ice and snow, living in caves, and for many of the West European Neanderthalers that is just a picture of their life.

source.text: But where there were no caves, further to the east on the Russian steppe, for example, open-air sites with some sort of constructed shelter were the only option.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: We now know much more about the cave sites than the open-air ones because, historically, it was the cave sites of Western Europe that were first explored by archaeologists and also because open-air sites are harder to find – many of them have disappeared under deep mud deposits or under the rising postglacial seas. Caves, moreover, aid the survival of archaeological material and can preserve the records of remote millennia.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 如今，我们对洞穴居址的了解远多于露天居址。一方面，历史上考古学家最早考察的是西欧的洞穴遗址；另一方面，露天遗址更难发现，其中许多已经消失在厚厚的泥土沉积之下，或被冰期后上涨的海水淹没。此外，洞穴有利于考古材料留存，能够保存遥远数千年前的记录。

source.text: We now know much more about the cave sites than the open-air ones because, historically, it was the cave sites of Western Europe that were first explored by archaeologists and also because open-air sites are harder to find – many of them have disappeared under deep mud deposits or under the rising postglacial seas.

translation.text: 如今，我们对洞穴居址的了解远多于露天居址。一方面，历史上考古学家最早考察的是西欧的洞穴遗址；另一方面，露天遗址更难发现，其中许多已经消失在厚厚的泥土沉积之下，或被冰期后上涨的海水淹没。

source.text: Caves, moreover, aid the survival of archaeological material and can preserve the records of remote millennia.

translation.text: 此外，洞穴有利于考古材料留存，能够保存遥远数千年前的记录。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In south-west France, the limestone caves of the Périgord region made ideal homes for the Neanderthal people. There were good supplies of flint to hand for axes and the like, and the caves were often sited in small river valleys that offered protection against the worst of the weather. The Neanderthalers liked south-facing caves, for obvious reasons of sunshine and wind avoidance, and caves at some height above the valley floor offered refuge from floods and good game-watching vantage points.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 在法国西南部，佩里戈尔地区的石灰岩洞穴是尼安德特人的理想居所。附近有充足的燧石，可用来制作石斧等工具；这些洞穴又往往位于小河谷中，能够抵御最恶劣的天气。尼安德特人喜欢朝南的洞穴，原因显而易见：既能获得阳光，又可避风。位置高出谷底一定距离的洞穴还能躲避洪水，并提供观察猎物的有利制高点。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The Périgord region during the last ice age was, in fact, an exceptionally benign habitat for humans. It enjoyed a rather maritime climate with cooler summers that permitted the extension of tundra and steppe over its higher plateaux, and its year-round high levels of sunshine favoured the growth of the ground plants needed by reindeer, bison and horse. Winters were mildish for the ice age, animals never needed to migrate far from summer to winter, and men never needed to travel far from home to find abundant supplies of meat.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In Central and Eastern Europe, where caves are less readily available, such open-air sites as have been discovered were mostly located near water: bottom-land was a good area to be for people and animals, and also because the sedimentation pattern of lakes and stream courses has aided archaeological preservation – whereas erosion has presumably blown away sites which were out in the open. Some of the open-air sites in Germany, Central Europe and Russia have provided valuable information about Neanderthal man and his way of life. From Moldova, for example, comes evidence that has been interpreted as the remains of wind-breaks, or even a large tent-ring, up to about 8 x 5 m in size, of mainly mammoth bones enclosing a dense concentration of stone tools, animal bones and ash.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 在洞穴较难找到的中欧和东欧，已经发现的露天遗址大多位于水边。低洼地带适合人类和动物活动；湖泊和河道的沉积模式也有助于保存考古遗存，而位于完全开阔地带的遗址很可能已被侵蚀作用吹散。德国、中欧其他地区和俄罗斯的一些露天遗址，为了解尼安德特人及其生活方式提供了宝贵资料。例如，摩尔多瓦出土的证据被解释为挡风设施的遗迹，甚至可能是一圈大型帐篷的遗迹。这一结构最大约为8米×5米，主要由猛犸象骨骼构成，围住了密集分布的石器、动物骨骼和灰烬。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: From the West European caves more evidence of built structures is available, and some of it goes back a long way in time. In the Grotte du Lazaret, near Nice, at a date during the last ice age but one, claims for some sort of skin tent within the cave have been advanced, on the basis of arrangements of large stones out from the cave wall that might have supported timber struts for a covering of skins up to the rock face above.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: At Lazaret, what might be openings in the hypothesised tents seem to point away from the cave mouth, and finds of wolf and fox foot bones, without the rest of the skeletons, inside these ‘tents’ have been thought to indicate the use of animal pelts as bed coverings. The two patches of ash at Lazaret that mark ancient fires, with stone tools around them evidently made and used on the spot, are edged with small marine mollusc shells, prompting the excavator to suggest that seaweed had been used as bedding around the fires. The cave of Baume-Bonne in the Basses-Alpes region of France, another early site, boasts ten square metres of cobbles brought up from the local river and laid down, as though to take care of a puddle area in the cave, with the smoothest and roundest surfaces of the stones uppermost, and there are other similar cases.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 在拉扎雷，被推测为帐篷入口的部位似乎背向洞口。人们还在这些“帐篷”内发现了狼和狐狸的足骨，却没有发现骨架的其他部分，因此有人认为，兽皮曾被用作床铺覆盖物。拉扎雷有两片灰烬标示出古代火堆，周围还有显然在现场制作和使用的石器。灰烬边缘分布着小型海洋软体动物的贝壳，这促使发掘者推测，人们曾把海藻铺在火堆周围当作寝具。法国下阿尔卑斯地区的博姆博讷洞穴也是一处早期遗址。洞内铺着面积达十平方米的卵石，这些卵石从当地河里运来，仿佛是为了处理洞内的一片积水区；石头最光滑、最圆润的一面都朝上，其他地方也有类似实例。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The ash encountered in concentrations at some sites testifies to the Neanderthal people’s use of fire: not surprising, since use of fire was, by Neanderthal times, an already ancient accomplishment of evolving humanity, and survival in the sub-arctic conditions faced by the Neanderthalers is inconceivable without control of fire. Fire gave warmth, light, heat for cooking and defence against predatory animals. A charred piece of birch from Krapina in Croatia is thought to be the remains of a fire-making twirl stick. But Neanderthal hearths, in the sense of specially constructed places for fire, are fewer and harder to identify with certainty than the mere ash piles that are a regular feature of their sites. They seem often to have just lit a small fire (40–50 cm across) on the existing ground surface of the cave, without preparation. Judging from the shallow penetration of heat effects under the ash, this fire was only of short duration. Sometimes the fires were larger in size, up to one metre across, and quite irregular in shape. It is not always easy to decide how much additional structure some fires possessed: claims of stone circles to contain the fire run up against the fact that stones tend to litter the cave floors everywhere and those around a fire can quite accidentally look as though they were arranged in a circle.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 一些遗址中成片集中出现的灰烬，证明尼安德特人使用过火。这并不令人意外，因为到尼安德特人生活的时代，使用火已经是不断进化的人类掌握已久的技能；若不能控制火，便无法想象他们如何在亚北极环境中生存。火能够提供温暖和照明，可用于烹饪，也能抵御捕食动物。克罗地亚克拉皮纳出土的一块烧焦桦木，被认为是钻木取火所用旋转木棍的残片。然而，如果把炉灶定义为专门修建的用火场所，那么尼安德特人的炉灶比遗址中常见的普通灰堆更少，也更难以确证。他们似乎经常不作任何准备，直接在洞穴原有地面上点起一堆直径40至50厘米的小火。从灰烬下方受热痕迹很浅来看，这种火只燃烧了很短时间。有时火堆较大，直径可达一米，而且形状很不规则。某些火堆究竟带有多少附加结构，并不总是容易判断。有人声称他们用一圈石块围住火堆，但洞穴地面本就到处散落着石头，火堆周围的石块完全可能只是偶然看起来像围成了一个圆圈。

source.text: On art and artists

translation.text: 论艺术与艺术家

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: There really is no such thing as art, only artists. Once these were people who took coloured earth and roughed out the forms of a bison on the wall of a cave; today some buy their paints, and others design posters for hoardings; they did and do many other things. There is no harm in calling all these activities art as long as we keep in mind that such a word may mean very different things in different times and places, and as long as we realize that Art with a capital A has no existence: it has become something of an obsession. You may crush an artist by telling him that what he has just done may be quite good in its own way, only it is not true art.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 其实并没有所谓的艺术，只有艺术家。从前，他们把带颜色的泥土涂到洞穴墙壁上，粗略勾勒出野牛的形状；如今，有些人购买颜料，有些人为广告牌设计海报。他们过去和现在还做着许多其他事情。只要我们记得“艺术”一词在不同时代和地点可能含义迥异，把所有这些活动都称为艺术并无不妥；我们也要明白，首字母大写、被奉为抽象概念的“艺术”并不存在，它已经成了某种执念。你若对一名艺术家说，他刚完成的作品以自身标准来看也许相当不错，只不过不是真正的艺术，就可能把他击垮。

translation.text: 其实并没有所谓的艺术，只有艺术家。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Actually, I do not think that there are any wrong reasons for liking a statue or a picture. We may like a painting of a village scene because it reminds us of home. There is nothing wrong with that. All of us, when we see a painting, are bound to be reminded of a hundred-and-one things which influence our likes and dislikes. As long as these memories help us to enjoy what we see, we need not worry.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Most people like to see in pictures what they would also like to see in reality. This is quite a natural preference. blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The great German painter Dürer certainly drew his mother with as much devotion and love as Rubens felt for his child. blocks.sourceNormalizedText: What is true of beauty is also true of facial expression. In fact, it is often the expression of a figure in the painting which makes us like or loathe the work. Some people like an expression - perhaps of suffering or of compassion - which they can readily understand, and which therefore moves them profoundly. But we should not, for that reason, turn away from works whose expression is perhaps less easy to understand. Often we must first learn to know the artist's methods of drawing to understand the feelings he or she wishes to portray, and may even come to prefer works of art in which expression is not obvious. Just as some of us would rather people use few words and gestures and leave something to be guessed, so some of us would rather look at paintings or sculptures which are open to interpretation.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: But here newcomers to art are often brought up against another difficulty. They want to admire the artist's skill in representing the things they see. What they like best are paintings which 'look real'. This is an important consideration, and the patience and skill which go into the faithful rendering of the visible world are indeed to be admired. Great artists of the past have devoted much labour to works in which every tiny detail is carefully recorded. Dürer's watercolour study of a hare is one of the most famous examples of this loving patience. But who would say that Rembrandt's drawing of an elephant is necessarily less good because it shows fewer details? Indeed Rembrandt gave us the feel of the elephant's wrinkly skin with just a few lines of his chalk.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 不过，刚接触艺术的人常常会在这里遇到另一项困难。他们希望赞叹艺术家再现所见事物的技巧，最喜欢的是那些“看起来真实”的画作。这确实是一项重要考量；为了忠实描绘可见世界而付出的耐心与技巧，也的确值得赞赏。过去的伟大艺术家在作品中倾注大量心血，细致记录每一个微小细节。丢勒以水彩描绘野兔的习作，就是这种满怀热爱的耐心最著名的例子之一。但谁会因为伦勃朗画的大象细节较少，就断言它一定比较差呢？事实上，伦勃朗只用寥寥几笔粉笔线条，就让我们感受到大象皱褶皮肤的质感。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: If we find fault with the accuracy of a picture, we must remember that artists may have their reasons for changing the appearance of what they see. We should also never condemn a work for being incorrectly drawn unless we are quite sure that we are right and the painter is wrong. We have a curious habit of thinking that nature must always look like the pictures we are accustomed to. For generations, paintings showed horses galloping with outstretched legs in full flight through the air, and we came to believe that this was indeed how they moved. It was only the development of photography which proved that horses simply do not gallop in that way. And yet, when painters began to apply this new discovery, and painted horses moving as they actually do, everyone complained that their pictures looked wrong.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 如果我们挑剔一幅画不够准确，就必须记得，艺术家改变所见事物的外观可能自有理由。除非完全确定自己正确而画家有误，否则绝不应仅因一件作品画得“不准确”就加以谴责。我们有一种奇怪的习惯，总以为自然界必然与自己看惯的图画一样。几代人的画作都把奔马画成四肢伸展、整个身体腾空飞驰的样子，于是我们开始相信马确实是这样奔跑的。直到摄影技术发展起来，才证明马根本不会以这种方式奔驰。然而，当画家开始运用这一新发现，按照马的实际动作作画时，人人却都抱怨这些画看起来不对。

source.text: Pacific Navigation and Voyaging

translation.text: 太平洋航海与远航

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: How people migrated to the Pacific islands
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 人类如何迁徙到太平洋岛屿

source.text: How people migrated to the Pacific islands

translation.text: 人类如何迁徙到太平洋岛屿

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The many tiny islands of the Pacific Ocean had no human population until ancestors of today’s islanders sailed from Southeast Asia in ocean-going canoes approximately 2,000 years ago. At the present time, the debate continues about exactly how they migrated such vast distances across the ocean, without any of the modern technologies we take for granted.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 太平洋上众多小岛原本无人居住，直到大约2,000年前，今天岛民的祖先乘坐远洋独木舟从东南亚航行而来。如今，人们仍在争论：在没有任何我们视为理所当然的现代技术时，他们究竟是如何跨越如此辽阔的海洋完成迁徙的。

source.text: The many tiny islands of the Pacific Ocean had no human population until ancestors of today’s islanders sailed from Southeast Asia in ocean-going canoes approximately 2,000 years ago.

translation.text: 太平洋上众多小岛原本无人居住，直到大约2,000年前，今天岛民的祖先乘坐远洋独木舟从东南亚航行而来。

source.text: At the present time, the debate continues about exactly how they migrated such vast distances across the ocean, without any of the modern technologies we take for granted.

translation.text: 如今，人们仍在争论：在没有任何我们视为理所当然的现代技术时，他们究竟是如何跨越如此辽阔的海洋完成迁徙的。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Although the romantic vision of some early twentieth-century writers of fleets of heroic navigators simultaneously setting sail had come to be considered by later investigators to be exaggerated, no considered assessment of Pacific voyaging was forthcoming until 1956 when the American historian Andrew Sharp published his research. Sharp challenged the ‘heroic vision’ by asserting that the expertise of the navigators was limited, and that the settlement of the islands was not systematic, being more dependent on good fortune by drifting canoes. Sharp’s theory was widely challenged, and deservedly so. If nothing else, however, it did spark renewed interest in the topic and precipitated valuable new research.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 20世纪初一些作家描绘了一幅浪漫画面：一支由英勇领航者组成的船队同时扬帆启航。虽然后来的研究者逐渐认为这种描述有所夸大，但直到1956年美国历史学家 Andrew Sharp 发表研究之前，仍没有出现对太平洋远航的严谨评估。Sharp 对这种“英雄式构想”提出质疑，声称领航者的技能有限，岛屿定居也并非有计划地进行，而是更多依赖随波漂流的独木舟碰上好运。Sharp 的理论受到广泛质疑，而且理应如此。不过，即使没有别的贡献，它至少重新激发了人们对这一主题的兴趣，并促成了很有价值的新研究。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Since the 1960s a wealth of investigations has been conducted, and most of them, thankfully, have been of the ‘non-armchair’ variety. While it would be wrong to denigrate all ‘armchair’ research — that based on an examination of available published materials — it has turned out that so little progress had been made in the area of Pacific voyaging because most writers relied on the same old sources — travelers’ journals or missionary narratives compiled by unskilled observers. After Sharp, this began to change, and researchers conducted most of their investigations not in libraries, but in the field.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 自20世纪60年代以来，人们开展了大量研究；值得庆幸的是，其中大多数并非“纸上谈兵”。当然，把所有基于查阅现有出版资料的“书斋研究”都贬得一无是处并不妥当。不过，事实证明，太平洋远航研究之所以长期进展甚微，是因为大多数作者都依赖相同的陈旧资料——缺乏专业知识的观察者编写的旅行者日志或传教士叙述。Sharp 之后，这种情况开始改变，研究者大多不再待在图书馆里，而是到实地开展调查。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In 1965, David Lewis, a physician and experienced yachtsman, set to work using his own unique philosophy: he took the yacht he had owned for many years and navigated through the islands in order to contact those men who still find their way at sea using traditional methods. He then accompanied these men, in their traditional canoes, on test voyages from which all modern instruments were banished from sight, though Lewis secretly used them to confirm the navigator’s calculations. His most famous such voyage was a return trip of around 1,000 nautical miles between two islands in mid-ocean. Far from drifting, as proposed by Sharp, Lewis found that ancient navigators would have known which course to steer by memorizing which stars rose and set in certain positions along the horizon, and this gave them fixed directions by which to steer their boats.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 1965年，医生兼资深帆船手 David Lewis 以自己独特的理念开始研究。他驾驶拥有多年的帆船穿行各岛，以便联系那些仍用传统方法在海上辨认航向的人。随后，他乘坐这些人的传统独木舟与他们一起试航，所有现代仪器都被藏在看不见的地方，不过 Lewis 会暗中使用仪器核实领航者的计算。他最著名的一次试航，是在大洋中央两座岛屿之间往返，航程约1,000海里。Lewis 发现，古代领航者绝非像 Sharp 所说的那样随波漂流。他们会记住哪些星星在地平线特定位置升起和落下，据此判断应走的航向，从而获得驾驶船只所需的固定方向。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The geographer Edwin Doran followed a quite different approach. He was interested in obtaining exact data on canoe sailing performance, and to that end employed the latest electronic instrumentation. Doran traveled on board traditional sailing canoes in some of the most remote parts of the Pacific, all the while using his instruments to record canoe speeds in different wind strengths — from gales to calms — and the angle canoes could sail relative to the wind. In the process, he provided the first really precise attributes of traditional sailing canoes.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 地理学家 Edwin Doran 采取了截然不同的方法。他希望获得独木舟航行性能的精确数据，为此采用了最新的电子仪器。Doran 乘坐传统帆航独木舟，前往太平洋一些最偏远的地区；在整个过程中，他用仪器记录不同风力下——从烈风到无风——独木舟的速度，以及独木舟相对于风向能够保持的航行角度。由此，他首次真正精确地测定了传统帆航独木舟的性能特征。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: A further contribution was made by Steven Horvath. As a physiologist, Horvath’s interest was not in navigation techniques or in canoes, but in the physical capabilities of the men themselves. By adapting standard physiological techniques, Horvath was able to calculate the energy expenditure required to paddle canoes of this sort at times when there was no wind to fill the sails, or when the wind was contrary. He concluded that paddles, or perhaps long oars, could indeed have propelled for long distances what were primarily sailing vessels.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: Steven Horvath 又作出了进一步贡献。作为生理学家，Horvath 感兴趣的不是导航技术或独木舟，而是船员自身的体能。他改造标准生理学技术，计算在无风鼓帆或逆风时，划动这类独木舟所需的能量消耗。他得出结论：桨，或许还有长桨，确实能够推动这些主要依靠风帆的船只航行很远的距离。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Finally, a team led by P. Wall Garrard conducted important research, in this case by making investigations while remaining safely in the laboratory. Wall Garrard’s unusual method was to use the findings of linguists who had studied the languages of the Pacific islands, many of which are remarkably similar although the islands where they are spoken are sometimes thousands of kilometres apart. Clever adaptation of computer simulation techniques pioneered in other disciplines allowed him to produce convincing models suggesting the migrations were indeed systematic, but not simultaneous. Wall Garrard proposed the migrations should be seen not as a single journey made by a massed fleet of canoes, but as a series of ever more ambitious voyages, each pushing further into the unknown ocean.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 最后，P. Wall Garrard 领导的团队开展了一项重要研究；这一次，研究人员安稳地留在实验室内进行调查。Wall Garrard 的独特方法，是利用研究过太平洋岛屿语言的语言学家所取得的成果。许多岛屿相隔有时达数千公里，所使用的语言却惊人地相似。他巧妙改造了其他学科率先采用的计算机模拟技术，建立了具有说服力的模型。这些模型表明，迁徙确实是有计划的，但并非同时发生。Wall Garrard 提出，不应把迁徙看成大批独木舟组成船队的一次航行，而应视为一连串规模越来越宏大的远航，每一次都向未知海洋推进得更远。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: What do we learn about Pacific navigation and voyaging from this research? Quite correctly, none of the researchers tried to use their findings to prove one theory or another; experiments such as these cannot categorically confirm or negate a hypothesis. The strength of this research lay in the range of methodologies employed. When we splice together these findings we can propose that traditional navigators used a variety of canoe types, sources of information and navigation techniques, and it was this adaptability which was their greatest accomplishment. These navigators observed the conditions prevailing at sea at the time a voyage was made and altered their techniques accordingly. Furthermore, the canoes of the navigators were not drifting helplessly at sea but were most likely part of a systematic migration; as such, the Pacific peoples were able to view the ocean as an avenue, not a barrier, to communication before any other race on Earth. Finally, one unexpected but most welcome consequence of this research has been a renaissance in the practice of traditional voyaging. In some groups of islands in the Pacific today, young people are resurrecting the skills of their ancestors, when a few decades ago it seemed they would be lost forever.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 这些研究让我们对太平洋导航和远航有何认识？研究者都没有试图用自己的发现证明某一种理论正确或错误，这样做十分恰当，因为这类实验无法断然证实或否定一项假说。这些研究的优势，在于采用了多种不同方法。把各项发现结合起来，我们可以提出：传统领航者会使用多种独木舟、信息来源和导航技术，而这种适应能力正是他们最大的成就。他们观察每次航行时海上的实际状况，并相应调整技术。此外，领航者的独木舟并非在海上无助地漂流，而很可能是一场有计划迁徙的一部分。因此，太平洋各族人民比地球上任何其他族群都更早把海洋视为沟通的通道，而不是障碍。最后，这些研究还带来了一个意料之外却极受欢迎的结果：传统远航实践重新兴起。如今在太平洋的一些群岛，年轻人正在复兴祖先的技能；而就在几十年前，这些技能似乎还将永远失传。

source.text: Petrol power an eco-revolution

translation.text: 汽油动力：一场生态革命

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Laura Ingalls Wilder’s semi-autobiographical novel The Long Winter describes how the inhabitants of a small town called De Smet in the American Midwest narrowly avoided starvation during the severe winter of 1880–1881. Over three metres of snow fell on the northern plains, immobilising the railways and cutting off the settlers from the rest of the world. Laura and her neighbours were only saved when her fiancé and his friend trudged 30 kilometres through the snow to fetch food, risking their lives in the process. The story is a reminder of how lethal geographical isolation and crop failures could be before the advent of modern farming and transportation technologies. Not long ago, subsistence farmers in many countries had to cope with the ‘lean season’ – the period of greatest scarcity before new crops became available. In England, late spring was once referred to as the ‘hungry gap’. The situation was made worse by the cost of moving heavy things over muddy dirt roads; three centuries ago, moving goods 50 kilometres on land between, say, Liverpool and Manchester was as expensive as shipping them across the North Atlantic.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: Laura Ingalls Wilder 的半自传体小说《漫长的冬季》讲述了1880至1881年严冬期间，美国中西部一个名为 De Smet 的小镇居民如何险些饿死。北部平原降雪超过三米，铁路完全瘫痪，定居者与外界隔绝。Laura 的未婚夫和他的一位朋友冒着生命危险，在雪中艰难跋涉30公里取回食物，她和邻居们才得以获救。这个故事提醒我们，在现代农业和运输技术出现以前，地理隔绝与作物歉收可能多么致命。就在不久前，许多国家的自给农民还不得不熬过“青黄不接期”，也就是新一季作物上市前物资最匮乏的时期。在英格兰，晚春曾被称为“饥饿空档期”。泥泞土路上搬运重物的成本使情况雪上加霜。三个世纪前，假设要在利物浦与曼彻斯特之间通过陆路运输货物50公里，其费用与横渡北大西洋运送货物一样高。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The development of coal-powered railways and steamships in the 19th century revolutionized the lives of farmers. Instead of having to grow everything they needed, they could now specialise in what they did best and rely on other producers for their remaining needs. The result was not only food and ever-cheaper prices, but the end of widespread famine and starvation, as the surplus from regions with good harvests could now be transported to those that had experienced mediocre ones. Since then, petroleum-derived fuels have largely displaced coal because of their higher energy density, cleaner combustion and greater ease of extraction, further improving road and rail transportation systems.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 19世纪，燃煤铁路和蒸汽船的发展彻底改变了农民的生活。他们不必再自行种植所需的一切，而可以专门生产自己最擅长的东西，其余需求则依赖其他生产者满足。结果不仅是食物供应增加、价格不断下降，大范围饥荒和饥饿也随之终结，因为丰收地区的余粮如今可以运往收成一般的地区。此后，石油衍生燃料凭借能量密度更高、燃烧更清洁且更容易开采等优势，在很大程度上取代了煤炭，进一步改善了公路和铁路运输系统。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: While the convenience of modern methods of transportation is obvious, few people grasp their historical significance in terms of their beneficial impact on large cities and the health of residents. In 1898, delegates gathered in New York City for the world’s first international urban-planning conference.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 现代运输方式十分便利，这一点显而易见；但很少有人理解，它们对大城市和居民健康产生有益影响，在历史上具有怎样的重要意义。1898年，各地代表齐聚纽约市，参加世界上第一次国际城市规划会议。

source.text: While the convenience of modern methods of transportation is obvious, few people grasp their historical significance in terms of their beneficial impact on large cities and the health of residents.

translation.text: 现代运输方式十分便利，这一点显而易见；但很少有人理解，它们对大城市和居民健康产生有益影响，在历史上具有怎样的重要意义。

source.text: In 1898, delegates gathered in New York City for the world’s first international urban-planning conference.

translation.text: 1898年，各地代表齐聚纽约市，参加世界上第一次国际城市规划会议。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The topic that dominated discussions was not infrastructure or housing, but horse manure. The problem was that as the populations of cities like New York and London grew, the number of horses there also grew, and in New York these produced nearly two million kilograms of manure each day. If this problem continued, it was estimated that by 1950 every street in London would be buried three metres deep in horse manure. Unable to think of any solution, the delegates concluded that urban living was inherently unsustainable.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 主导会议讨论的议题不是基础设施或住房，而是马粪。问题在于，随着纽约和伦敦等城市人口增长，马匹数量也随之增加；仅纽约的马每天就会产生近200万公斤粪便。据估计，如果问题持续下去，到1950年，伦敦每条街道都会被三米深的马粪掩埋。代表们想不出任何解决办法，因而得出结论：城市生活本质上无法持续。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Paradoxically, much of the urban manure problem was related to the growth of the railways. The ability to deliver perishable goods, such as meat and dairy products, from locations that benefited from better soil and climate, put many farms located near cities out of business. As these had relied on manure from city workhorses for fertiliser, the demand for this was greatly reduced.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 矛盾的是，城市的马粪问题很大程度上与铁路发展有关。铁路能把肉类和奶制品等易腐商品从土壤与气候条件较好的地区运来，致使许多城市附近的农场倒闭。这些农场原本依靠城市役马的粪便作肥料，因此对马粪的需求大幅减少。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The impact of urban workhorses was felt both in the cities and in the countryside. In cities, apart from their overpowering stench, the manure piles were prime breeding grounds for house flies, perhaps three billion of which hatched each day in US cities in the early 20th century. With flies came outbreaks of typhoid, cholera and diphtheria. Workhorses sometimes panicked in heavy traffic and kicked or bit bystanders. The clatter of wagon wheels on cobblestone pavement could be deafening, and since a horse and wagon occupied more street space than a modern truck, they also created significant traffic congestion, while a horse that collapsed on the road created an obstruction that was difficult to remove. The countryside also suffered. To supply the workhorses with oats and hay, additional land had to be cleared of its natural animal life and vegetation, and sometimes water had to be diverted to irrigate it, with considerable negative effects on the whole area.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 城市役马的影响既波及城市，也波及乡村。在城市里，粪堆不仅散发令人难以忍受的恶臭，还是家蝇的主要孳生地；20世纪初，美国城市每天孵化的家蝇或许多达30亿只。苍蝇随之带来了伤寒、霍乱和白喉的暴发。役马有时会在拥挤交通中受惊，踢伤或咬伤旁人。马车车轮在鹅卵石路面上发出的哐当声可能震耳欲聋；一匹马和一辆马车占用的街道空间比现代卡车还多，因此也会造成严重交通拥堵，而一匹倒在路上的马则会成为很难清除的障碍。乡村同样受害。为了给役马供应燕麦和干草，人们不得不开垦更多土地，清除原有的动物和植被；有时还要改道引水灌溉，对整个地区造成相当严重的负面影响。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: So, while the trains, cars and trucks of the early 20th century were noisy and polluting by today’s standards, they were regarded as a significant improvement on what had gone before. Before they were available, poor soils often meant that a large amount of land was required to sustain a household, and much environmental damage, primarily in the form of soil erosion, was caused by trying to farm these soils. It could be argued that modern transportation allowed the development of remote regions like the Canadian Prairies and allowed more suitable crops to be grown in the poorer soils in Europe before being sold elsewhere.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 因此，尽管以今天的标准来看，20世纪初的火车、汽车和卡车既嘈杂又造成污染，当时的人们仍认为，它们比此前的运输方式有了显著改善。在这些交通工具出现以前，贫瘠土壤往往意味着维持一个家庭需要大片土地；尝试耕种这类土壤还造成了大量环境破坏，主要表现为土壤侵蚀。可以说，现代运输使加拿大大草原等偏远地区得以开发，也让人们能够在欧洲较贫瘠的土地上种植更适合的作物，再运往别处销售。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Over time, the concentration of food production in the world’s best locations allowed some agricultural land to revert to a wild state. For instance, France benefited from an expansion of its forest area by one third between 1830 and 1960. This so-called ‘forest transition’ occurred in the context of a doubling of the French population and a dramatic increase in standards of living.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Improvements in logistics also allowed the production and export of food from locations where water was abundant to regions where it was scarce, thus preventing the depletion of water resources there. It also made possible a drastic increase in the size of our cities. Contrary to what most people believe, the growth in cities is a positive development. In the words of economist Ed Glaeser: ‘Residing in a forest might seem to be a good way of showing one’s love of nature, but living in a concrete jungle is actually far more ecologically friendly… If you love nature, stay away from it.’ It could be argued that modern transportation technologies have been a major contributor to a wealthier, cleaner and more sustainable world.

source.text: Rebranding art museums

translation.text: 艺术博物馆的品牌重塑

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: A study of the reopened National Gallery of Victoria
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 重开后的维多利亚国家美术馆（National Gallery of Victoria）研究

source.text: A study of the reopened National Gallery of Victoria

translation.text: 重开后的维多利亚国家美术馆（National Gallery of Victoria）研究

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: As anyone with even a passing interest in cultural institutions will know, art museums are adapting to keep up with changes in society. Do any of these newly developed spaces indicate a fundamental shift in the ways we engage with art at the beginning of the twenty-first century? The answer is a qualified Yes and also, it must be said, No. A clear sense of this can be gained by considering the 2003 redevelopment of the National Gallery of Victoria (NGV) in Melbourne, Australia’s second largest city, in the light of the aspirations embodied in the original building that served as its template.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 只要对文化机构略有兴趣，人们就会知道，艺术博物馆正在作出调整，以跟上社会变化。21世纪初，这些新开发的空间中，是否有任何一处表明我们接触艺术的方式发生了根本转变？答案是有条件的“是”，但也不得不说是“否”。要清楚理解这一点，可以考察2003年维多利亚国家美术馆（NGV）的改建，并把它与作为改建蓝本的原建筑所体现的愿景相对照。该美术馆位于澳大利亚第二大城市墨尔本。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: The first building was considered a thoroughly modern museum when it opened to the public in 1968. We should not forget that it was also bold, entrepreneurial and innovative in ways that have done great credit to the vision and foresight of the architect, Roy Grounds. For one thing, the 1968 building signalled a strong sense of engagement with Asian and Pacific cultures, both in its architecture and through the layout of its collections. Its entrance lobby was designed to facilitate the rapid and efficient circulation of visitors. It also contained a series of greatly expanded temporary exhibition galleries and a vast Great Hall, which represented an unprecedented emphasis on the ancillary roles of corporate functions and public performances in the contemporary museum.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 第一座馆舍于1968年向公众开放时，被视为一座彻底现代化的博物馆。我们不应忘记，无论是大胆、进取还是创新，这座建筑都充分证明了建筑师 Roy Grounds 的远见卓识。首先，1968年的建筑无论在建筑风格上，还是在藏品布局上，都鲜明体现出对亚洲和太平洋文化的关注。入口大厅的设计便于参观者迅速高效地通行。馆内还设有一系列大幅扩建的临时展厅和一座规模宏大的大会堂；在当代博物馆中，企业活动和公共演出这两项辅助功能从未受到过如此重视。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: This last feature might have seemed excessive to some, yet how wise it has proven over the years as museums have come to place increasing emphasis on corporate sponsorship, and on the need to generate additional funds via room hire. Furthermore, the Great Hall has for forty years provided an area for children to roam at large before being escorted through the much less spatially accommodating galleries themselves. As an unintimidating introduction to the lifelong rigours of visiting art museums, its impact on attendance cannot be overestimated.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 最后这项设计在一些人看来或许有些过头，但多年来，随着博物馆越来越重视企业赞助，也越来越需要通过出租场地获得额外收入，它已经证明设计者何等明智。此外，四十年来，孩子们可以先在大会堂内自由跑动，再由大人带着穿过空间局促得多的展厅。作为终身参观艺术博物馆这一辛苦旅程的轻松起点，大会堂对参观人数的影响再怎么估计也不过分。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: At the same time, other aspects of the 1968 NGV have not withstood the test of time so well. Foremost among these are the huge expanse of the exterior’s windowless wall and the surrounding moat, which creates a rather unwelcoming expression of the museum as a temple of culture set apart from the everyday world. Over time, this idea has been questioned, and has been superseded by the growing impetus towards the alternative model of the museum as a more open-ended and visitor-friendly forum that engages the public more effectively.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 与此同时，1968年美术馆的另一些方面却没有很好地经受住时间考验。其中最突出的是外墙大片没有窗户的区域和环绕建筑的护城河。这些设计给人的印象并不亲切，仿佛博物馆是一座与日常世界隔绝的文化殿堂。随着时间推移，这一理念受到质疑，并逐渐让位于另一种越来越受推崇的模式：把博物馆建成一个更开放、对参观者更友好的公共论坛，以更有效地吸引公众参与。

translation.text: 其中最突出的是外墙大片没有窗户的区域和环绕建筑的护城河。这些设计给人的印象并不亲切，仿佛博物馆是一座与日常世界隔绝的文化殿堂。

source.text: Over time, this idea has been questioned, and has been superseded by the growing impetus towards the alternative model of the museum as a more open-ended and visitor-friendly forum that engages the public more effectively.

translation.text: 随着时间推移，这一理念受到质疑，并逐渐让位于另一种越来越受推崇的模式：把博物馆建成一个更开放、对参观者更友好的公共论坛，以更有效地吸引公众参与。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: With these considerations in mind, Mario Bellini’s redeveloped NGV opened in 2003 and his design reflects what the new, improved, twenty-first century global museum feels it should be emphasising to its visitors. Here the institution’s energies are focused, not so much on the technical subtleties of how to design the galleries themselves, as on presenting to the public a spectacular image of the museum itself as a welcoming yet efficient facilitator of social interaction, popular entertainment and public knowledge. All of this is certainly impressive, but where has the art gone? We are not allowed to see the exhibitions until we have completed the necessary inductions. We are greeted by a hugely expanded cloakroom screening off our vision to the right, followed by a large visitor information office leading to the ticket booths. Above us is the cafe and to our left we cannot escape the NGV shop set alongside the exit.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: And what of the redesigned galleries themselves? In fact, they represent a wonderfully elegant reframing of the permanent collections in ways that should offer first-time visitors and seasoned members alike many new avenues for engagement in the years to come. But herein lies the conundrum posed by the NGV renovation and by the global sweep of new museum projects more generally. The mainstay elements of a permanent collection can become all too easily lost in the increased prominence that these rebranding exercises tend to place on the more glamorously spectacular aspects of the institution itself. At its most extreme, this results in the construction of new buildings that supplant the artworks inside them to become the major attractions themselves.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 那么，重新设计的展厅本身怎么样？事实上，它们以极其优雅的方式重新呈现永久藏品，未来多年应能为初次来访者和资深会员提供许多新的参与途径。然而，这里也正隐藏着维多利亚国家美术馆改建乃至全球新博物馆项目普遍面临的难题。此类品牌重塑往往更突出机构本身华丽壮观的方面，永久藏品中的核心内容很容易因此被淹没。到了最极端的情况，新建筑会取代馆内艺术品，本身成为主要景点。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: These challenges are most keenly felt in the area of the temporary exhibition. Entrance to the NGV permanent collection is now free, so the NGV needs something to keep the paying public coming back. The answer lies in the international ‘blockbuster’ exhibition. The Impressionists, for example, netted a total of 380,000 visitors, making it one of the most popular exhibitions in Australian history. There has also been, it needs to be said, a commendable attempt to leaven the international masterpieces with selected highlights from the permanent collection. Overall, though, the prevalence of these ‘rental’ blockbusters cannot but help introduce a certain ‘off the rack’ feeling to the institution’s exhibition programme. More importantly perhaps, they clearly narrow the options for other worthy but less glamorous projects, and they take energy away from the curators’ potential to do further work on and around the permanent collection itself.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 这些挑战在临时展览方面表现得最为突出。如今，参观维多利亚国家美术馆的永久藏品不收门票，因此美术馆需要某种内容，让愿意付费的公众不断回来。答案就是国际“重磅”展览。例如，“印象派画家”展共吸引38万名参观者，成为澳大利亚历史上最受欢迎的展览之一。还必须指出，馆方也作出了值得称赞的尝试，从永久藏品中选出亮点，与国际名作搭配展出。但总体来看，这类“租来”的重磅展览大行其道，不可避免地让馆方的展览计划带上几分“套用现成模板”的感觉。或许更重要的是，它们明显压缩了其他值得开展却不那么光鲜的项目空间，也分散了策展人本可用于进一步研究永久藏品本身及相关领域的精力。

passages.title: Research into the effects of different teaching styles

headerUnits.sourceNormalizedText: Research into the effects of different teaching styles
headerUnits.translationNormalizedText: 不同教学风格影响的研究

source.text: Research into the effects of different teaching styles

translation.text: 不同教学风格影响的研究

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Prior to 1960, most inquiries into pupils’ learning skills explored the relationship between factors such as children’s social background, personality or measured intelligence and their achievement in various school subjects. Studies of teachers were largely a quest for criteria of effectiveness, and numerous investigations sought links between personality or attitude and ‘success’ at teaching. By 1950, Domas and Tiedeman were able to survey 672 such studies of teacher effectiveness. Yet there was widespread disappointment with such research, partly because so little of value seemed to emerge. First of all, there was little agreement about what constituted ‘good’ teaching or who the good teachers were. Secondly, there were numerous conflicting and contradictory findings. No sooner had one investigator found a relationship which appeared to be significant, than another discovered the opposite effect.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 1960年以前，多数有关学生学习能力的调查，都在探究儿童的社会背景、性格或测得的智力等因素，与他们在各门学校科目中成绩之间的关系。对教师的研究则大多是在寻找衡量有效教学的标准，许多调查试图找出性格或态度与教学“成功”之间的联系。到1950年，Domas 和 Tiedeman 已经能够综述672项此类教师效能研究。然而，人们普遍对这类研究感到失望，部分原因是它们似乎很少产生有价值的结果。首先，对于怎样才算“良好”教学、哪些人才是好教师，人们几乎没有共识。其次，研究中存在许多相互冲突、彼此矛盾的发现。一名研究者刚发现一种看似显著的关系，另一名研究者便会发现相反的效果。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: For example, in 1945, two American researchers, Rostker and Rolfe, both using standardized testing techniques and broad samples of teachers, reached exactly opposite conclusions. Rostker concluded that the intelligence of the teacher is the most important single factor conditioning teaching ability, and that there is no significant relationship between personality and teaching ability. Rolfe, however, found no correlation between intelligence and teaching efficiency: he claimed that the teacher’s personality was what produced good teaching. Another American writer, Barr (1961), summarized a massive amount of American research and underlined the chaos in the research literature on effectiveness: “Some teachers were preferred by administrators, some were liked by the pupils, and some taught in classes where there were substantial pupil gains, and generally speaking these were not the same teachers.”

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: One of the earliest pieces of research dates from 1912, when Stevens made 100 random observations of lessons in a variety of subject areas, in order to analyze the number and nature of questions being asked by teachers. Stevens’s overall total was 64% teacher talk and 36% pupil talk, figures which are remarkably similar to a number of findings half a century later.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: For many years in the first half of the 20th century, so-called ‘formal’ teaching was the norm. Teachers taught their classes as a whole group, gave out information, asked questions which predominantly required factual recall, and frequently set a common written task for the children to complete in a prescribed period of time. It was hardly surprising, therefore, that one focus of classroom interaction research in the decades following Stevens’s inquiry was on the phenomenon of ‘attentiveness’. A number of studies in the 1920s and 1930s, by Morrison and others, sought relationships between the degree of attention being paid by children and the amount they subsequently appeared to have learnt. Such research was usually based on observing teachers at work, a technique which was also employed extensively by United States administrators in the 1920s and 1930s, in order to assess teachers’ competence and allocate merit payments to so-called ‘superior’ teachers.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 20世纪上半叶的许多年里，所谓“正式”教学一直是常态。教师把全班作为一个整体授课，传授信息，提出主要要求回忆事实的问题，还经常布置统一的书面任务，要求儿童在规定时间内完成。因此，Stevens 调查之后几十年间，课堂互动研究的一项重点是“专注”现象，这毫不奇怪。20世纪20年代和30年代，Morrison 等人开展了多项研究，寻找儿童的专注程度与他们后来表现出的学习量之间的关系。这类研究通常以观察教师工作为基础。20世纪20年代和30年代，美国管理人员也广泛采用这种方法，以评估教师能力，并向所谓“优秀”教师发放绩效奖金。

source.text: A number of studies in the 1920s and 1930s, by Morrison and others, sought relationships between the degree of attention being paid by children and the amount they subsequently appeared to have learnt.

translation.text: 20世纪20年代和30年代，Morrison 等人开展了多项研究，寻找儿童的专注程度与他们后来表现出的学习量之间的关系。

source.text: Such research was usually based on observing teachers at work, a technique which was also employed extensively by United States administrators in the 1920s and 1930s, in order to assess teachers’ competence and allocate merit payments to so-called ‘superior’ teachers.

translation.text: 这类研究通常以观察教师工作为基础。20世纪20年代和30年代，美国管理人员也广泛采用这种方法，以评估教师能力，并向所谓“优秀”教师发放绩效奖金。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: As the 1930s came to an end, it was partly the emergence of totalitarian regimes in Europe which led to a shift in interest in the United States away from attentiveness, with its emphasis on the authority of the teacher, and towards a scrutiny of authoritarianism itself. A number of people began to feel that if dictatorship were to be avoided, children must learn in school how to handle democracy. Several investigators examined the processes taking place within small discussion groups, and tried to establish superiority for discussion groups over lecture classes, but with conflicting results. The movement towards what was becoming known as child-centred education was gathering momentum, and as interest in child development increased, investigators began to discover the usefulness of direct observation and the categorization of child behavior.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 20世纪30年代末，欧洲极权政权的出现，在一定程度上推动美国的研究兴趣从强调教师权威的“专注”问题转向对权威主义本身的审视。一些人逐渐认为，要避免独裁，儿童就必须在学校学会如何践行民主。数名研究人员考察了小型讨论组内部发生的过程，试图证明讨论组优于讲授式课堂，却得出了相互矛盾的结果。后来被称为儿童中心教育的运动声势日盛；随着人们对儿童发展的兴趣增加，研究人员开始发现直接观察和对儿童行为进行分类很有用。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: This was when systematic observation of teacher-pupil interaction began in earnest. Anderson (1939) studied what he called ‘domination’ and ‘integration’ amongst kindergarten children. Dominative acts by children included blaming and snatching toys, and such acts by teachers included restricting children’s activities; while children’s integrative acts included sharing facilities and playing harmoniously, and those of teachers included expanding opportunities for self-direction and co-operation. Anderson then attempted to measure what is now commonly called ‘classroom climate’.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 正是在这一时期，对师生互动的系统观察真正开始。Anderson 在1939年研究了幼儿园儿童中他所谓的“支配”和“融合”。儿童的支配行为包括责备别人和抢夺玩具，教师的此类行为包括限制儿童活动；儿童的融合行为包括共享设施、和谐玩耍，教师的此类行为则包括扩大儿童自主行动与合作的机会。随后，Anderson 尝试衡量如今通常所说的“课堂氛围”。

source.text: Risk taking

translation.text: 承担风险

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: We run risks. Most of the time we ignore them; sometimes we stop and decide how to deal with them. That’s life. Risks arise in sports, in business, in personal relationships; they are present in the laboratory, in political calculations, everywhere. Acting individually, we often prefer to gain some benefit by accepting some danger. Acting collectively, we make similar trade-offs.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 我们都要冒风险。大多数时候，我们忽略风险；有时则会停下来，决定如何应对。这就是生活。体育运动、商业和人际关系中都会出现风险；实验室里有风险，政治算计中有风险，风险无处不在。以个人身份行动时，我们常愿意承受一些危险来换取某些好处；集体行动时，我们也会作出类似的权衡。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: When society must assess risks, and those risks can be clarified, at least in part, by science, technology or mathematics, the responsibility of the research community is to be clear and complete. But that is not always so easy. Furthermore, too few people pay full attention to the best evidence, much less modify their behaviors as a result. Even when the evidence of high risk is clear – about smoking, for instance – many will deny the risk, or dispute it, or accept that it exists and still go ahead. As a former cigarette smoker, I understand denial.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 当社会必须评估风险，而科学、技术或数学至少能澄清其中一部分时，研究界有责任作出清楚而完整的说明。但这并不总是那么容易。此外，充分关注最佳证据的人太少，愿意因此改变行为的人就更少了。即使高风险的证据十分明确——例如吸烟的风险——许多人仍会否认或质疑风险，或者承认它存在却照做不误。我以前也吸烟，因此理解这种否认心理。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Perhaps more important than the basic facts of risk are the varied perception of it. Hearing the prediction of 60% chance of rain, or recognizing the minuscule likelihood of becoming ill from a flu shot, most people understand the right responses: take your umbrella and get your flu shot. But some, fearfully but irrationally, go to the extreme and stay at home and avoid all contact with other people. Irrational decisions occasionally affect us all. When it comes to risks the best odds do not always influence people to make the correct decision.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: In her book, The Universe and the Teacup, the science writer K. C. Cole reminds us that the risks of losing something and gaining something appear to be calculated in our minds according to quite different scales. People will risk a lot to prevent a loss, she notes; some people will rush into a burning building to save a pet. But they will usually risk very little if the only perceived outcome is a possible gain; many people won’t even risk pursuing an exciting job, if the current job, though unfulfilling, remains comfortable. That psychological mechanism, a desire to maintain the status quo, helps explain the high hurdles that any rational risk assessment must confront.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 科学作家 K. C. Cole 在《宇宙与茶杯》一书中提醒我们，失去某物的风险与得到某物的机会，似乎会在我们头脑中按照截然不同的尺度来计算。她指出，人们愿意冒很大风险来避免损失；有些人会冲进着火的建筑营救宠物。但如果他们认为唯一可能的结果只是获得某种好处，通常就只愿承担很小风险。即使现有工作不能令人满足，只要还算舒适，许多人甚至不愿冒险追求一份令人兴奋的新工作。这种希望维持现状的心理机制，有助于解释任何理性风险评估都必须跨越的重重障碍。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Organizations face the same hurdles whenever they must cope with major shifts in policy. In his classic examination of the character of high-tech industry, Only the Paranoid Survive, Andrew S. Grove gives a perceptive account of a crisis that took place during his tenure as Chairman of the Intel Corporation. The business environment for Intel and its competitors was transformed by a flood of low-cost memory chips from Japan, and Intel made the difficult decision to abandon its chip-making business. Such a period of change in the outside world is filled with danger, Grove notes, precisely because it is so easy for executives to try to disregard it or misinterpret the mounting evidence showing the profound risks of not making change at the very core. The distinction Cole cites is instructive here: one reason management and staff may not act is that they tend to focus on the potential gains of risking change (which they characterize as small), rather than on the catastrophic losses that risking change could prevent. The period becomes critical for a company, according to Grove, and deadly when unattended to.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 每当机构必须应对重大政策转变时，也会面临同样的障碍。Andrew S. Grove 在考察高科技产业特征的经典著作《只有偏执狂才能生存》中，深刻讲述了他担任 Intel 公司董事长期间发生的一场危机。来自日本的低价存储芯片大量涌入，彻底改变了 Intel 及其竞争者的商业环境，Intel 因而作出艰难决定，放弃芯片制造业务。Grove 指出，外部世界发生这种变化的时期充满危险，原因恰恰是高管很容易试图忽视或误读不断增加的证据；这些证据显示，不从核心作出改变会带来深重风险。Cole 提到的区别在这里很有启发性：管理层和员工可能不采取行动，一个原因是他们往往关注冒险变革可能带来的收益，并把收益说得很小，却不去关注冒险变革可以防止的灾难性损失。Grove 认为，这个时期对企业至关重要；若置之不理，则会致命。

source.text: The distinction Cole cites is instructive here: one reason management and staff may not act is that they tend to focus on the potential gains of risking change (which they characterize as small), rather than on the catastrophic losses that risking change could prevent.

translation.text: Cole 提到的区别在这里很有启发性：管理层和员工可能不采取行动，一个原因是他们往往关注冒险变革可能带来的收益，并把收益说得很小，却不去关注冒险变革可以防止的灾难性损失。

source.text: The period becomes critical for a company, according to Grove, and deadly when unattended to.

translation.text: Grove 认为，这个时期对企业至关重要；若置之不理，则会致命。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: It is more than 100 years since the death of the Scottish writer Robert Louis Stevenson on the South Pacific island of Samoa, and it seems that time has not been kind to Stevenson’s memory. Immediately after his death, his family and friends set to work to fashion the legend of Robert Louis Stevenson, or R. L. S., as he became known, one of the few writers familiar from his initials alone. Subsequent works of biography then turned him into a writer of almost religious importance. One example was literary critic Balfour, who in 1901 portrayed Stevenson’s family as ministering angels to the dying genius during his final illness. Similarly, the biographer Crouch absurdly overstated Stevenson’s significance by placing him in the same company as those most revered names in English literature: Shakespeare and Keats. The reaction to this nonsense was a number of highly critical assessments of Stevenson’s legacy in the 1920s.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 苏格兰作家 Robert Louis Stevenson 在南太平洋萨摩亚岛去世，距今已超过100年；时间似乎并未善待人们对他的记忆。他去世后，亲友立即开始塑造 Robert Louis Stevenson 的传奇。他后来以 R. L. S. 为人所知，是少数仅凭姓名首字母就能被认出的作家之一。随后出现的传记作品又把他塑造成一位几乎具有宗教重要性的作家。例如，文学评论家 Balfour 在1901年描写 Stevenson 最后患病期间，把他的家人刻画成照料这位垂死天才的天使。同样，传记作家 Crouch 荒谬地夸大 Stevenson 的重要性，把他与英语文学中最受敬仰的名字——莎士比亚和济慈——并列。对这些无稽之谈的反弹，是20世纪20年代出现了多项对 Stevenson 文学遗产极为严厉的评价。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Normally, the critical pendulum can be relied on to swing back again, but there are several aspects of Stevenson’s work that have, until recently, acted against a more balanced appraisal. First is the allegation that Stevenson was a mere master of linguistic fireworks, who lacked moral depth. Some critics accused him of being a literary charlatan, of juggling words very prettily to strike effects which overawed an ignorant public, and served to distract from the inadequacy of his ideas.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Then there has long been a prejudice against the adventure story as the proper medium for deep moral seriousness, a prejudice which is still extremely influential today. It seems that we can accept that an adventure film can successfully express profound moral truths, but we reject the same idea for a book. The absurdity of this becomes apparent when we think of writers like Joseph Conrad and Graham Greene, but it is no use pretending that this bias against adventure stories is not part of our high culture. A further problem is that Stevenson has often not found favour in the land of his birth because his conservatism so often collides with the strong radical tradition in Scotland. His many escapist stories and preference for living abroad have led to accusations that he camouflaged Scotland’s problems. Lastly, the high adventure of Stevenson’s own lifestyle has sometimes obscured his output, his life a greater story than any he could devise. This was precisely what his friends feared would happen towards the end of his short life: his art might be overwhelmed by the drama of life in Samoa.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 长期以来，人们还抱有一种偏见，认为冒险故事不适合承载深刻而严肃的道德思想；这种偏见至今仍有极大影响。我们似乎能够接受一部冒险电影成功表达深刻的道德真理，却不愿接受一本书也能做到同样的事。想到 Joseph Conrad 和 Graham Greene 等作家，这种看法的荒谬便显而易见；但若假装对冒险故事的偏见并非高雅文化的一部分，也毫无意义。另一个问题是，Stevenson 在出生地往往不受欢迎，因为他的保守主义经常与苏格兰强大的激进传统发生冲突。他创作了许多逃避现实的故事，又偏爱在国外生活，因此被指责掩盖了苏格兰的问题。最后，Stevenson 自身极富冒险色彩的生活有时遮蔽了他的作品；他的一生比自己能构思的任何故事都更精彩。在他短暂生命接近尾声时，朋友们担心的恰恰就是这一点：他的艺术可能被萨摩亚生活的戏剧性淹没。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: One consequence of this has been that Stevenson’s influence on other writers has too often been neglected. The writer and poet Oscar Wilde was deeply influenced by Stevenson, even though he declared that Stevenson would have produced better work if he had lived in London rather than Samoa. Stevenson tends to stick in the throat even of those writers who would like to spit him out, such as Shaw, who claimed to have learned from him that the romantic hero is always mocked by reality. Likewise, the writer Galsworthy, who began as a determined critic, later changed his mind and said that the superiority of Stevenson over the novelist Hardy was that Stevenson was all life and Hardy all death. The influence on the novelist Chesterton would also repay detailed study, for it was through him that Stevenson has managed to cross the ages, emerging as an influence on the modernist movement and our own contemporary Latin American school of “magical realism”.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 这种情况造成的一个后果是，Stevenson 对其他作家的影响太常受到忽视。作家兼诗人 Oscar Wilde 深受 Stevenson 影响，尽管他曾宣称，如果 Stevenson 住在伦敦而不是萨摩亚，作品会写得更好。即使是那些很想排斥 Stevenson 的作家，也往往摆脱不了他的影响；Shaw 就是如此，他声称自己从 Stevenson 那里认识到，浪漫英雄总会受到现实的嘲弄。同样，作家 Galsworthy 起初坚决批评 Stevenson，后来却改变看法，认为 Stevenson 胜过小说家 Hardy 之处在于，Stevenson 笔下全是生命，而 Hardy 笔下全是死亡。Stevenson 对小说家 Chesterton 的影响也值得深入研究，因为正是通过 Chesterton，Stevenson 的影响才得以跨越时代，并延伸至现代主义运动和当代拉丁美洲的‘魔幻现实主义’流派。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: When making an assessment of his life and work one question must inevitably be asked: was Robert Louis Stevenson Scotland’s greatest writer of English prose? For most commentators this honour falls to Sir Walter Scott, author of Ivanhoe among many other classic novels, and it is true that in terms of craftsmanship, precision and the ability to minutely regulate language to create the desired effect, Scott takes the prize. However, this is not the same thing at all as inherent talent; by way of comparison one may take the example of the two great Russian composers Shostakovich and Prokofiev, of whom the former had learned more precise skills of execution but the latter’s intrinsic genius was greater, and so it seems to be with Scott and Stevenson. Admittedly, Scott’s detailed style does permit his stories to explore levels of tragedy that are beyond Stevenson’s reach, but in this regard they have the musty smell of the museum, somehow artificial and removed from modern day reality. On the other hand, Stevenson’s skill with plotting and narrative gives his books a timeless quality, so that they still live today, and Stevenson was also the shrewder judge of behaviour and psychology. For example, his compelling descriptions of a man with a split personality in The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde have proved so accessible and accurate that the expression “Jekyll and Hyde” has entered common English usage. Even if we do not see a revival of critical interest in this great Scottish writer, it is to be hoped that readers go back to Robert Louis Stevenson’s magnificent stories and reassess this neglected genius.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 评价史蒂文森的生平和作品时，有一个问题不可避免：Robert Louis Stevenson 是否是苏格兰最伟大的英语散文作家？对大多数评论者而言，这项荣誉属于 Walter Scott 爵士；他创作了《艾凡赫》等许多经典小说。的确，如果衡量工艺、精准度，以及细致调控语言以产生预期效果的能力，Scott 更胜一筹。然而，这与内在天赋完全不是一回事。可以用俄国两位伟大作曲家 Shostakovich 和 Prokofiev 作比较：前者掌握了更精准的创作技巧，后者的内在天才却更为卓越；Scott 与 Stevenson 似乎也是如此。诚然，Scott 细致的文风使其故事能够探索 Stevenson 力所不及的悲剧层次，但在这方面，他的作品带着博物馆里陈旧发霉的气息，显得有些造作，也脱离现代现实。另一方面，Stevenson 构思情节和叙事的技巧赋予作品永恒特质，使它们至今仍有生命力；他对行为和心理的判断也更敏锐。例如，他在《杰基尔医生与海德先生奇案》中对一名双重人格者所作的动人描写，既通俗易懂又十分准确，以至于“Jekyll and Hyde”已成为英语中的常用说法。即使评论界对这位伟大苏格兰作家的兴趣没有复兴，也希望读者能重读 Robert Louis Stevenson 的精彩故事，重新评价这位被忽视的天才。

source.text: Sea Change for Salinity

translation.text: 盐碱化防治迎来重大转变

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: One of the most serious problems facing Australian farmers is an increase in the salt content in the soil. However, there are new weapons emerging in the fight against salinity.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 澳大利亚农民面临的最严重问题之一，是土壤中的盐分不断增加。不过，抗击盐碱化的新武器正在出现。

source.text: One of the most serious problems facing Australian farmers is an increase in the salt content in the soil.

translation.text: 澳大利亚农民面临的最严重问题之一，是土壤中的盐分不断增加。

source.text: However, there are new weapons emerging in the fight against salinity.

translation.text: 不过，抗击盐碱化的新武器正在出现。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Beneath the flat, impassive surface of Australia lie hidden mountains, valleys and gorges – ancient traps and channels for the deadly salt that is stealthily killing so much of the Australian landscape. The war on salt is calling forth new weapons. A suite of high technologies used by geologists to see underground and prospect for gold and minerals is now being used to pinpoint the presence of salt beneath the landscape, and to predict where it might move.
blocks.translationNormalizedText: 澳大利亚平坦沉静的地表之下，隐藏着山脉、谷地和峡谷。它们是古老的陷阱和通道，致命盐分正沿其悄然流动，使澳大利亚大片土地失去生机。抗盐之战正在召唤新武器。地质学家用来透视地下、勘探黄金和矿物的一整套高科技，如今正被用于精确定位地表之下的盐分，并预测它可能流向何处。

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Unless this process is clearly understood, warns Chief of Exploration and Mining Dr Neil Phillips, the hard work now underway of planning and tree-planting on the surface may be rendered ineffective: salt can still sneak past and erupt, following one of the ancient river channels formed millions of years ago. The use of airborne electromagnetics to detect salt hidden beneath the landscape has been around for a decade, but the past two years have seen a major development in its precision and powers of detection. Like the use of radar in battles, it has the potential to turn the tide of the struggle in favour of the defence by helping to pinpoint, plot and predict the movements of the foe.

blocks.sourceNormalizedText: Angus Howell, who farms near Warrenbayne, in Southeast Australia, saw his first outbreak of salt in 1948. Over the ensuing decades the patches spread and multiplied until they consumed almost 100 hectares. By the late 1970s, Howell and his fellow farmers had decided it was time for action and established a government-funded “Landcare” group in a bid to save Australia’s farmland. But despite a mounting effort by scientists, farmers and governments, the “white death” continued to encroach. Small successes were eclipsed by larger defeats and fresh outbreaks.
